File Summary

Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of the entire repository's contents.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:

- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Only files matching these patterns are included: app/**/*, proxy.ts, scripts/**/*, package.json, next.config.ts, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, repomix.config.json

File: app/components/Accordion.tsx

"use client";

import { useState } from 'react';
import styles from './Accordion.module.css';

type AccordionProps = {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
};

export default function Accordion({ title, children }: AccordionProps) {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div>
      <div className={styles.header} onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}>
        {title}
        <span className={`${styles.icon} ${isOpen ? styles.iconOpen : ''}`}>
          ▼
        </span>
      </div>
      {isOpen && <div className={styles.content}>{children}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: app/[city]/about/page.tsx
================
import { notFound, permanentRedirect } from 'next/navigation';
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { getAllCitySlugs, getCityBySlug } from '../../lib/cities';
import AboutView from '../../components/AboutView';
type PageProps = {
  params: Promise<{ city: string }>;
};
export async function generateStaticParams() {
  return getAllCitySlugs().map((city) => ({ city }));
}
export async function generateMetadata({ params }: PageProps): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { city: citySlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    return {
      title: 'City Not Found',
      robots: { index: false, follow: false },
    };
  }
  return {
    title: `About — ${city.name}`,
    description: `Learn about Someplace Social and community event listings in ${city.heroLocation}.`,
    alternates: {
      canonical: `/${city.slug}/about`,
    },
  };
}
export default async function CityAboutPage({ params }: PageProps) {
  const { city: citySlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    notFound();
  }
  if (city.slug !== citySlug) {
    permanentRedirect(`/${city.slug}/about`);
  }
  return <AboutView city={city} />;
}

================
File: app/[city]/events/[event]/NextOccurrenceBadge.tsx
================
'use client';
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import { Event } from '../../../lib/google-sheets';
import { getNextEventOccurrence } from '../../../events/event-helpers';
const emptySubscribe = () => () => {};
interface NextOccurrenceBadgeProps {
  event: Event;
  timeZone: string;
  initialLabel: string | null;
  className: string;
  todayClassName?: string;
}
export default function NextOccurrenceBadge({
  event,
  timeZone,
  initialLabel,
  className,
  todayClassName,
}: NextOccurrenceBadgeProps) {
  const label = useSyncExternalStore(
    emptySubscribe,
    () => getNextEventOccurrence(event, timeZone, 90)?.label ?? null,
    () => initialLabel
  );
  if (!label) return null;
  const isToday = label === 'Today';
  return (
    <span className={`${className} ${isToday && todayClassName ? todayClassName : ''}`}>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

================
File: app/[city]/events/[event]/opengraph-image.tsx
================
import { ImageResponse } from 'next/og';
import { getCityBySlug } from '../../../lib/cities';
import { getEvents } from '../../../lib/google-sheets';
import { isFreePrice } from '../../../events/utils';
import { buildScheduleLine, resolveEventBySlug } from '../../../events/event-helpers';
export const revalidate = 3600;
export const size = {
  width: 1200,
  height: 630,
};
export const contentType = 'image/png';
export const alt = 'Someplace Social Event Listing';
function truncateText(text: string, maxLen: number): string {
  const cleaned = text.trim();
  if (cleaned.length <= maxLen) return cleaned;
  return `${cleaned.slice(0, maxLen - 1).trimEnd()}…`;
}
export default async function EventOpenGraphImage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ city: string; event: string }>;
}) {
  const { city: citySlug, event: eventSlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  const events = city ? await getEvents(city, 3600) : [];
  const resolved = city ? resolveEventBySlug(events, eventSlug) : null;
  if (!city || !resolved) {
    return new ImageResponse(
      (
        <div
          style={{
            width: '100%',
            height: '100%',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            padding: '72px',
            backgroundColor: '#fff9ec',
            color: '#1f1b16',
            fontFamily: 'sans-serif',
          }}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              fontSize: 28,
              fontWeight: 700,
              color: '#1f7a4d',
              letterSpacing: '0.06em',
              textTransform: 'uppercase',
              marginBottom: 16,
            }}
          >
            Someplace Social
          </div>
          <div style={{ fontSize: 60, fontWeight: 800, lineHeight: 1.1 }}>
            Community Events &amp; Gatherings
          </div>
        </div>
      ),
      { ...size }
    );
  }
  const { event } = resolved;
  const titleText = truncateText(event.title, 78);
  const scheduleLine = truncateText(buildScheduleLine(event), 48);
  const venueName = (event.venue || event.location || '').trim();
  const areaName = (event.area || '').trim();
  const placeLine = truncateText(
    venueName && areaName && venueName.toLowerCase() !== areaName.toLowerCase()
      ? `${venueName} · ${areaName}`
      : venueName || areaName || city.heroLocation,
    50
  );
  const priceText = (event.price || '').trim();
  const freeHighlight = Boolean(priceText && isFreePrice(priceText));
  const eyebrowText = areaName
    ? `Someplace Social · ${city.name} · ${areaName}`
    : `Someplace Social · ${city.name}`;
  return new ImageResponse(
    (
      <div
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          height: '100%',
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          justifyContent: 'space-between',
          padding: '60px 68px',
          backgroundColor: '#fff9ec',
          color: '#1f1b16',
          fontFamily: 'sans-serif',
        }}
      >
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
            border: '2px solid #eadfc8',
            borderRadius: '28px',
            padding: '52px 56px',
            flex: 1,
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <div
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                fontSize: 22,
                fontWeight: 700,
                letterSpacing: '0.08em',
                textTransform: 'uppercase',
                color: '#1f7a4d',
                marginBottom: 24,
              }}
            >
              {eyebrowText}
            </div>
            <div
              style={{
                fontSize: titleText.length > 48 ? 52 : 62,
                fontWeight: 800,
                lineHeight: 1.1,
                letterSpacing: '-0.02em',
                color: '#1f1b16',
              }}
            >
              {titleText}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexWrap: 'wrap',
              gap: '14px',
              alignItems: 'center',
            }}
          >
            {scheduleLine && (
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  backgroundColor: '#f3ead4',
                  border: '1.5px solid #d6c8ad',
                  borderRadius: '14px',
                  padding: '12px 22px',
                  fontSize: 24,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  color: '#1f1b16',
                }}
              >
                {scheduleLine}
              </div>
            )}
            {placeLine && (
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  backgroundColor: '#faf4e6',
                  border: '1.5px solid #eadfc8',
                  borderRadius: '14px',
                  padding: '12px 22px',
                  fontSize: 24,
                  fontWeight: 600,
                  color: '#4f483e',
                }}
              >
                {placeLine}
              </div>
            )}
            {priceText && (
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  backgroundColor: freeHighlight ? '#e4f4ea' : '#f3ead4',
                  border: freeHighlight ? '1.5px solid #1f7a4d' : '1.5px solid #d6c8ad',
                  borderRadius: '14px',
                  padding: '12px 22px',
                  fontSize: 24,
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  color: freeHighlight ? '#1f7a4d' : '#1f1b16',
                }}
              >
                {priceText}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            alignItems: 'center',
            marginTop: '22px',
            paddingLeft: '8px',
            paddingRight: '8px',
            fontSize: 20,
            fontWeight: 600,
            color: '#6f675c',
          }}
        >
          <span>someplacesocial.org</span>
          <span>Weekly community events · Free &amp; ad-free</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    ),
    { ...size }
  );
}

================
File: app/[city]/events/[event]/page.tsx
================
import { notFound, redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import {
  SITE_URL,
  getAllCities,
  getCityBySlug,
  getCityTimeZone,
} from '../../../lib/cities';
import { getEvents } from '../../../lib/google-sheets';
import {
  buildEventJsonLd,
  buildEventMetaDescription,
  getEventSlug,
  getNextEventOccurrence,
  resolveEventBySlug,
} from '../../../events/event-helpers';
import EventDetailView from './EventDetailView';
export const revalidate = 3600;
type PageProps = {
  params: Promise<{ city: string; event: string }>;
};
export async function generateStaticParams() {
  const cities = getAllCities();
  const allParams = await Promise.all(
    cities.map(async (city) => {
      const events = await getEvents(city, 3600);
      return events.map((ev) => ({
        city: city.slug,
        event: getEventSlug(ev),
      }));
    })
  );
  return allParams.flat();
}
export async function generateMetadata({ params }: PageProps): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { city: citySlug, event: eventSlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    return {
      title: 'Event Not Found',
      robots: { index: false, follow: false },
    };
  }
  const events = await getEvents(city, 3600);
  const resolved = resolveEventBySlug(events, eventSlug);
  if (!resolved) {
    return {
      title: 'Event Not Found',
      robots: { index: false, follow: false },
    };
  }
  const { event, canonicalSlug } = resolved;
  const pageTitle = `${event.title} — ${city.name} Events`;
  const fullTitle = `${pageTitle} | Someplace Social`;
  const description = buildEventMetaDescription(event, city);
  const canonicalPath = `/${city.slug}/events/${canonicalSlug}`;
  return {
    title: pageTitle,
    description,
    alternates: {
      canonical: canonicalPath,
    },
    openGraph: {
      title: fullTitle,
      description,
      url: canonicalPath,
      siteName: 'Someplace Social',
      type: 'website',
    },
    twitter: {
      card: 'summary_large_image',
      title: fullTitle,
      description,
    },
    robots: {
      index: true,
      follow: true,
      googleBot: {
        index: true,
        follow: true,
      },
    },
  };
}
export default async function EventPage({ params }: PageProps) {
  const { city: citySlug, event: eventSlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    notFound();
  }
  const events = await getEvents(city, 3600);
  const resolved = resolveEventBySlug(events, eventSlug);
  if (!resolved) {
    notFound();
  }
  if (!resolved.isCanonical || city.slug !== citySlug) {
    redirect(`/${city.slug}/events/${resolved.canonicalSlug}`);
  }
  const { event, canonicalSlug } = resolved;
  const timeZone = getCityTimeZone(city);
  const nextOccurrence = getNextEventOccurrence(event, timeZone, 90);
  const canonicalUrl = `${SITE_URL}/${city.slug}/events/${canonicalSlug}`;
  const jsonLd = buildEventJsonLd(event, city, canonicalUrl, nextOccurrence);
  return (
    <>
      {jsonLd && (
        <script
          type="application/ld+json"
          dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{
            __html: JSON.stringify(jsonLd).replace(/</g, '\\u003c'),
          }}
        />
      )}
      <EventDetailView
        city={city}
        event={event}
        initialNextLabel={nextOccurrence?.label ?? null}
      />
    </>
  );
}

================
File: app/[city]/events/page.tsx
================
import { notFound, permanentRedirect } from 'next/navigation';
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { getCityBySlug, getAllCitySlugs } from '../../lib/cities';
import { getEvents, getLastUpdated } from '../../lib/google-sheets';
import CityEventsView from '../../events/CityEventsView';
export const revalidate = 60;
type PageProps = {
  params: Promise<{ city: string }>;
};
export async function generateStaticParams() {
  return getAllCitySlugs().map((city) => ({ city }));
}
export async function generateMetadata({ params }: PageProps): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { city: citySlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    return {
      title: 'City Not Found · Someplace Social',
      robots: { index: false, follow: false },
    };
  }
  const title = `${city.name} Events & Activities This Week`;
  const description = `Weekly community events, classes, and social activities in ${city.heroLocation}. Free and affordable group gatherings.`;
  return {
    title,
    description,
    alternates: {
      canonical: `/${city.slug}/events`,
    },
    openGraph: {
      title: `${title} | Someplace Social`,
      description,
      url: `/${city.slug}/events`,
      siteName: 'Someplace Social',
      type: 'website',
    },
    robots: {
      index: true,
      follow: true,
      googleBot: {
        index: true,
        follow: true,
      },
    },
  };
}
export default async function CityEventsPage({ params }: PageProps) {
  const { city: citySlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    notFound();
  }
  if (city.slug !== citySlug) {
    permanentRedirect(`/${city.slug}/events`);
  }
  const [events, lastUpdated] = await Promise.all([
    getEvents(city),
    getLastUpdated(city),
  ]);
  return (
    <CityEventsView
      city={city}
      initialEvents={events}
      lastUpdated={lastUpdated}
    />
  );
}

import { notFound, permanentRedirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getCityBySlug } from '../lib/cities';
type PageProps = {
  params: Promise<{ city: string }>;
};
export default async function CityRootPage({ params }: PageProps) {
  const { city: citySlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    notFound();
  }
  permanentRedirect(`/${city.slug}/events`);
}

================
File: app/api/send-form/route.ts
================
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { Resend } from 'resend';
const recipientEmail = process.env.EMAIL_RECIPIENT;
export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const apiKey = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;
    if (!apiKey) {
      throw new Error('Resend API key is not configured.');
    }
    if (!recipientEmail) {
      throw new Error('Recipient email is not configured.');
    }
    const resend = new Resend(apiKey);
    const body = await request.json();
    const { formType, message } = body;
    const { error } = await resend.emails.send({
      from: 'Someplace Social <onboarding@resend.dev>',
      to: recipientEmail,
      subject: `New Form Submission: ${formType}`,
      text: message,
    });
    if (error) {
      console.error('Resend error:', error);
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, message: 'Error sending email.' }, { status: 500 });
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, message: 'Form submitted successfully.' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error processing form:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, message: 'Server error.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

================
File: app/components/ContactForm.tsx
================
"use client";
import { useState } from 'react';
import styles from './ContactForm.module.css';
type ContactFormProps = {
  formType: string;
  fields: readonly { name: string; label: string; placeholder?: string; type: 'text' | 'email' | 'textarea'; required: boolean }[];
};
export default function ContactForm({ formType, fields }: ContactFormProps) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const handleSubmit = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setStatus('Submitting...');
    const formData = new FormData(event.currentTarget);
    let message = '';
    formData.forEach((value, key) => {
      message += `${key}: ${value}\n`;
    });
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/send-form', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ formType, message }),
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (result.success) {
        setStatus('Message sent successfully!');
        (event.target as HTMLFormElement).reset();
      } else {
        setStatus('Failed to send message. Please try again.');
      }
    } catch {
      setStatus('An error occurred. Please try again.');
    }
  };
  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className={styles.form}>
      {fields.map(field => (
        <div key={field.name} className={styles.field}>
          <label htmlFor={field.name}>{field.label}</label>
          {field.type === 'textarea' ? (
            <textarea
              id={field.name}
              name={field.name}
              required={field.required}
              placeholder={field.placeholder || ''}
              className={styles.textarea}
            />
          ) : (
            <input
              type={field.type}
              id={field.name}
              name={field.name}
              required={field.required}
              placeholder={field.placeholder || ''}
              className={styles.input}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
      <button type="submit" className={styles.button}>Send Message</button>
      {status && <p>{status}</p>}
    </form>
  );
}

File: app/components/ThemeScript.tsx

'use client';
import { useRef } from 'react';
import { useServerInsertedHTML } from 'next/navigation';
const THEME_INIT_SCRIPT = `(function(){try{var t=localStorage.getItem('theme');if(t==='dark'||(!t&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme:dark)').matches)){document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme','dark');}else{document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme','light');}}catch(e){}})();`;
export default function ThemeScript() {
  const insertedRef = useRef(false);
  useServerInsertedHTML(() => {
    if (insertedRef.current) return null;
    insertedRef.current = true;
    return (
      <script
        id="theme-init"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: THEME_INIT_SCRIPT }}
      />
    );
  });
  return null;
}

================
File: app/events/calendar-helpers.test.ts
================
import { describe, it } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { CITIES } from '../lib/cities';
import {
  buildGoogleCalendarUrl,
  buildIcsContent,
  foldIcsLine,
  getIcsFilename,
  resolveCalendarOccurrence,
  zonedLocalToUtc,
} from './calendar-helpers';
import { makeEvent } from './test-fixtures';

const jan2Fri = new Date(2026, 0, 2);

describe('calendar helpers (Google Calendar, ICS & copy summary)', () => {
  it('builds a clean single-occurrence Google Calendar URL, upgrades short-form contact URLs, and omits evidence notes', () => {
    const ev = makeEvent({
      id: 'MED014',
      title: 'Verb & Vibe Game Nite',
      venue: 'Café Revolución',
      location: 'Cra. 37 #8A-37',
      area: 'Laureles',
      organization: 'Language Friends',
      startTime: '7:00 PM',
      endTime: '9:30 PM',
      frequency: 'Weekly',
      price: 'Free',
      preRegistration: 'RSVP recommended',
      registrationUrl: 'lu.ma/verb-vibe',
      contact: 'hello@verbvibe.com',
      map: 'maps.app.goo.gl/abc123',
      about: 'Practice Spanish and English with board games.',
      url1: 'instagram.com/p/public-link',
      url1Notes: 'secret-verification-note',
      url2: 'meetup.com/group',
      url2Notes: 'secret-url2-note',
      database: 'Medellin Sheet Row 44',
      activities: ['Games', 'Language exchange'],
    });
    const details = resolveCalendarOccurrence(
      ev,
      CITIES['medellin-colombia'],
      jan2Fri
    );
    assert.ok(details);
    assert.equal(details.location, 'Café Revolución, Cra. 37 #8A-37, Medellín, Colombia');
    assert.equal(
      details.copySummary,
      'Fri, Jan 2 7p–9:30p: Verb & Vibe Game Nite at Café Revolución'
    );

    const url = new URL(buildGoogleCalendarUrl(details));
    assert.equal(url.origin + url.pathname, 'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render');
    assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('action'), 'TEMPLATE');
    assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('text'), 'Verb & Vibe Game Nite');
    assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('dates'), '20260102T190000/20260102T213000');
    assert.equal(url.searchParams.get('ctz'), 'America/Bogota');
    assert.equal(
      url.searchParams.get('location'),
      'Café Revolución, Cra. 37 #8A-37, Medellín, Colombia'
    );

    const desc = url.searchParams.get('details') || '';
    assert.equal(desc.includes('Practice Spanish and English with board games.'), true);
    assert.equal(desc.includes('Price: Free'), true);
    assert.equal(desc.includes('RSVP: RSVP recommended (https://lu.ma/verb-vibe)'), true);
    assert.equal(desc.includes('Schedule: Weekly'), true);
    assert.equal(desc.includes('Hosted by: Language Friends'), true);
    assert.equal(desc.includes('Contact: hello@verbvibe.com'), true);
    assert.equal(desc.includes('Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/abc123'), true);
    assert.equal(
      desc.includes(
        'Event info: https://www.someplacesocial.org/medellin-colombia/events/verb-vibe-game-nite-med014'
      ),
      true
    );
    assert.equal(desc.includes('secret-verification-note'), false);
    assert.equal(desc.includes('secret-url2-note'), false);
    assert.equal(desc.includes('Medellin Sheet Row 44'), false);
    assert.equal(desc.includes('MED014'), false);

    const urlContactDetails = resolveCalendarOccurrence(
      makeEvent({
        id: 'MED015',
        title: 'WhatsApp Club',
        contact: 'wa.me/573001234567',
      }),
      CITIES['medellin-colombia'],
      jan2Fri
    );
    assert.ok(urlContactDetails);
    assert.equal(
      urlContactDetails.description.includes('Contact: https://wa.me/573001234567'),
      true
    );
  });

  it('handles missing endTime (+1h default), overnight rollover, all-day events, missing venue, and duplicate venue in title', () => {
    const noEnd = resolveCalendarOccurrence(
      makeEvent({
        title: 'Trivia at Maxline Brewing',
        venue: 'Maxline Brewing',
        location: '2724 McClelland Dr, Fort Collins, CO',
        startTime: '7:00 PM',
        endTime: '',
      }),
      CITIES['fort-collins-colorado'],
      jan2Fri
    );
    assert.ok(noEnd);
    assert.equal(noEnd.location, 'Maxline Brewing, 2724 McClelland Dr, Fort Collins, CO');
    assert.equal(noEnd.copySummary, 'Fri, Jan 2 7p: Trivia at Maxline Brewing');
    assert.deepEqual(noEnd.startLocal, { year: 2026, month: 1, day: 2, hour: 19, minute: 0 });
    assert.deepEqual(noEnd.endLocal, { year: 2026, month: 1, day: 2, hour: 20, minute: 0 });

    const overnight = resolveCalendarOccurrence(
      makeEvent({ startTime: '9:00 PM', endTime: '1:00 AM' }),
      CITIES['medellin-colombia'],
      jan2Fri
    );
    assert.ok(overnight);
    assert.deepEqual(overnight.endLocal, { year: 2026, month: 1, day: 3, hour: 1, minute: 0 });

    const allDay = resolveCalendarOccurrence(
      makeEvent({ title: 'Park Day', startTime: '', endTime: '', venue: '', location: '', area: '' }),
      CITIES['fort-collins-colorado'],
      jan2Fri
    );
    assert.ok(allDay);
    assert.equal(allDay.isAllDay, true);
    assert.equal(allDay.copySummary, 'Fri, Jan 2: Park Day');
    const allDayUrl = new URL(buildGoogleCalendarUrl(allDay));
    assert.equal(allDayUrl.searchParams.get('dates'), '20260102/20260103');

    const paused = resolveCalendarOccurrence(
      makeEvent({ frequency: 'Weekly', frequencyNotes: 'Paused' }),
      CITIES['medellin-colombia']
    );
    assert.equal(paused, null);
  });

  it('converts local wall times accurately to UTC across Bogota and Denver standard/DST dates', () => {
    const bogotaUtc = zonedLocalToUtc(
      { year: 2026, month: 1, day: 2, hour: 19, minute: 0 },
      'America/Bogota'
    );
    assert.equal(bogotaUtc.toISOString(), '2026-01-03T00:00:00.000Z');

    const denverWinterUtc = zonedLocalToUtc(
      { year: 2026, month: 1, day: 2, hour: 19, minute: 0 },
      'America/Denver'
    );
    assert.equal(denverWinterUtc.toISOString(), '2026-01-03T02:00:00.000Z');

    const denverSummerUtc = zonedLocalToUtc(
      { year: 2026, month: 7, day: 10, hour: 19, minute: 0 },
      'America/Denver'
    );
    assert.equal(denverSummerUtc.toISOString(), '2026-07-11T01:00:00.000Z');
  });

  it('generates RFC 5545 compliant ICS content with escaping, CRLF endings, UTC times, and UTF-8 safe folding', () => {
    const ev = makeEvent({
      id: '14',
      title: 'Salsa, Bachata; & Café Night',
      venue: 'Café Revolución',
      location: 'Cra. 37 #8A-37',
      startTime: '7:00 PM',
      endTime: '9:00 PM',
      about: 'Bring friends, water;\nMeet upstairs in Medellín.',
    });
    const details = resolveCalendarOccurrence(
      ev,
      CITIES['medellin-colombia'],
      jan2Fri
    );
    assert.ok(details);
    assert.equal(getIcsFilename(details), 'salsa-bachata-cafe-night-2026-01-02.ics');

    const ics = buildIcsContent(details, new Date('2026-01-01T12:00:00Z'));
    assert.equal(ics.endsWith('\r\n'), true);
    assert.equal(ics.includes('RRULE'), false);
    assert.equal(ics.includes('DTSTART:20260103T000000Z'), true);
    assert.equal(ics.includes('DTEND:20260103T020000Z'), true);
    assert.equal(ics.includes('SUMMARY:Salsa\\, Bachata\\; & Café Night'), true);
    assert.equal(ics.includes('Bring friends\\, water\\;\\nMeet upstairs in Medellín.'), true);

    const folded = foldIcsLine(
      `DESCRIPTION:${'Medellín '.repeat(15)}`
    );
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    for (const part of folded.split('\r\n')) {
      assert.equal(encoder.encode(part).length <= 75, true);
    }

    const allDayDetails = resolveCalendarOccurrence(
      makeEvent({ id: '99', title: 'Park Day', startTime: '', endTime: '' }),
      CITIES['fort-collins-colorado'],
      jan2Fri
    );
    assert.ok(allDayDetails);
    const allDayIcs = buildIcsContent(allDayDetails, new Date('2026-01-01T12:00:00Z'));
    assert.equal(allDayIcs.includes('DTSTART;VALUE=DATE:20260102'), true);
    assert.equal(allDayIcs.includes('DTEND;VALUE=DATE:20260103'), true);
  });
});

File: app/events/components/DayPicker.tsx

'use client';
import { memo } from 'react';
import styles from '../EventsView.module.css';

const DAY_NAMES_SHORT = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'];

interface DayPickerProps {
  rollingWeek: Date[];
  activeDayIdx: number;
  onSelectDay: (idx: number) => void;
  dayCounts?: number[];
  getEventCountForDay?: (idx: number) => number;
}

function DayPicker({
  rollingWeek,
  activeDayIdx,
  onSelectDay,
  dayCounts,
  getEventCountForDay,
}: DayPickerProps) {
  const getCount = (idx: number) => {
    if (dayCounts && dayCounts[idx] !== undefined) {
      return dayCounts[idx];
    }
    return getEventCountForDay ? getEventCountForDay(idx) : 0;
  };

  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.dayListVertical} role="group" aria-label="Day list">
        {rollingWeek.map((day, idx) => {
          const label =
            idx === 0
              ? 'Today'
              : `${DAY_NAMES_SHORT[day.getDay()]} ${day.getDate()}`;
          const count = getCount(idx);
          const isSelected = idx === activeDayIdx;
          return (
            <button
              key={idx}
              type="button"
              className={`${styles.dayBtnVertical} ${
                isSelected ? styles.dayBtnVerticalActive : ''
              }`}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              onClick={() => onSelectDay(idx)}
            >
              <span>{label}</span>
              <span
                className={`${styles.dayCountText} ${
                  isSelected ? styles.dayCountTextActive : ''
                }`}
              >
                {count} events
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.mobileDaysGrid} role="group" aria-label="Pick day">
        {rollingWeek.map((day, idx) => {
          const dayShort = idx === 0 ? 'Today' : DAY_NAMES_SHORT[day.getDay()];
          const count = getCount(idx);
          const isSelected = idx === activeDayIdx;
          return (
            <button
              key={idx}
              type="button"
              className={`${styles.mobileDayBtn} ${
                isSelected ? styles.mobileDayBtnActive : ''
              }`}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              onClick={() => onSelectDay(idx)}
            >
              <span
                className={`${styles.mobileDayLabel} ${
                  isSelected ? styles.mobileDayLabelActive : ''
                }`}
              >
                {dayShort}
              </span>
              <span className={styles.mobileDayNum}>{day.getDate()}</span>
              <span
                className={`${styles.mobileDayCount} ${
                  isSelected ? styles.mobileDayCountActive : ''
                }`}
              >
                {count}
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

export default memo(DayPicker);

File: app/events/components/EventFacts.tsx
================
'use client';
import {
  CheckIcon,
  ExternalLinkIcon,
  PenIcon,
  RepeatIcon,
} from './EventIcons';
import styles from './EventFacts.module.css';

interface EventFactsProps {
  recurrenceText: string;
  preRegistrationText: string;
  registrationUrl: string;
  needsSignupIcon: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export default function EventFacts({
  recurrenceText,
  preRegistrationText,
  registrationUrl,
  needsSignupIcon,
  className,
}: EventFactsProps) {
  if (!recurrenceText && !preRegistrationText) {
    return null;
  }
  const signupIcon = needsSignupIcon ? (
    <PenIcon className={styles.factIcon} />
  ) : (
    <CheckIcon className={styles.factIcon} />
  );
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.facts} ${className || ''}`}>
      {recurrenceText && (
        <span className={styles.fact}>
          <RepeatIcon className={styles.factIcon} />
          <span>{recurrenceText}</span>
        </span>
      )}
      {preRegistrationText &&
        (registrationUrl ? (
          <a
            href={registrationUrl}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className={`${styles.fact} ${styles.factLink}`}
          >
            {signupIcon}
            <span className={styles.factLinkText}>{preRegistrationText}</span>
            <ExternalLinkIcon className={styles.factExternalIcon} />
          </a>
        ) : (
          <span className={styles.fact}>
            {signupIcon}
            <span>{preRegistrationText}</span>
          </span>
        ))}
    </div>
  );
}

================

.link {
  display: inline;
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
  text-decoration-thickness: 1.5px;
  text-decoration-color: var(--line-strong);
  transition: color 0.15s ease, text-decoration-color 0.15s ease;
}

.link:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
  text-decoration-color: var(--accent);
}

.link:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ink);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}

  display: inline-block;
  width: 11.5px;
  height: 11.5px;

================
File: app/events/components/InlineExternalLink.tsx

'use client';
import { ExternalLinkIcon } from './EventIcons';
import styles from './InlineExternalLink.module.css';

interface InlineExternalLinkProps {
  href?: string;
  children: string;
  className?: string;
}

export default function InlineExternalLink({
  href,
  children,
  className,
}: InlineExternalLinkProps) {
  if (!href) {
    return <span className={className}>{children}</span>;
  }
  return (
    <a
      href={href}
      target="_blank"
      rel="noopener noreferrer"
      className={`${styles.link} ${className || ''}`}
    >
      <span>{children}</span>
      <ExternalLinkIcon className={styles.icon} />
    </a>
  );
}

import { describe, it } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { CITIES } from '../lib/cities';
import { ensureExternalUrl } from './utils';
import {
  normalizeContactText,
  parseContactWithLinks,
  parseTextWithLinks,
} from './linkify';
import {
  slugifyText,
  getEventSlug,
  resolveEventBySlug,
  getNextEventOccurrence,
  buildEventInviteText,
  buildEventJsonLd,
  getEventDisplayDetails,
  buildProveItSources,
} from './event-helpers';
import { makeEvent } from './test-fixtures';

describe('slug generation and event resolution', () => {
  it('strips accents, emojis, punctuation, and formats clean slugs', () => {
    assert.equal(slugifyText("Café & Español! 🎉 Game's Nite"), 'cafe-espanol-games-nite');
    assert.equal(
      getEventSlug(makeEvent({ id: '14', title: 'Verb & Vibe Game Nite' })),
      'verb-vibe-game-nite-14'
    );
    assert.equal(
      getEventSlug(makeEvent({ id: '', title: 'Café Revolución Meetup' })),
      'cafe-revolucion-meetup'
    );
    assert.equal(getEventSlug(makeEvent({ id: '9', title: '🎉✨' })), 'event-9');
  });
  it('resolves exact, renamed-title ID, bare ID, missing-ID fallback, split IDs, and rejects deleted IDs', () => {
    const events = [
      makeEvent({ id: '14', title: 'Verb & Vibe Game Nite' }),
      makeEvent({ id: '', title: 'Open Air Sketching' }),
      makeEvent({ id: 'FOCO0024-mon', title: 'Weekly Karaoke Night', dayOfWeek: 'Mon' }),
      makeEvent({ id: 'FOCO0024-wed', title: 'Weekly Karaoke Night', dayOfWeek: 'Wed' }),
    ];
    const exact = resolveEventBySlug(events, 'verb-vibe-game-nite-14');
    assert.ok(exact);
    assert.equal(exact.event.id, '14');
    assert.equal(exact.isCanonical, true);
    const renamed = resolveEventBySlug(events, 'old-title-here-14');
    assert.ok(renamed);
    assert.equal(renamed.event.id, '14');
    assert.equal(renamed.canonicalSlug, 'verb-vibe-game-nite-14');
    assert.equal(renamed.isCanonical, false);
    const bareId = resolveEventBySlug(events, '14');
    assert.ok(bareId);
    assert.equal(bareId.event.id, '14');
    assert.equal(bareId.isCanonical, false);
    const splitWed = resolveEventBySlug(events, 'weekly-karaoke-night-foco0024-wed');
    assert.ok(splitWed);
    assert.equal(splitWed.event.id, 'FOCO0024-wed');
    assert.equal(splitWed.isCanonical, true);
    const legacyUnsplit = resolveEventBySlug(events, 'weekly-karaoke-night-foco0024');
    assert.ok(legacyUnsplit);
    assert.equal(legacyUnsplit.event.id, 'FOCO0024-mon');
    assert.equal(legacyUnsplit.canonicalSlug, 'weekly-karaoke-night-foco0024-mon');
    assert.equal(legacyUnsplit.isCanonical, false);
    const missingId = resolveEventBySlug(events, 'open-air-sketching');
    assert.ok(missingId);
    assert.equal(missingId.event.title, 'Open Air Sketching');
    assert.equal(missingId.isCanonical, true);
    const deletedId = resolveEventBySlug(events, 'verb-vibe-game-nite-999');
    assert.equal(deletedId, null);
  });
});

describe('next occurrence, invite text, and JSON-LD', () => {
  it('finds next occurrence beyond 7 days for monthly events and omits paused events', () => {
    const monthlyEv = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Monthly',
      frequencyNotes: '1st Fri',
      dayOfWeek: 'Fri',
    });
    const occ = getNextEventOccurrence(monthlyEv, 'America/Bogota', 90, new Date('2026-01-10T15:00:00Z'));
    assert.ok(occ);
    assert.equal(occ.date.getMonth(), 1);
    assert.equal(occ.date.getDate(), 6);
    assert.equal(occ.label.startsWith('Next: '), true);
    const pausedEv = makeEvent({ frequency: 'Weekly', frequencyNotes: 'Paused' });
    assert.equal(
      getNextEventOccurrence(pausedEv, 'America/Bogota', 90, new Date('2026-01-10T15:00:00Z')),
      null
    );
  });
  it('builds formatted invite text skipping missing fields cleanly', () => {
    const fullEv = makeEvent({
      id: '14',
      title: 'Verb & Vibe Game Nite',
      dayOfWeek: 'Fri',
      startTime: '7:00 PM',
      endTime: '9:30 PM',
      venue: 'Café Revolución',
      area: 'Laureles',
      price: 'Free',
    });
    assert.equal(
      buildEventInviteText(fullEv, 'medellin-colombia'),
      'Verb & Vibe Game Nite\nFri · 7p – 9:30p\nCafé Revolución (Laureles) · Free\nhttps://www.someplacesocial.org/medellin-colombia/events/verb-vibe-game-nite-14'
    );
    const sparseEv = makeEvent({
      id: '2',
      title: 'Mystery Gathering',
      dayOfWeek: '',
      frequency: '',
      startTime: '',
      endTime: '',
      venue: '',
      location: '',
      area: '',
      price: '',
    });
    assert.equal(
      buildEventInviteText(sparseEv, 'fort-collins-colorado'),
      'Mystery Gathering\nhttps://www.someplacesocial.org/fort-collins-colorado/events/mystery-gathering-2'
    );
  });
  it('builds valid schema.org/Event JSON-LD including venue, organizer, and registration URLs', () => {
    const ev = makeEvent({
      id: '14',
      title: 'Salsa Night',
      venue: 'Son Havana',
      venueUrl: 'sonhavana.com',
      organization: 'Medellín Salsa Collective',
      organizerUrl: 'instagram.com/medellinsalsa',
      registrationUrl: 'eventbrite.com/e/salsa-14',
      location: 'Cra 73 #44-56',
      price: 'Free',
      startTime: '8:00 PM',
      endTime: '11:00 PM',
    });
    const occ = getNextEventOccurrence(ev, 'America/Bogota', 90, new Date('2026-01-02T15:00:00Z'));
    const ld = buildEventJsonLd(
      ev,
      CITIES['medellin-colombia'],
      'https://www.someplacesocial.org/medellin-colombia/events/salsa-night-14',
      occ
    ) as Record<string, unknown>;
    assert.ok(ld);
    assert.equal(ld['@type'], 'Event');
    assert.equal(ld['eventAttendanceMode'], 'https://schema.org/OfflineEventAttendanceMode');
    assert.equal(String(ld['startDate']).startsWith('2026-01-02T20:00:00'), true);
    assert.equal((ld['location'] as Record<string, unknown>)['url'], 'https://sonhavana.com');
    assert.equal(
      (ld['organizer'] as Record<string, unknown>)['url'],
      'https://instagram.com/medellinsalsa'
    );
    assert.equal(
      (ld['offers'] as Record<string, unknown>)['url'],
      'https://eventbrite.com/e/salsa-14'
    );
  });
});

describe('getEventDisplayDetails & URL normalization', () => {
  it('prepends https:// across short-form Organizer, Venue, Registration, Map, and URL1 while preserving query strings', () => {
    const linked = getEventDisplayDetails(
      makeEvent({
        venue: 'Maxline Brewing',
        venueUrl: 'maxlinebrewing.com',
        organization: 'Hosted by Geeks Who Drink',
        organizerUrl: 'instagram.com/geekswhodrink',
        preRegistration: 'Registration required.',
        registrationUrl: 'geekswhodrink.com/register?city=foco',
        map: 'maps.app.goo.gl/abc123',
        url1: 'instagram.com/p/DfV0gzJjq-e/?img_index=2',
      }),
      'Fort Collins'
    );
    assert.equal(linked.displayVenue, 'Maxline Brewing');
    assert.equal(linked.venueUrl, 'https://maxlinebrewing.com');
    assert.equal(linked.organizerName, 'Geeks Who Drink');
    assert.equal(linked.organizerUrl, 'https://instagram.com/geekswhodrink');
    assert.equal(linked.showOrganizer, true);
    assert.equal(linked.preRegistrationText, 'Registration required.');
    assert.equal(linked.registrationUrl, 'https://geekswhodrink.com/register?city=foco');
    assert.equal(linked.mapsHref, 'https://maps.app.goo.gl/abc123');
    assert.equal(linked.moreDetailsUrl, 'https://instagram.com/p/DfV0gzJjq-e/?img_index=2');
    assert.equal(linked.needsSignupIcon, true);

    const blankAndUnsafe = getEventDisplayDetails(
      makeEvent({
        venue: 'City Park',
        venueUrl: 'javascript:alert(1)',
        organization: '',
        organizerUrl: '',
        preRegistration: 'Drop-in (no RSVP needed)',
        registrationUrl: '',
        url1: '',
      }),
      'Fort Collins'
    );
    assert.equal(blankAndUnsafe.venueUrl, '');
    assert.equal(blankAndUnsafe.showOrganizer, false);
    assert.equal(blankAndUnsafe.registrationUrl, '');
    assert.equal(blankAndUnsafe.moreDetailsUrl, '');
    assert.equal(blankAndUnsafe.needsSignupIcon, false);
    assert.equal(ensureExternalUrl('//example.com/events?img_index=3'), 'https://example.com/events?img_index=3');
    assert.equal(ensureExternalUrl('x'), '');
  });
});

describe('buildProveItSources', () => {
  it('builds Listed at + Also, at entries with https:// hrefs, query strings intact, and notes', () => {
    const both = buildProveItSources({
      url1: 'maxlinebrewing.com/whats-happening',
      url1Notes: 'Click on the "Community Events" tab',
      url2: 'instagram.com/p/DfV0gzJjq-e/?img_index=2',
      url2Notes: 'Check slide 2 for times',
    });
    assert.deepEqual(both, [
      {
        prefix: 'Listed at ',
        url: 'maxlinebrewing.com/whats-happening',
        href: 'https://maxlinebrewing.com/whats-happening',
        notes: 'Click on the "Community Events" tab',
      },
      {
        prefix: 'Also, at ',
        url: 'instagram.com/p/DfV0gzJjq-e/?img_index=2',
        href: 'https://instagram.com/p/DfV0gzJjq-e/?img_index=2',
        notes: 'Check slide 2 for times',
      },
    ]);
  });

  it('shows only the first line when URL2 is blank and ignores stray URL2 Notes', () => {
    const firstOnly = buildProveItSources({
      url1: 'comedyfortcollins.com/events/142205?img_index=1',
      url1Notes: 'Click on "Biography" link',
      url2: '',
      url2Notes: 'Ignored note when URL2 is empty',
    });
    assert.deepEqual(firstOnly, [
      {
        prefix: 'Listed at ',
        url: 'comedyfortcollins.com/events/142205?img_index=1',
        href: 'https://comedyfortcollins.com/events/142205?img_index=1',
        notes: 'Click on "Biography" link',
      },
    ]);
  });

  it('returns empty array when both URL1 and URL2 are blank, x, or unsafe', () => {
    assert.deepEqual(
      buildProveItSources({ url1: '', url1Notes: 'orphan', url2: '', url2Notes: '' }),
      []
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      buildProveItSources({ url1: 'x', url1Notes: '', url2: '  ', url2Notes: '' }),
      []
    );
    assert.deepEqual(
      buildProveItSources({ url1: 'javascript:alert(1)', url1Notes: '', url2: '', url2Notes: '' }),
      []
    );
  });

  it('promotes URL2 to Listed at when URL1 is blank and URL2 is filled', () => {
    const secondOnly = buildProveItSources({
      url1: '',
      url1Notes: '',
      url2: 'instagram.com/p/DfiPohTlspn/?img_index=4',
      url2Notes: 'Carousel slide 4',
    });
    assert.deepEqual(secondOnly, [
      {
        prefix: 'Listed at ',
        url: 'instagram.com/p/DfiPohTlspn/?img_index=4',
        href: 'https://instagram.com/p/DfiPohTlspn/?img_index=4',
        notes: 'Carousel slide 4',
      },
    ]);
  });
});

describe('linkify Contact and URL text', () => {
  it('normalizes empty and x placeholder values', () => {
    assert.equal(normalizeContactText(''), '');
    assert.equal(normalizeContactText('   '), '');
    assert.equal(normalizeContactText('x'), '');
    assert.equal(normalizeContactText('X'), '');
    assert.equal(normalizeContactText('  info@venue.com  '), 'info@venue.com');
  });
  it('links bare URLs, protocols, emails, query params, multi-part TLDs, curly quotes, and ignores non-URLs', () => {
    const mixed = parseTextWithLinks(
      '(See https://www.example.com/events?id=1, or maxlinebrewing.com.) Email info@venue.com at 7:30 p.m. e.g. $12.50.'
    );
    assert.deepEqual(mixed, [
      { type: 'text', text: '(See ' },
      {
        type: 'link',
        text: 'https://www.example.com/events?id=1',
        href: 'https://www.example.com/events?id=1',
      },
      { type: 'text', text: ', or ' },
      {
        type: 'link',
        text: 'maxlinebrewing.com',
        href: 'https://maxlinebrewing.com',
      },
      { type: 'text', text: '.) Email ' },
      {
        type: 'link',
        text: 'info@venue.com',
        href: 'mailto:info@venue.com',
      },
      { type: 'text', text: ' at 7:30 p.m. e.g. $12.50.' },
    ]);
    const extra = parseTextWithLinks(
      'Check “sub.example.com.co” and maxlinebrewing.com?tab=events.'
    );
    assert.deepEqual(extra, [
      { type: 'text', text: 'Check “' },
      {
        type: 'link',
        text: 'sub.example.com.co',
        href: 'https://sub.example.com.co',
      },
      { type: 'text', text: '” and ' },
      {
        type: 'link',
        text: 'maxlinebrewing.com?tab=events',
        href: 'https://maxlinebrewing.com?tab=events',
      },
      { type: 'text', text: '.' },
    ]);
    const wiki = parseTextWithLinks('Look at en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pub_quiz_(game).');
    assert.deepEqual(wiki, [
      { type: 'text', text: 'Look at ' },
      {
        type: 'link',
        text: 'en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pub_quiz_(game)',
        href: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pub_quiz_(game)',
      },
      { type: 'text', text: '.' },
    ]);
    const unsafe = parseTextWithLinks('Try javascript:alert(1) or javascript:evil.com');
    assert.deepEqual(unsafe, [
      { type: 'text', text: 'Try javascript:alert(1) or javascript:evil.com' },
    ]);
  });
  it('links emails, short-form contact URLs across TLDs, phone numbers, and mixed contact strings safely', () => {
    assert.deepEqual(parseContactWithLinks('x'), []);
    assert.deepEqual(parseContactWithLinks('mailto:hello@venue.com'), [
      { type: 'link', text: 'hello@venue.com', href: 'mailto:hello@venue.com' },
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(parseContactWithLinks('venue.com/contact?ref=1'), [
      { type: 'link', text: 'venue.com/contact?ref=1', href: 'https://venue.com/contact?ref=1' },
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(parseContactWithLinks('lu.ma'), [
      { type: 'link', text: 'lu.ma', href: 'https://lu.ma' },
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(parseContactWithLinks('someclub.photography'), [
      { type: 'link', text: 'someclub.photography', href: 'https://someclub.photography' },
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(parseContactWithLinks('wa.me/573001234567'), [
      { type: 'link', text: 'wa.me/573001234567', href: 'https://wa.me/573001234567' },
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(parseContactWithLinks('tel:+1-970-555-1234'), [
      { type: 'link', text: '+1-970-555-1234', href: 'tel:+19705551234' },
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(
      parseContactWithLinks('WhatsApp +57 300 123 4567 or info@venue.com'),
      [
        { type: 'text', text: 'WhatsApp ' },
        { type: 'link', text: '+57 300 123 4567', href: 'tel:+573001234567' },
        { type: 'text', text: ' or ' },
        { type: 'link', text: 'info@venue.com', href: 'mailto:info@venue.com' },
      ]
    );
    assert.deepEqual(parseContactWithLinks('(970) 555-1234'), [
      { type: 'link', text: '(970) 555-1234', href: 'tel:9705551234' },
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(parseContactWithLinks('https://wa.me/573001234567'), [
      { type: 'link', text: 'https://wa.me/573001234567', href: 'https://wa.me/573001234567' },
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(parseContactWithLinks('DM @club on Instagram'), [
      { type: 'text', text: 'DM @club on Instagram' },
    ]);
    assert.deepEqual(parseContactWithLinks('Updated 2026-01-15'), [
      { type: 'text', text: 'Updated 2026-01-15' },
    ]);
  });
});

================
File: app/events/schedule-splitter.ts
================
import type { Event } from '../lib/google-sheets';

const ORDERED_DAYS = ['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'] as const;
const DAILY_DAYS = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'] as const;

const DAY_TOKEN_TO_SHORT: Record<string, string> = {
  sun: 'Sun',
  sunday: 'Sun',
  sundays: 'Sun',
  mon: 'Mon',
  monday: 'Mon',
  mondays: 'Mon',
  tue: 'Tue',
  tues: 'Tue',
  tuesday: 'Tue',
  tuesdays: 'Tue',
  wed: 'Wed',
  weds: 'Wed',
  wednesday: 'Wed',
  wednesdays: 'Wed',
  thu: 'Thu',
  thur: 'Thu',
  thurs: 'Thu',
  thursday: 'Thu',
  thursdays: 'Thu',
  fri: 'Fri',
  friday: 'Fri',
  fridays: 'Fri',
  sat: 'Sat',
  saturday: 'Sat',
  saturdays: 'Sat',
};

type ScheduleSpec = {
  isDayMapped: boolean;
  byDay: Map<string, string>;
  unlabeled: string[];
};

function expandDayRange(startDay: string, endDay: string): string[] | null {
  const startIdx = ORDERED_DAYS.indexOf(startDay as (typeof ORDERED_DAYS)[number]);
  const endIdx = ORDERED_DAYS.indexOf(endDay as (typeof ORDERED_DAYS)[number]);
  if (startIdx === -1 || endIdx === -1) return null;
  const result: string[] = [];
  if (startIdx <= endIdx) {
    for (let i = startIdx; i <= endIdx; i++) {
      result.push(ORDERED_DAYS[i]);
    }
  } else {
    for (let i = startIdx; i < ORDERED_DAYS.length; i++) {
      result.push(ORDERED_DAYS[i]);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i <= endIdx; i++) {
      result.push(ORDERED_DAYS[i]);
    }
  }
  return result;
}

function parseDaysExpression(expr: string): string[] | null {
  const trimmed = (expr || '').trim();
  if (!trimmed) return null;
  const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  if (lower === 'daily' || lower === 'everyday' || lower === 'every day') {
    return [...DAILY_DAYS];
  }
  const parts = trimmed
    .split(/\s*(?:,|&|\band\b)\s*/i)
    .map((p) => p.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 0) return null;
  const days: string[] = [];
  for (const part of parts) {
    const rangeMatch = part.match(/^([a-zA-Z]+)\s*(?:[\u2013\u2014\-]|\bto\b)\s*([a-zA-Z]+)$/i);
    if (rangeMatch) {
      const startShort = DAY_TOKEN_TO_SHORT[rangeMatch[1].toLowerCase()];
      const endShort = DAY_TOKEN_TO_SHORT[rangeMatch[2].toLowerCase()];
      if (!startShort || !endShort) return null;
      const expanded = expandDayRange(startShort, endShort);
      if (!expanded) return null;
      for (const d of expanded) {
        if (!days.includes(d)) days.push(d);
      }
      continue;
    }
    const short = DAY_TOKEN_TO_SHORT[part.toLowerCase()];
    if (!short) return null;
    if (!days.includes(short)) {
      days.push(short);
    }
  }
  return days.length > 0 ? days : null;
}

function splitOutsideParens(input: string, delimiters: Set<string>): string[] {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  let current = '';
  let depth = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < input.length; i++) {
    const ch = input[i];
    if (ch === '(') {
      depth++;
      current += ch;
    } else if (ch === ')') {
      depth = Math.max(0, depth - 1);
      current += ch;
    } else if (depth === 0 && delimiters.has(ch)) {
      const trimmed = current.trim();
      if (trimmed) parts.push(trimmed);
      current = '';
    } else {
      current += ch;
    }
  }
  const tail = current.trim();
  if (tail) parts.push(tail);
  return parts;
}

function isTimeLike(str: string): boolean {
  return /^\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?|a|p)?$/i.test(str.trim());
}

function segmentHasDayAnnotation(seg: string): boolean {
  const parenMatch = seg.match(/\(([^)]+)\)/);
  if (parenMatch && parseDaysExpression(parenMatch[1])) {
    return true;
  }
  const colonMatch = seg.match(/^(.+?)\s*:\s*(.+)$/);
  if (colonMatch && parseDaysExpression(colonMatch[1]) && /\d/.test(colonMatch[2])) {
    return true;
  }
  const leadMatch = seg.match(
    /^([a-zA-Z,\s&/-]+?)\s+(\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?|a|p)?)$/i
  );
  if (leadMatch && parseDaysExpression(leadMatch[1])) {
    return true;
  }
  const trailMatch = seg.match(
    /^(\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?|a|p)?)\s+([a-zA-Z,\s&/-]+)$/i
  );
  if (trailMatch && parseDaysExpression(trailMatch[2])) {
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function parseScheduleSpec(raw: string): ScheduleSpec {
  const trimmed = (raw || '').trim();
  const byDay = new Map<string, string>();
  const unlabeled: string[] = [];
  if (!trimmed) {
    return { isDayMapped: false, byDay, unlabeled };
  }
  const primaryChunks = splitOutsideParens(trimmed, new Set(['/', ';', '|']));
  const segments: string[] = [];
  for (const chunk of primaryChunks) {
    const subChunks = splitOutsideParens(chunk, new Set([',', '&']));
    if (
      subChunks.length > 1 &&
      subChunks.every((s) => segmentHasDayAnnotation(s) || isTimeLike(s))
    ) {
      segments.push(...subChunks);
    } else {
      segments.push(chunk);
    }
  }
  let isDayMapped = false;
  for (const seg of segments) {
    const parenMatch = seg.match(/\(([^)]+)\)/);
    if (parenMatch) {
      const days = parseDaysExpression(parenMatch[1]);
      if (days && days.length > 0) {
        const timeVal = seg
          .replace(parenMatch[0], '')
          .replace(/^[\s:,-]+|[\s:,-]+$/g, '')
          .trim();
        for (const d of days) {
          byDay.set(d, timeVal);
        }
        isDayMapped = true;
        continue;
      }
    }
    const colonMatch = seg.match(/^(.+?)\s*:\s*(.+)$/);
    if (colonMatch) {
      const days = parseDaysExpression(colonMatch[1]);
      if (days && /\d/.test(colonMatch[2])) {
        const timeVal = colonMatch[2].trim();
        for (const d of days) {
          byDay.set(d, timeVal);
        }
        isDayMapped = true;
        continue;
      }
    }
    const leadMatch = seg.match(
      /^([a-zA-Z,\s&/-]+?)\s+(\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?|a|p)?)$/i
    );
    if (leadMatch) {
      const days = parseDaysExpression(leadMatch[1]);
      if (days) {
        const timeVal = leadMatch[2].trim();
        for (const d of days) {
          byDay.set(d, timeVal);
        }
        isDayMapped = true;
        continue;
      }
    }
    const trailMatch = seg.match(
      /^(\d{1,2}(?::\d{2})?\s*(?:a\.?m\.?|p\.?m\.?|a|p)?)\s+([a-zA-Z,\s&/-]+)$/i
    );
    if (trailMatch) {
      const days = parseDaysExpression(trailMatch[2]);
      if (days) {
        const timeVal = trailMatch[1].trim();
        for (const d of days) {
          byDay.set(d, timeVal);
        }
        isDayMapped = true;
        continue;
      }
    }
    unlabeled.push(seg.trim());
  }
  return { isDayMapped, byDay, unlabeled };
}

export function expandEventSchedules(event: Event): Event[] {
  const startSpec = parseScheduleSpec(event.startTime);
  const endSpec = parseScheduleSpec(event.endTime);
  const hasDayMapped = startSpec.isDayMapped || endSpec.isDayMapped;
  const hasMultiUnlabeled =
    startSpec.unlabeled.length > 1 || endSpec.unlabeled.length > 1;
  if (!hasDayMapped && !hasMultiUnlabeled) {
    return [event];
  }
  const parsedDays = parseDaysExpression(event.dayOfWeek || '');
  if (hasDayMapped) {
    const targetDays: string[] =
      parsedDays && parsedDays.length > 0
        ? parsedDays
        : Array.from(new Set([...startSpec.byDay.keys(), ...endSpec.byDay.keys()]));
    if (targetDays.length === 0) {
      return [event];
    }
    return targetDays.map((day, idx) => {
      let resolvedStart: string;
      if (startSpec.isDayMapped) {
        resolvedStart =
          startSpec.byDay.get(day) ??
          (startSpec.unlabeled.length === 1 ? startSpec.unlabeled[0] : '');
      } else if (startSpec.unlabeled.length === targetDays.length) {
        resolvedStart = startSpec.unlabeled[idx];
      } else {
        resolvedStart = startSpec.unlabeled[0] ?? event.startTime;
      }

      let resolvedEnd: string;
      if (endSpec.isDayMapped) {
        resolvedEnd =
          endSpec.byDay.get(day) ??
          (endSpec.unlabeled.length === 1 ? endSpec.unlabeled[0] : '');
      } else if (endSpec.unlabeled.length === targetDays.length) {
        resolvedEnd = endSpec.unlabeled[idx];
      } else {
        resolvedEnd = endSpec.unlabeled[0] ?? event.endTime;
      }

      const splitId =
        targetDays.length > 1 && event.id
          ? `${event.id}-${day.toLowerCase()}`
          : event.id;

      return {
        ...event,
        id: splitId,
        dayOfWeek: day,
        startTime: resolvedStart,
        endTime: resolvedEnd,
      };
    });
  }
  const slotCount = Math.max(startSpec.unlabeled.length, endSpec.unlabeled.length);
  if (parsedDays && parsedDays.length === slotCount) {
    return parsedDays.map((day, idx) => ({
      ...event,
      id: event.id ? `${event.id}-${day.toLowerCase()}` : event.id,
      dayOfWeek: day,
      startTime: startSpec.unlabeled[idx] ?? startSpec.unlabeled[0] ?? '',
      endTime: endSpec.unlabeled[idx] ?? endSpec.unlabeled[0] ?? '',
    }));
  }
  if (parsedDays && parsedDays.length === 1) {
    const day = parsedDays[0];
    return Array.from({ length: slotCount }, (_, idx) => ({
      ...event,
      id: event.id ? `${event.id}-${day.toLowerCase()}-${idx + 1}` : event.id,
      dayOfWeek: day,
      startTime: startSpec.unlabeled[idx] ?? startSpec.unlabeled[0] ?? '',
      endTime: endSpec.unlabeled[idx] ?? endSpec.unlabeled[0] ?? '',
    }));
  }
  return [event];
}

File: scripts/generate-context.ts

import { execSync } from 'node:child_process';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import process from 'node:process';

const DEFAULT_INCLUDES: string[] = [
  'app/**/*',
  'proxy.ts',
  'scripts/**/*',
  'package.json',
  'next.config.ts',
  'tsconfig.json',
  'eslint.config.mjs',
  'repomix.config.json'
];

const SECTIONS: Record<string, string[]> = {
  app: ['app/**/*'],
  components: ['app/components/**/*', 'app/events/components/**/*'],
  events: ['app/events/**/*', 'app/[city]/events/**/*'],
  city: ['app/[city]/**/*', 'app/lib/cities.ts', 'proxy.ts'],
  api: ['app/api/**/*'],
  core: [
    'app/layout.tsx',
    'app/page.tsx',
    'app/globals.css',
    'proxy.ts',
    'package.json',
    'next.config.ts',
    'tsconfig.json'
  ],
  scripts: ['scripts/**/*', 'repomix.config.json']
};

const IGNORES: string[] = [
  'node_modules',
  '.next',
  '.git',
  '.vercel',
  'pnpm-lock.yaml',
  'package-lock.json',
  'public/**/*',
  '**/*.png',
  '**/*.jpg',
  '**/*.jpeg',
  '**/*.svg',
  '**/*.ico',
  '**/*.pdf',
  '**/*.lock',
  '**/*.pem',
  '**/*.key',
  '**/dist/**',
  'repomix-output.txt',
  'repomix.temp.*',
  'project-context.txt',
  'ctx-map.txt',
  '.claude/settings.local.json',
  '**/.env*',
  '.env*',
  '.env.local',
  '**/.env.local'
];

function skeletonize(content: string): string {
  return content.replace(/(\s*\{\s*)([\s\S]*?)(\s*\})/g, (match, open, body, close) => {
    if (body.length > 40 && body.includes('\n')) {
      return `${open} /* implementation removed */ ${close}`;
    }
    return match;
  });
}

function generateProjectTree(dir = '.', prefix = ''): string {
  const ignoredFolders = new Set(['.git', '.next', 'node_modules', 'public', '.vercel', 'dist', 'out']);
  const ignoredFiles = new Set(['repomix-output.txt', 'next-env.d.ts']);
  const items = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((i: fs.Dirent) =>
      !ignoredFolders.has(i.name) &&
      !ignoredFiles.has(i.name) &&
      !i.name.startsWith('.') &&
      !i.name.includes('lock') &&
      !i.name.includes('.temp.')
    )
    .sort((a: fs.Dirent, b: fs.Dirent) => (b.isDirectory() ? 1 : 0) - (a.isDirectory() ? 1 : 0) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

  let output = '';
  for (let idx = 0; idx < items.length; idx++) {
    const item = items[idx];
    const isLast = idx === items.length - 1;
    const marker = isLast ? '\\--- ' : '+--- ';
    output += `${prefix}${marker}${item.name}\n`;

    if (item.isDirectory()) {
      const subPrefix = prefix + (isLast ? '    ' : '|   ');
      output += generateProjectTree(`${dir}/${item.name}`, subPrefix);
    }
  }
  return output;
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const startTime = Date.now();

  if (fs.existsSync('repomix-output.txt')) {
    try {
      fs.writeFileSync('repomix-output.txt', '', 'utf8');
    } catch {}
  }

  const rawArgs = process.argv.slice(2).map((a: string) => a.toLowerCase());
  const isMap = rawArgs.includes('map');
  const isFull = rawArgs.includes('full');
  const isSkeleton = rawArgs.includes('skeleton') || (!isMap && !isFull && rawArgs.length === 0);
  const domainArgs = rawArgs.filter((a: string) => a !== 'skeleton' && a !== 'map' && a !== 'full' && a !== 'db');

  const isMapOnly = isMap && !isSkeleton && !isFull && domainArgs.length === 0;

  if (isMapOnly) {
    const tree = generateProjectTree();
    const output = [
      '#TASK\n\n\n\n\n',
      '#PROJECT FILES\n\n',
      'Project Structure Map:\n+--- root\n',
      tree,
      '\n'
    ].join('');

    fs.writeFileSync('repomix-output.txt', output, 'utf8');
    const elapsed = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(2);
    console.log(`Generated fresh repomix-output.txt (Map) in ${elapsed}s.`);
    try {
      execSync('code -r "repomix-output.txt"', { stdio: 'ignore' });
    } catch {
      try {
        execSync('code "repomix-output.txt"', { stdio: 'ignore' });
      } catch {}
    }
    return;
  }

  let includes: string[] = [];
  if (domainArgs.length === 0 || domainArgs.includes('all')) {
    includes = DEFAULT_INCLUDES;
  } else {
    domainArgs.forEach((arg: string) => {
      if (SECTIONS[arg]) {
        includes.push(...SECTIONS[arg]);
      } else {
        includes.push(arg);
      }
    });
  }

  const tempOutputFile = 'repomix.temp.out.txt';
  const repomixConfig = {
    output: {
      filePath: tempOutputFile,
      style: 'plain',
      removeComments: false,
      removeEmptyLines: !isFull,
      showLineNumbers: false,
      topFilesLength: 0,
      showSummary: false,
      showDirectoryStructure: false
    },
    include: includes,
    ignore: {
      useGitignore: true,
      useDefaultPatterns: true,
      customPatterns: IGNORES
    }
  };

  fs.writeFileSync('repomix.temp.json', JSON.stringify(repomixConfig, null, 2));

  try {
    console.log(`Packing files with repomix (Skeleton: ${isSkeleton}, Full: ${isFull})...`);
    execSync('pnpm exec repomix --config repomix.temp.json', { stdio: 'inherit' });

    let fileContent = '';
    if (fs.existsSync(tempOutputFile)) {
      fileContent = fs.readFileSync(tempOutputFile, 'utf8');
      fs.unlinkSync(tempOutputFile);
    }
    if (fs.existsSync('repomix.temp.json')) {
      fs.unlinkSync('repomix.temp.json');
    }

    if (isSkeleton) {
      console.log('Applying skeletonization...');
      fileContent = skeletonize(fileContent);
    }

    const chunks: string[] = [];
    chunks.push('#TASK\n\n\n\n\n');
    chunks.push('#PROJECT FILES\n\n');
    chunks.push('Project Structure Map:\n+--- root\n' + generateProjectTree() + '\n\n');
    chunks.push(fileContent);

    fs.writeFileSync('repomix-output.txt', chunks.join(''), 'utf8');

    const elapsed = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(2);
    console.log(`Generated fresh repomix-output.txt in ${elapsed}s.`);

    try {
      execSync('code -r "repomix-output.txt"', { stdio: 'ignore' });
      console.log('Opened repomix-output.txt in VS Code.');
    } catch {
      try {
        execSync('code "repomix-output.txt"', { stdio: 'ignore' });
        console.log('Opened repomix-output.txt in VS Code.');
      } catch {}
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Execution failed:', error);
    if (fs.existsSync(tempOutputFile)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(tempOutputFile);
    }
    if (fs.existsSync('repomix.temp.json')) {
      fs.unlinkSync('repomix.temp.json');
    }
  }
}

main().catch((err: unknown) => {
  console.error('Error in context generator:', err);
  process.exit(1);
});

import { Suspense } from 'react';
import { notFound, permanentRedirect } from 'next/navigation';
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { getAllCitySlugs, getCityBySlug } from '../../lib/cities';
import Header from '../../components/Header';
import Footer from '../../components/Footer';
import ContactView from '../../contact/ContactView';
type PageProps = {
  params: Promise<{ city: string }>;
};
export async function generateStaticParams() {
  return getAllCitySlugs().map((city) => ({ city }));
}
export async function generateMetadata({ params }: PageProps): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { city: citySlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    return {
      title: 'City Not Found',
      robots: { index: false, follow: false },
    };
  }
  return {
    title: `Contact Us — ${city.name}`,
    description: `Submit a new regularly occurring event in ${city.heroLocation} or ask us a question.`,
    alternates: {
      canonical: `/${city.slug}/contact`,
    },
  };
}
export default async function CityContactPage({ params }: PageProps) {
  const { city: citySlug } = await params;
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    notFound();
  }
  if (city.slug !== citySlug) {
    permanentRedirect(`/${city.slug}/contact`);
  }
  return (
    <div style={{ minHeight: '100vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <Header city={city} />
      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        <ContactView city={city} />
      </Suspense>
      <Footer city={city} />
    </div>
  );
}

File: app/components/ThemeToggle.tsx

'use client';
import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
import styles from './ThemeToggle.module.css';
interface ThemeToggleProps {
  showLabel?: boolean;
}
const emptySubscribe = () => () => {};
function subscribeTheme(callback: () => void) {
  const observer = new MutationObserver(callback);
  observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ['data-theme'],
  });
  const media = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
  media.addEventListener('change', callback);
  return () => {
    observer.disconnect();
    media.removeEventListener('change', callback);
  };
}
function getThemeSnapshot(): 'light' | 'dark' {
  const current = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme');
  if (current === 'dark') return 'dark';
  if (current === 'light') return 'light';
  return window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
}
function getThemeServerSnapshot(): 'light' | 'dark' {
  return 'light';
}
export default function ThemeToggle({ showLabel = false }: ThemeToggleProps) {
  const mounted = useSyncExternalStore(
    emptySubscribe,
    () => true,
    () => false
  );
  const theme = useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribeTheme,
    getThemeSnapshot,
    getThemeServerSnapshot
  );
  const toggleTheme = () => {
    const nextTheme = theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', nextTheme);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('theme', nextTheme);
    } catch {
    }
  };
  const isDark = mounted ? theme === 'dark' : false;
  const sunIcon = (
    <svg
      width="18"
      height="18"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth="2.2"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5" />
      <line x1="12" y1="1" x2="12" y2="3" />
      <line x1="12" y1="21" x2="12" y2="23" />
      <line x1="4.22" y1="4.22" x2="5.64" y2="5.64" />
      <line x1="18.36" y1="18.36" x2="19.78" y2="19.78" />
      <line x1="1" y1="12" x2="3" y2="12" />
      <line x1="21" y1="12" x2="23" y2="12" />
      <line x1="4.22" y1="19.78" x2="5.64" y2="18.36" />
      <line x1="18.36" y1="5.64" x2="19.78" y2="4.22" />
    </svg>
  );
  const moonIcon = (
    <svg
      width="18"
      height="18"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth="2.2"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z" />
    </svg>
  );
  if (showLabel) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        className={styles.toggleBtnMobile}
        onClick={toggleTheme}
        aria-label={`Switch to ${isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'} mode`}
      >
        <span className={styles.mobileLabelRow}>
          {isDark ? sunIcon : moonIcon}
          <span>{isDark ? 'Light Mode' : 'Dark Mode'}</span>
        </span>
        <span className={styles.pillBadge}>{isDark ? 'Dark' : 'Light'}</span>
      </button>
    );
  }
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={styles.toggleBtn}
      onClick={toggleTheme}
      aria-label={`Switch to ${isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'} mode`}
      title={`Switch to ${isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'} mode`}
    >
      {isDark ? sunIcon : moonIcon}
    </button>
  );
}

File: app/contact/components/ContactMessageForm.tsx

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import styles from '../Contact.module.css';
interface ContactMessageFormProps {
  cityName?: string;
}
export default function ContactMessageForm({ cityName }: ContactMessageFormProps) {
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ success: boolean; message: string } | null>(null);
  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setStatus(null);
    const messageLines = [
      cityName ? `City Page: ${cityName}` : null,
      `Name: ${name}`,
      `Email Address: ${email}`,
      `Message:`,
      message,
    ].filter((line): line is string => line !== null);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/send-form', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          formType: cityName ? `Question / Message (${cityName})` : 'Question / Message',
          message: messageLines.join('\n'),
        }),
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (result.success) {
        setStatus({
          success: true,
          message: 'Thank you! Your message has been sent. We will get back to you soon.',
        });
        setName('');
        setEmail('');
        setMessage('');
      } else {
        setStatus({
          success: false,
          message: 'Failed to send message. Please try again.',
        });
      }
    } catch {
      setStatus({
        success: false,
        message: 'A connection error occurred. Please try again.',
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <form
      id="panel-question"
      role="tabpanel"
      aria-labelledby="tab-question"
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
    >
      <fieldset className={styles.fieldset}>
        <legend className={styles.legend}>Question? Comment? Suggestion?</legend>
        <div className={styles.row}>
          <div className={styles.field}>
            <label htmlFor="q-name" className={styles.label}>
              Name *
            </label>
            <input
              id="q-name"
              type="text"
              required
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. John Doe"
              className={styles.input}
            />
          </div>
          <div className={styles.field}>
            <label htmlFor="q-email" className={styles.label}>
              Email *
            </label>
            <input
              id="q-email"
              type="email"
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. john@doe.com"
              className={styles.input}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.field}>
          <label htmlFor="q-message" className={styles.label}>
            Message *
          </label>
          <textarea
            id="q-message"
            required
            value={message}
            onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Enter your message…"
            className={styles.textarea}
          />
        </div>
      </fieldset>
      <button type="submit" className={styles.submitBtn} disabled={loading}>
        {loading ? 'Sending message...' : 'Send Message'}
      </button>
      {status && (
        <div
          className={`${styles.statusAlert} ${
            status.success ? styles.statusSuccess : styles.statusError
          }`}
          role="status"
        >
          {status.message}
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}

'use client';
import styles from './FilterControls.module.css';

interface FilterDropdownProps {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  category: string;
  value: string;
  title: string;
  options: string[];
  selected: string[];
  isOpen: boolean;
  onToggleOpen: () => void;
  onToggleOption: (option: string) => void;
  onClear: () => void;
  containerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  flexStyle?: boolean;
}

export default function FilterDropdown({
  icon,
  category,
  value,
  title,
  options,
  selected,
  isOpen,
  onToggleOpen,
  onToggleOption,
  onClear,
  containerRef,
  flexStyle = false,
}: FilterDropdownProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={styles.multiSelectWrapper}
      ref={containerRef}
      style={flexStyle ? { flex: 1 } : undefined}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        className={`${styles.multiSelectTrigger} ${
          selected.length > 0 ? styles.multiSelectTriggerActive : ''
        }`}
        aria-expanded={isOpen}
        onClick={onToggleOpen}
      >
        <span className={styles.filterTriggerLeft}>
          <span className={styles.filterTriggerIcon}>{icon}</span>
          <span className={styles.filterCategory}>{category}</span>
          <span className={styles.filterValue}>{value}</span>
        </span>
        <svg
          className={styles.filterChevron}
          width="14"
          height="14"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2.4"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d={isOpen ? 'M6 15l6-6 6 6' : 'M6 9l6 6 6-6'} />
        </svg>
      </button>
      {isOpen && (
        <div className={styles.multiSelectMenu}>
          <div className={styles.multiSelectMenuHeader}>
            <span>{title}</span>
            {selected.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className={styles.multiSelectClearLink}
                onClick={onClear}
              >
                Clear
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          {options.map((opt) => {
            const isChecked = selected.includes(opt);
            return (
              <label key={opt} className={styles.multiSelectOption}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={isChecked}
                  onChange={() => onToggleOption(opt)}
                  className={styles.hiddenCheckbox}
                />
                <span
                  className={`${styles.customCheckbox} ${
                    isChecked ? styles.customCheckboxChecked : ''
                  }`}
                >
                  {isChecked && (
                    <svg
                      width="12"
                      height="12"
                      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                      fill="none"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      strokeWidth="3"
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                      strokeLinejoin="round"
                    >
                      <path d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                    </svg>
                  )}
                </span>
                <span>{opt}</span>
              </label>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: proxy.ts
================
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server';
import { getCityBySlug } from './app/lib/cities';
export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const rawEvent = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get('event')?.trim() || '';
  if (
    !rawEvent ||
    rawEvent.length > 200 ||
    rawEvent.includes('/') ||
    rawEvent.includes('\\') ||
    rawEvent.includes('..')
  ) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }
  const segments = request.nextUrl.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
  if (segments.length !== 2) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }
  const citySlug =
    segments[1] === 'events'
      ? segments[0]
      : segments[0] === 'events'
      ? segments[1]
      : '';
  if (!citySlug) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }
  const city = getCityBySlug(citySlug);
  if (!city) {
    return NextResponse.next();
  }
  const destination = request.nextUrl.clone();
  destination.pathname = `/${city.slug}/events/${encodeURIComponent(rawEvent)}`;
  destination.searchParams.delete('event');
  return NextResponse.redirect(destination, 307);
}
export const config = {
  matcher: [
    {
      source: '/:city/events',
      has: [{ type: 'query', key: 'event' }],
    },
    {
      source: '/events/:city',
      has: [{ type: 'query', key: 'event' }],
    },
  ],
};
