                  id="edit-day"
                  label="Day of Week"
                  value={values.dayOfWeek}
                  changed={isFieldChanged('dayOfWeek')}
                  onChange={(v) => handleChange('dayOfWeek', v)}
                />
                <EditField
                  id="edit-start"
                  label="Start Time"
                  value={values.startTime}
                  changed={isFieldChanged('startTime')}
                  onChange={(v) => handleChange('startTime', v)}
                />
                <EditField
                  id="edit-end"
                  label="End Time"
                  value={values.endTime}
                  changed={isFieldChanged('endTime')}
                  onChange={(v) => handleChange('endTime', v)}
                />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.gridRow}>
                <EditField
                  id="edit-freq"
                  label="Frequency"
                  value={values.frequency}
                  changed={isFieldChanged('frequency')}
                  onChange={(v) => handleChange('frequency', v)}
                />
                <EditField
                  id="edit-freq-notes"
                  label="Frequency Notes"
                  value={values.frequencyNotes}
                  changed={isFieldChanged('frequencyNotes')}
                  placeholder="e.g. Even weeks, May-Sep"
                  onChange={(v) => handleChange('frequencyNotes', v)}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.section}>
              <div className={styles.sectionHeader}>
                <span className={styles.sectionTitle}>Price &amp; Registration</span>
                <div className={styles.sectionLine} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.gridRow}>
                <EditField
                  id="edit-price"
                  label="Price"
                  value={values.price}
                  changed={isFieldChanged('price')}
                  onChange={(v) => handleChange('price', v)}
                />
                <EditField
                  id="edit-prereg"
                  label="Pre-Registration / RSVP"
                  value={values.preRegistration}
                  changed={isFieldChanged('preRegistration')}
                  onChange={(v) => handleChange('preRegistration', v)}
                />
              </div>
              <EditField
                id="edit-reg-url"
                label="Registration URL"
                value={values.registrationUrl}
                changed={isFieldChanged('registrationUrl')}
                placeholder="Only if registration is required or recommended"
                onChange={(v) => handleChange('registrationUrl', v)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className={styles.section}>
              <div className={styles.sectionHeader}>
                <span className={styles.sectionTitle}>Notes &amp; Submitter Info</span>
                <div className={styles.sectionLine} aria-hidden="true" />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <label htmlFor="edit-notes" className={styles.label}>
                  What changed or needs updating? (optional)
                </label>
                <textarea
                  id="edit-notes"
                  value={notes}
                  onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Explain reason for changes or provide additional links..."
                  className={styles.textarea}
                />
              </div>
              <div className={styles.field}>
                <label htmlFor="edit-email" className={styles.label}>
                  Your Email (optional)
                </label>
                <input
                  id="edit-email"
                  type="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="name@example.com"
                  className={styles.input}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            {status && (
              <div
                className={`${styles.statusAlert} ${
                  status.success ? styles.statusSuccess : styles.statusError
                }`}
                role="status"
              >
                {status.message}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className={styles.modalFooter}>
            <div
              className={`${styles.changeSummary} ${
                changedFields.length > 0 ? styles.changeSummaryActive : ''
              }`}
            >
              {changedFields.length === 0
                ? notes.trim()
                  ? 'Note only'
                  : 'No changes made yet'
                : `${changedFields.length} field${changedFields.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} modified`}
            </div>
            <div className={styles.modalActions}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={styles.modalCancelBtn}
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={isSubmitting}
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="submit"
                className={styles.modalSubmitBtn}
                disabled={isSubmitting || !hasChanges}
              >
                {isSubmitting
                  ? 'Sending...'
                  : changedFields.length > 0
                  ? `Send ${changedFields.length} Edit${changedFields.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
                  : 'Send Edit'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: app/events/components/ProveItButton.tsx
================
'use client';
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { buildProveItSources } from '../event-helpers';
import {
  normalizeContactText,
  parseContactWithLinks,
  parseTextWithLinks,
  type TextSegment,
} from '../linkify';
import ActionPopover from './ActionPopover';
import { ExternalLinkIcon, ShieldCheckIcon } from './EventIcons';
import styles from './ProveItButton.module.css';

interface ProveItButtonProps {
  url1?: string;
  url1Notes?: string;
  url2?: string;
  url2Notes?: string;
  contact?: string;
  contactPageHref: string;
  btnClassName: string;
  btnActiveClassName: string;
  btnDisabledClassName: string;
}

function renderTextSegments(segments: TextSegment[]) {
  return segments.map((seg, idx) => {
    if (seg.type === 'text') {
      return <span key={idx}>{seg.text}</span>;
    }
    const isExternal =
      !seg.href.startsWith('mailto:') && !seg.href.startsWith('tel:');
    return (
      <a
        key={idx}
        href={seg.href}
        target={isExternal ? '_blank' : undefined}
        rel={isExternal ? 'noopener noreferrer' : undefined}
        className={styles.proveItLink}
      >
        <span>{seg.text}</span>
        {isExternal && <ExternalLinkIcon className={styles.proveItLinkIcon} />}
      </a>
    );
  });
}

export default function ProveItButton({
  url1,
  url1Notes,
  url2,
  url2Notes,
  contact,
  contactPageHref,
  btnClassName,
  btnActiveClassName,
  btnDisabledClassName,
}: ProveItButtonProps) {
  const sources = useMemo(
    () =>
      buildProveItSources({
        url1: url1 || '',
        url1Notes: url1Notes || '',
        url2: url2 || '',
        url2Notes: url2Notes || '',
      }),
    [url1, url1Notes, url2, url2Notes]
  );
  const cleanContact = useMemo(() => normalizeContactText(contact), [contact]);
  const contactSegments = useMemo(
    () => (cleanContact ? parseContactWithLinks(cleanContact) : []),
    [cleanContact]
  );

  if (sources.length === 0) {
    return (
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled
        className={`${btnClassName} ${btnDisabledClassName}`}
        title="No source details listed yet"
      >
        <ShieldCheckIcon />
        Prove It
      </button>
    );
  }

  const needsTrailingPeriod =
    Boolean(cleanContact) && !/[.!?]$/.test(cleanContact);

  return (
    <ActionPopover
      triggerLabel="Prove It"
      triggerIcon={<ShieldCheckIcon />}
      btnClassName={btnClassName}
      btnActiveClassName={btnActiveClassName}
      dialogLabel="Event source and verification details"
      headerLabel="Prove It"
      wide
      align="left"
    >
      {() => (
        <div className={styles.proveItBox}>
          {sources.map((source) => (
            <div
              key={`${source.prefix}-${source.url}`}
              className={styles.proveItSource}
            >
              <p className={styles.proveItText}>
                <span>{source.prefix}</span>
                <a
                  href={source.href}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className={styles.proveItLink}
                >
                  <span>{source.url}</span>
                  <ExternalLinkIcon className={styles.proveItLinkIcon} />
                </a>
              </p>
              {source.notes && (
                <p className={styles.proveItNote}>
                  {renderTextSegments(parseTextWithLinks(source.notes))}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
          <p className={`${styles.proveItText} ${styles.proveItContactDivider}`}>
            <span>Want more proof? Contact </span>
            {cleanContact ? (
              <>
                {renderTextSegments(contactSegments)}
                {needsTrailingPeriod ? '.' : ''}
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Link href={contactPageHref} className={styles.proveItLink}>
                  us
                </Link>
                .
              </>
            )}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </ActionPopover>
  );
}

================
File: app/events/event-helpers.ts
================
import { Event } from '../lib/google-sheets';
import {
  CityConfig,
  SITE_URL,
  getCityPriceConfig,
  getCityTimeZone,
} from '../lib/cities';
import {
  ensureExternalUrl,
  formatRecurrenceText,
  formatTimeRange,
  isEventActiveOnDate,
  isFreeOrDonation,
  parseEventPrice,
  parseHour,
} from './utils';

export type EventResolutionResult = {
  event: Event;
  canonicalSlug: string;
  isCanonical: boolean;
};

export type NextOccurrenceResult = {
  date: Date;
  offsetDays: number;
  label: string;
  isToday: boolean;
  isTomorrow: boolean;
};

export type EventDisplayDetails = {
  displayVenue: string;
  venueUrl: string;
  showDistinctAddress: boolean;
  organizerName: string;
  organizerUrl: string;
  showOrganizer: boolean;
  recurrenceText: string;
  preRegistrationText: string;
  registrationUrl: string;
  needsSignupIcon: boolean;
  mapsHref: string;
  moreDetailsUrl: string;
};

export type ProveItSource = {
  prefix: 'Listed at ' | 'Also, at ';
  url: string;
  href: string;
  notes: string;
};

function cleanOptionalField(raw?: string): string {
  if (!raw) return '';
  const trimmed = raw.trim();
  if (!trimmed || trimmed.toLowerCase() === 'x') return '';
  return trimmed;
}

export function buildProveItSources(
  event: Pick<Event, 'url1' | 'url1Notes' | 'url2' | 'url2Notes'>
): ProveItSource[] {
  const url1 = cleanOptionalField(event.url1);
  const href1 = url1 ? ensureExternalUrl(url1) : '';
  const url1Notes = cleanOptionalField(event.url1Notes);

  const url2 = cleanOptionalField(event.url2);
  const href2 = url2 ? ensureExternalUrl(url2) : '';
  const url2Notes = cleanOptionalField(event.url2Notes);

  const sources: ProveItSource[] = [];
  if (url1 && href1) {
    sources.push({
      prefix: 'Listed at ',
      url: url1,
      href: href1,
      notes: url1Notes,
    });
  }
  if (url2 && href2) {
    sources.push({
      prefix: sources.length === 0 ? 'Listed at ' : 'Also, at ',
      url: url2,
      href: href2,
      notes: url2Notes,
    });
  }
  return sources;
}

export function getEventDisplayDetails(
  event: Event,
  cityName: string
): EventDisplayDetails {
  const displayVenue = (event.venue || event.location || '').trim();
  const venueUrl =
    displayVenue && event.venueUrl ? ensureExternalUrl(event.venueUrl) : '';
  const showDistinctAddress = Boolean(
    event.venue.trim() &&
      event.location.trim() &&
      event.venue.trim().toLowerCase() !== event.location.trim().toLowerCase()
  );
  const organizerName = (event.organization || '')
    .trim()
    .replace(/^hosted\s+by\s+/i, '')
    .trim();
  const organizerUrl =
    organizerName && event.organizerUrl
      ? ensureExternalUrl(event.organizerUrl)
      : '';
  const showOrganizer = Boolean(
    organizerName &&
      organizerName.toLowerCase() !== displayVenue.toLowerCase()
  );
  const recurrenceText = formatRecurrenceText(
    event.frequency,
    event.frequencyNotes
  );
  const rawPreReg = (event.preRegistration || '').trim();
  const registrationUrl = event.registrationUrl
    ? ensureExternalUrl(event.registrationUrl)
    : '';
  const preRegistrationText = rawPreReg || (registrationUrl ? 'Registration' : '');
  const regLower = preRegistrationText.toLowerCase();
  const isDropInOrNoReg =
    regLower.startsWith('drop') ||
    regLower.startsWith('no ') ||
    regLower.includes('no rsvp') ||
    regLower.includes('no registration') ||
    regLower.includes('not required') ||
    regLower.includes('not needed');
  const needsSignupIcon =
    Boolean(registrationUrl) ||
    (!isDropInOrNoReg &&
      /\b(reg|register|registration|pre-?registration|rsvp|ticket|ticketed|pre-?pay|required|recommended|sign[\s-]?up)\b/i.test(
        regLower
      ));
  const mapsHref =
    (event.map ? ensureExternalUrl(event.map) : '') ||
    `https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=${encodeURIComponent(
      `${displayVenue || event.title}, ${cityName}`
    )}`;
  const moreDetailsUrl = cleanOptionalField(event.url1)
    ? ensureExternalUrl(event.url1)
    : '';
  return {
    displayVenue,
    venueUrl,
    showDistinctAddress,
    organizerName,
    organizerUrl,
    showOrganizer,
    recurrenceText,
    preRegistrationText,
    registrationUrl,
    needsSignupIcon,
    mapsHref,
    moreDetailsUrl,
  };
}

export function slugifyText(text: string): string {
  if (!text) return '';
  return text
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/['’‘`]/g, '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
}

function normalizeEventId(id?: string): string {
  if (!id) return '';
  return id
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
    .toLowerCase();
}

export function getEventSlug(event: Pick<Event, 'id' | 'title'>): string {
  const titleSlug = slugifyText(event.title);
  const idPart = normalizeEventId(event.id);
  if (idPart && titleSlug) {
    return `${titleSlug}-${idPart}`;
  }
  if (idPart) {
    return `event-${idPart}`;
  }
  return titleSlug || 'event';
}

export function getEventPath(citySlug: string, event: Pick<Event, 'id' | 'title'>): string {
  return `/${citySlug}/events/${getEventSlug(event)}`;
}

export function getEventAbsoluteUrl(
  citySlug: string,
  event: Pick<Event, 'id' | 'title'>
): string {
  return `${SITE_URL}${getEventPath(citySlug, event)}`;
}

export function resolveEventBySlug(
  events: Event[],
  rawSlug: string
): EventResolutionResult | null {
  if (!rawSlug || events.length === 0) return null;
  let decoded = rawSlug;
  try {
    decoded = decodeURIComponent(rawSlug);
  } catch {
  }
  const normalizedSlug = decoded.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  if (!normalizedSlug) return null;
  for (const ev of events) {
    const canonicalSlug = getEventSlug(ev);
    if (canonicalSlug === normalizedSlug) {
      return { event: ev, canonicalSlug, isCanonical: true };
    }
  }
  for (const ev of events) {
    const normId = normalizeEventId(ev.id);
    if (!normId) continue;
    if (normId === normalizedSlug) {
      const canonicalSlug = getEventSlug(ev);
      return { event: ev, canonicalSlug, isCanonical: false };
    }
  }
  const lastDashIdx = normalizedSlug.lastIndexOf('-');
  if (lastDashIdx !== -1 && lastDashIdx < normalizedSlug.length - 1) {
    const trailingId = normalizedSlug.slice(lastDashIdx + 1);
    const exactTrailingMatch = events.find(
      (ev) => normalizeEventId(ev.id) === trailingId
    );
    if (exactTrailingMatch) {
      const canonicalSlug = getEventSlug(exactTrailingMatch);
      return {
        event: exactTrailingMatch,
        canonicalSlug,
        isCanonical: canonicalSlug === normalizedSlug,
      };
    }
  }
  let bestHyphenatedMatch: Event | null = null;
  let bestIdLen = 0;
  for (const ev of events) {
    const normId = normalizeEventId(ev.id);
    if (!normId || !normId.includes('-')) continue;
    if (normalizedSlug.endsWith(`-${normId}`) && normId.length > bestIdLen) {
      bestHyphenatedMatch = ev;
      bestIdLen = normId.length;
    }
  }
  if (bestHyphenatedMatch) {
    const canonicalSlug = getEventSlug(bestHyphenatedMatch);
    return {
      event: bestHyphenatedMatch,
      canonicalSlug,
      isCanonical: canonicalSlug === normalizedSlug,
    };
  }
  const barePrefixMatch = events.find((ev) => {
    const normId = normalizeEventId(ev.id);
    return Boolean(normId) && normId.startsWith(`${normalizedSlug}-`);
  });
  if (barePrefixMatch) {
    const canonicalSlug = getEventSlug(barePrefixMatch);
    return {
      event: barePrefixMatch,
      canonicalSlug,
      isCanonical: false,
    };
  }
  if (lastDashIdx !== -1 && lastDashIdx < normalizedSlug.length - 1) {
    const trailingId = normalizedSlug.slice(lastDashIdx + 1);
    const trailingPrefixMatch = events.find((ev) => {
      const normId = normalizeEventId(ev.id);
      return Boolean(normId) && normId.startsWith(`${trailingId}-`);
    });
    if (trailingPrefixMatch) {
      const canonicalSlug = getEventSlug(trailingPrefixMatch);
      return {
        event: trailingPrefixMatch,
        canonicalSlug,
        isCanonical: false,
      };
    }
  }
  const idLessEvents = events.filter((ev) => !normalizeEventId(ev.id));
  const idLessTitleMatch = idLessEvents.find(
    (ev) => slugifyText(ev.title) === normalizedSlug
  );
  if (idLessTitleMatch) {
    const canonicalSlug = getEventSlug(idLessTitleMatch);
    return {
      event: idLessTitleMatch,
      canonicalSlug,
      isCanonical: canonicalSlug === normalizedSlug,
    };
  }
  const hasTrailingNumericId = /-\d+$/.test(normalizedSlug);
  if (!hasTrailingNumericId) {
    const titleMatch = events.find((ev) => slugifyText(ev.title) === normalizedSlug);
    if (titleMatch) {
      const canonicalSlug = getEventSlug(titleMatch);
      return {
        event: titleMatch,
        canonicalSlug,
        isCanonical: canonicalSlug === normalizedSlug,
      };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export function getCityToday(timeZone: string, now: Date = new Date()): Date {
  try {
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone,
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'numeric',
      day: 'numeric',
    }).formatToParts(now);
    const year = Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === 'year')?.value);
    const month = Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === 'month')?.value);
    const day = Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === 'day')?.value);
    if (year && month && day) {
      return new Date(year, month - 1, day);
    }
  } catch {
  }
  return new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
}

export function formatOccurrenceLabel(date: Date, offsetDays: number): string {
  if (offsetDays === 0) return 'Today';
  if (offsetDays === 1) return 'Tomorrow';
  const formatted = date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    weekday: 'short',
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  });
  return `Next: ${formatted}`;
}

export function getNextEventOccurrence(
  event: Event,
  timeZone: string,
  maxDays: number = 90,
  now: Date = new Date()
): NextOccurrenceResult | null {
  const startDay = getCityToday(timeZone, now);
  for (let offset = 0; offset <= maxDays; offset++) {
    const candidate = new Date(startDay);
    candidate.setDate(startDay.getDate() + offset);
    if (isEventActiveOnDate(event, candidate)) {
      return {
        date: candidate,
        offsetDays: offset,
        label: formatOccurrenceLabel(candidate, offset),
        isToday: offset === 0,
        isTomorrow: offset === 1,
      };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

export function buildScheduleLine(event: Event): string {
  const { start, end } = formatTimeRange(event.startTime, event.endTime);
  const timePart = start && end ? `${start} – ${end}` : start || '';
  const freqRaw = (event.frequency || '').trim();
  const notesRaw = (event.frequencyNotes || '').trim();
  const isPlainWeekly = /^weekly$/i.test(freqRaw) && !notesRaw;
  const recurrencePart = formatRecurrenceText(freqRaw, notesRaw);
  const dayRaw = (event.dayOfWeek || '').trim();
  let whenPart = '';
  if (dayRaw && recurrencePart && !isPlainWeekly) {
    if (recurrencePart.toLowerCase().includes(dayRaw.toLowerCase())) {
      whenPart = recurrencePart;
    } else {
      whenPart = `${dayRaw} (${recurrencePart})`;
    }
  } else {
    whenPart = dayRaw || recurrencePart;
  }
  return [whenPart, timePart].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
}

export function buildEventInviteText(event: Event, citySlug: string): string {
  const url = getEventAbsoluteUrl(citySlug, event);
  const title = event.title.trim();
  const scheduleLine = buildScheduleLine(event);
  const venue = (event.venue || event.location || '').trim();
  const area = (event.area || '').trim();
  let placePart = '';
  if (venue && area && venue.toLowerCase() !== area.toLowerCase()) {
    placePart = `${venue} (${area})`;
  } else {
    placePart = venue || area;
  }
  const pricePart = (event.price || '').trim();
  const detailsLine = [placePart, pricePart].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
  return [title, scheduleLine, detailsLine, url].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
}

export async function copyToClipboard(text: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      return true;
    }
    if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
      const textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
      textarea.value = text;
      textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
      textarea.style.opacity = '0';
      document.body.appendChild(textarea);
      textarea.focus();
      textarea.select();
      const ok = document.execCommand('copy');
      document.body.removeChild(textarea);
      return ok;
    }
  } catch {
  }
  return false;
}

export function buildEventMetaDescription(event: Event, city: CityConfig): string {
  const schedule = buildScheduleLine(event);
  const venue = (event.venue || event.location || '').trim();
  const area = (event.area || '').trim();
  const price = (event.price || '').trim();
  const about = (event.about || event.notes || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  let locationPhrase = '';
  if (venue && area && venue.toLowerCase() !== area.toLowerCase()) {
    locationPhrase = `${venue} (${area})`;
  } else {
    locationPhrase = venue || area || city.heroLocation;
  }
  const headParts: string[] = [];
  if (schedule && locationPhrase) {
    headParts.push(`${schedule} at ${locationPhrase}`);
  } else if (schedule) {
    headParts.push(schedule);
  } else if (locationPhrase) {
    headParts.push(`${locationPhrase}, ${city.name}`);
  }
  if (price) {
    headParts.push(price);
  }
  const headerSummary = headParts.join(' · ');
  const full = [headerSummary ? `${headerSummary}.` : '', about]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' ');
  if (full.length <= 160) return full;
  const sliced = full.slice(0, 157);
  const lastSpace = sliced.lastIndexOf(' ');
  const trimmed = lastSpace > 90 ? sliced.slice(0, lastSpace) : sliced;
  return `${trimmed.replace(/[.,;:\s]+$/, '')}…`;
}

function getTimeZoneOffsetString(date: Date, timeZone: string): string {
  try {
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
      timeZone,
      timeZoneName: 'longOffset',
    }).formatToParts(date);
    const tzName = parts.find((p) => p.type === 'timeZoneName')?.value || '';
    const match = tzName.match(/GMT([+-]\d{2}):?(\d{2})/);
    if (match) {
      return `${match[1]}:${match[2]}`;
    }
    if (tzName === 'GMT') return 'Z';
  } catch {
  }
  return timeZone === 'America/Bogota' ? '-05:00' : '-07:00';
}

function formatLocalIsoDateTime(
  date: Date,
  decimalHour: number,
  timeZone: string
): string {
  const totalMinutes = Math.round(decimalHour * 60);
  const hours = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60) % 24;
  const minutes = totalMinutes % 60;
  const yyyy = date.getFullYear();
  const mm = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const dd = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  const hh = String(hours).padStart(2, '0');
  const min = String(minutes).padStart(2, '0');
  const offset = getTimeZoneOffsetString(
    new Date(Date.UTC(yyyy, date.getMonth(), date.getDate(), 12, 0, 0)),
    timeZone
  );
  return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}T${hh}:${min}:00${offset}`;
}

function formatLocalIsoDate(date: Date): string {
  const yyyy = date.getFullYear();
  const mm = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const dd = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
}

export function buildEventJsonLd(
  event: Event,
  city: CityConfig,
  canonicalUrl: string,
  occurrence: NextOccurrenceResult | null
): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  const venueName = (event.venue || event.location || '').trim();
  if (!occurrence || (!venueName && !city.name)) {
    return null;
  }
  const timeZone = getCityTimeZone(city);
  const hasStartTime = Boolean((event.startTime || '').trim());
  const startHour = parseHour(event.startTime);
  const startDate = hasStartTime
    ? formatLocalIsoDateTime(occurrence.date, startHour, timeZone)
    : formatLocalIsoDate(occurrence.date);
  let endDate: string | undefined;
  if (hasStartTime && (event.endTime || '').trim()) {
    const endHour = parseHour(event.endTime);
    const endDay = new Date(occurrence.date);
    if (endHour < startHour) {
      endDay.setDate(endDay.getDate() + 1);
    }
    endDate = formatLocalIsoDateTime(endDay, endHour, timeZone);
  }
  const cleanOrg = (event.organization || '')
    .trim()
    .replace(/^hosted\s+by\s+/i, '')
    .trim();
  const venueUrl =
    venueName && event.venueUrl ? ensureExternalUrl(event.venueUrl) : '';
  const organizerUrl =
    cleanOrg && event.organizerUrl ? ensureExternalUrl(event.organizerUrl) : '';
  const registrationUrl = event.registrationUrl
    ? ensureExternalUrl(event.registrationUrl)
    : '';
  const priceConfig = getCityPriceConfig(city);
  const freeOrDonation = isFreeOrDonation(event.price);
  const numericPrice = freeOrDonation
    ? 0
    : parseEventPrice(event.price, priceConfig.currencyCode);
  const resolvedOfferPrice =
    numericPrice !== null
      ? priceConfig.currencyCode === 'COP' && !freeOrDonation
        ? Math.round(numericPrice * 1000)
        : numericPrice
      : null;
  const description = (event.about || event.notes || '').trim();
  const streetAddress = (event.location || '').trim();
  const jsonLd: Record<string, unknown> = {
    '@context': 'https://schema.org',
    '@type': 'Event',
    name: event.title.trim(),
    startDate,
    ...(endDate ? { endDate } : {}),
    eventAttendanceMode: 'https://schema.org/OfflineEventAttendanceMode',
    eventStatus: 'https://schema.org/EventScheduled',
    url: canonicalUrl,
    location: {
      '@type': 'Place',
      name: venueName || city.heroLocation,
      ...(venueUrl ? { url: venueUrl } : {}),
      address: {
        '@type': 'PostalAddress',
        ...(streetAddress ? { streetAddress } : {}),
        addressLocality: city.name,
        ...(city.region ? { addressRegion: city.region } : {}),
      },
    },
    ...(description ? { description } : {}),
    ...(cleanOrg
      ? {
          organizer: {
            '@type': 'Organization',
            name: cleanOrg,
            ...(organizerUrl ? { url: organizerUrl } : {}),
          },
        }
      : {}),
    ...(resolvedOfferPrice !== null
      ? {
          offers: {
            '@type': 'Offer',
            price: resolvedOfferPrice,
            priceCurrency: priceConfig.currencyCode,
            availability: 'https://schema.org/InStock',
            url: registrationUrl || canonicalUrl,
          },
        }
      : {}),
  };
  return jsonLd;
}

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { CityConfig, getCityTimeZone } from '../../../lib/cities';
import { Event } from '../../../lib/google-sheets';
import {
  formatTimeRange,
  getTagStyle,
  isFreePrice,
} from '../../../events/utils';
import {
  buildScheduleLine,
  getEventDisplayDetails,
} from '../../../events/event-helpers';
import Header from '../../../components/Header';
import Footer from '../../../components/Footer';
import EventActions from '../../../events/components/EventActions';
import EventFacts from '../../../events/components/EventFacts';
import InlineExternalLink from '../../../events/components/InlineExternalLink';
import SuggestEditModal from '../../../events/components/SuggestEditModal';
import {
  CalendarIcon,
  CompassIcon,
  PinIcon,
  TagIcon,
} from '../../../events/components/EventIcons';
import NextOccurrenceBadge from './NextOccurrenceBadge';
import styles from './EventDetail.module.css';

interface EventDetailViewProps {
  city: CityConfig;
  event: Event;
  initialNextLabel: string | null;
}

export default function EventDetailView({
  city,
  event,
  initialNextLabel,
}: EventDetailViewProps) {
  const [editModalOpen, setEditModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const timeZone = getCityTimeZone(city);
  const { start, end } = formatTimeRange(event.startTime, event.endTime);
  const scheduleSummary =
    buildScheduleLine(event) || (start && end ? `${start} – ${end}` : start);
  const {
    displayVenue,
    venueUrl,
    showDistinctAddress,
    organizerName,
    organizerUrl,
    showOrganizer,
    recurrenceText,
    preRegistrationText,
    registrationUrl,
    needsSignupIcon,
    mapsHref,
    moreDetailsUrl,
  } = getEventDisplayDetails(event, city.name);
  const isFree = isFreePrice(event.price);
  const tagList = event.activities || [];
  const hasMeta = Boolean(event.price || event.area || tagList.length > 0);
  const descriptionText = (event.about || event.notes || '').trim();
  const eyebrowText = event.area ? `${city.name} · ${event.area}` : city.name;

  return (
    <div className={styles.pageContainer}>
      <Header city={city} />
      <main className={styles.main}>
        <Link href={`/${city.slug}/events`} className={styles.backLink}>
          <span aria-hidden="true">←</span>
          <span>All {city.name} events</span>
        </Link>
        <article className={styles.card}>
          <div className={styles.head}>
            <p className={styles.eyebrow}>{eyebrowText}</p>
            <h1 className={styles.title}>{event.title}</h1>
            {(scheduleSummary || initialNextLabel) && (
              <div className={styles.scheduleRow}>
                {scheduleSummary && (
                  <span className={styles.scheduleText}>
                    <CalendarIcon className={styles.scheduleIcon} />
                    <span>{scheduleSummary}</span>
                  </span>
                )}
                <NextOccurrenceBadge
                  event={event}
                  timeZone={timeZone}
                  initialLabel={initialNextLabel}
                  className={styles.nextBadge}
                  todayClassName={styles.nextBadgeToday}
                />
              </div>
            )}
            {(displayVenue || showOrganizer) && (
              <div className={styles.venueBlock}>
                {displayVenue && (
                  <div className={styles.venue}>
                    <PinIcon className={styles.venueIcon} />
                    <InlineExternalLink href={venueUrl}>
                      {displayVenue}
                    </InlineExternalLink>
                  </div>
                )}
                {showDistinctAddress && (
                  <div className={styles.address}>{event.location}</div>
                )}
                {showOrganizer && (
                  <div
                    className={`${styles.host} ${
                      !displayVenue ? styles.hostFlush : ''
                    }`}
                  >
                    Hosted by{' '}
                    <InlineExternalLink
                      href={organizerUrl}
                      className={organizerUrl ? styles.hostLink : undefined}
                    >
                      {organizerName}
                    </InlineExternalLink>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
            {hasMeta && (
              <div className={styles.meta}>
                {event.price && (
                  <span
                    className={`${styles.price} ${
                      isFree ? styles.priceFree : styles.pricePaid
                    }`}
                  >
                    <TagIcon />
                    <span>{event.price}</span>
                  </span>
                )}
                {event.price && event.area && (
                  <span className={styles.dot} aria-hidden="true" />
                )}
                {event.area && (
                  <span className={styles.area}>
                    <CompassIcon />
                    <span>{event.area}</span>
                  </span>
                )}
                {(event.price || event.area) && tagList.length > 0 && (
                  <span className={`${styles.dot} ${styles.sep2}`} aria-hidden="true" />
                )}
                {tagList.length > 0 && (
                  <div className={styles.tags}>
                    {tagList.map((tag) => {
                      const customStyle = getTagStyle(tag);
                      return (
                        <span
                          key={tag}
                          className={styles.tag}
                          style={{
                            color: customStyle.color,
                            backgroundColor: customStyle.background,
                          }}
                        >
                          {tag}
                        </span>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className={styles.body}>
            {(descriptionText || moreDetailsUrl) && (
              <p className={styles.desc}>
                {descriptionText}
                {descriptionText && moreDetailsUrl ? ' ' : ''}
                {moreDetailsUrl && (
                  <InlineExternalLink
                    href={moreDetailsUrl}
                    className={styles.moreDetailsLink}
                  >
                    More details
                  </InlineExternalLink>
                )}
              </p>
            )}
            <EventFacts
              recurrenceText={recurrenceText}
              preRegistrationText={preRegistrationText}
              registrationUrl={registrationUrl}
              needsSignupIcon={needsSignupIcon}
              className={styles.facts}
            />
            <EventActions
              event={event}
              city={city}
              mapsHref={mapsHref}
              onOpenEdit={() => setEditModalOpen(true)}
            />
          </div>
        </article>
        <div className={styles.bottomCtaWrap}>
          <Link href={`/${city.slug}/events`} className={styles.bottomCta}>
            Explore all {city.name} events →
          </Link>
        </div>
      </main>
      <Footer city={city} />
      {editModalOpen && (
        <SuggestEditModal
          event={event}
          cityName={city.name}
          onClose={() => setEditModalOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

File: app/events/components/CityHeroCard.tsx

'use client';
import styles from './CityHeroCard.module.css';
interface CityHeroCardProps {
  cityName: string;
  introTitle?: string;
  introDescription?: string;
  eventCount?: number;
  lastUpdated?: string | null;
  activities: string[];
  selectedActivities: string[];
  onSelectChip: (activity: string) => void;
  onClearActivities: () => void;
}
export default function CityHeroCard({
  cityName,
  introTitle,
  introDescription,
  eventCount,
  lastUpdated,
  activities,
  selectedActivities,
  onSelectChip,
  onClearActivities,
}: CityHeroCardProps) {
  const isAllActive = selectedActivities.length === 0;
  return (
    <section className={styles.heroCard} aria-labelledby="city-intro-heading">
      <div className={styles.titleCol}>
        <p className={styles.eyebrow}>Someplace Social</p>
        <h1 id="city-intro-heading" className={styles.title}>
          {introTitle || `${cityName} Community Listings`}
        </h1>
        {((typeof eventCount === 'number' && eventCount > 0) || lastUpdated) && (
          <div className={styles.metaRow}>
            {typeof eventCount === 'number' && eventCount > 0 && (
              <span className={styles.metaSubtitle}>
                {eventCount} {eventCount === 1 ? 'Event & Activity' : 'Events & Activities'}
              </span>
            )}
            {lastUpdated && (
              <div className={styles.lastUpdatedBadge}>
                <svg
                  className={styles.lastUpdatedIcon}
                  width="14"
                  height="14"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  fill="none"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth="2.4"
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                >
                  <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
                  <path d="M9 12.5l2 2 4-4.5" />
                </svg>
                <span className={styles.lastUpdatedLabel}>Last updated:</span>
                <span className={styles.lastUpdatedDate}>{lastUpdated}</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.descCol}>
        <p className={styles.lead}>
          {introDescription ||
            `Regular community events, weekly activities, and recurring meetups all in one place. Find things to do including weekly meetups, classes, and fun stuff to do in ${cityName}.`}
        </p>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.chips} role="group" aria-label="Filter by activity">
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`${styles.chip} ${isAllActive ? styles.chipActive : ''}`}
          aria-pressed={isAllActive}
          onClick={onClearActivities}
        >
          All
        </button>
        {activities.map((act) => {
          const isSelected = selectedActivities.includes(act);
          return (
            <button
              key={act}
              type="button"
              className={`${styles.chip} ${isSelected ? styles.chipActive : ''}`}
              aria-pressed={isSelected}
              onClick={() => onSelectChip(act)}
            >
              {act}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

================
File: app/events/components/FilterControls.tsx
================
'use client';
import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo, memo } from 'react';
import FilterDropdown from './FilterDropdown';
import PriceFilterDropdown from './PriceFilterDropdown';
import { CityPriceConfig } from '../../lib/cities';
import styles from './FilterControls.module.css';

interface FilterControlsProps {
  searchQuery: string;
  onSearchChange: (query: string) => void;
  priceConfig: CityPriceConfig;
  maxPrice: number;
  onPriceChange: (val: number) => void;
  timeSections: string[];
  selectedTimes: string[];
  onToggleTime: (timeName: string) => void;
  onClearTimes: () => void;
  activities: string[];
  selectedActivities: string[];
  onToggleActivity: (act: string) => void;
  onClearActivities: () => void;
  areas: string[];
  selectedAreas: string[];
  onToggleArea: (ar: string) => void;
  onClearAreas: () => void;
  hasActiveFilters: boolean;
  onClearAllFilters: () => void;
}

const activityIcon = (
  <svg
    width="16"
    height="16"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    strokeWidth="2.4"
    strokeLinecap="round"
    strokeLinejoin="round"
    aria-hidden="true"
  >
    <path d="M4 6h16M7 12h10M10 18h4" />
  </svg>
);

const timeIcon = (
  <svg
    width="16"
    height="16"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    strokeWidth="2.2"
    strokeLinecap="round"
    strokeLinejoin="round"
    aria-hidden="true"
  >
    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" />
    <polyline points="12 7 12 12 15 14" />
  </svg>
);

const areaIcon = (
  <svg
    width="16"
    height="16"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    strokeWidth="2.2"
    strokeLinecap="round"
    strokeLinejoin="round"
    aria-hidden="true"
  >
    <path d="M12 21s-6-5.5-6-10a6 6 0 1 1 12 0c0 4.5-6 10-6 10z" />
    <circle cx="12" cy="11" r="2.5" />
  </svg>
);

const filterSliderIcon = (
  <svg
    width="16"
    height="16"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    strokeWidth="2.2"
    strokeLinecap="round"
    strokeLinejoin="round"
    aria-hidden="true"
  >
    <line x1="4" y1="21" x2="4" y2="14" />
    <line x1="4" y1="10" x2="4" y2="3" />
    <line x1="12" y1="21" x2="12" y2="12" />
    <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="3" />
    <line x1="20" y1="21" x2="20" y2="16" />
    <line x1="20" y1="12" x2="20" y2="3" />
    <line x1="1" y1="14" x2="7" y2="14" />
    <line x1="9" y1="8" x2="15" y2="8" />
    <line x1="17" y1="16" x2="23" y2="16" />
  </svg>
);

function FilterControls({
  searchQuery,
  onSearchChange,
  priceConfig,
  maxPrice,
  onPriceChange,
  timeSections,
  selectedTimes,
  onToggleTime,
  onClearTimes,
  activities,
  selectedActivities,
  onToggleActivity,
  onClearActivities,
  areas,
  selectedAreas,
  onToggleArea,
  onClearAreas,
  hasActiveFilters,
  onClearAllFilters,
}: FilterControlsProps) {
  const [mobileAccordionOpen, setMobileAccordionOpen] = useState(false);
  const [priceMenuOpen, setPriceMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [timeMenuOpen, setTimeMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [actMenuOpen, setActMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [areaMenuOpen, setAreaMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const priceMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const priceMobileMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const timeMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const timeMobileMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const actMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const actMobileMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const areaMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const areaMobileMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      const target = e.target as Node;
      if (
        priceMenuRef.current &&
        !priceMenuRef.current.contains(target) &&
        (!priceMobileMenuRef.current || !priceMobileMenuRef.current.contains(target))
      ) {
        setPriceMenuOpen(false);
      }
      if (
        timeMenuRef.current &&
        !timeMenuRef.current.contains(target) &&
        (!timeMobileMenuRef.current || !timeMobileMenuRef.current.contains(target))
      ) {
        setTimeMenuOpen(false);
      }
      if (
        actMenuRef.current &&
        !actMenuRef.current.contains(target) &&
        (!actMobileMenuRef.current || !actMobileMenuRef.current.contains(target))
      ) {
        setActMenuOpen(false);
      }
      if (
        areaMenuRef.current &&
        !areaMenuRef.current.contains(target) &&
        (!areaMobileMenuRef.current || !areaMobileMenuRef.current.contains(target))
      ) {
        setAreaMenuOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  const activeFilterCount = useMemo(() => {
    let count = 0;
    if (searchQuery.trim().length > 0) count++;
    if (maxPrice < priceConfig.maxPrice) count++;
    count += selectedTimes.length;
    count += selectedActivities.length;
    count += selectedAreas.length;
    return count;
  }, [
    searchQuery,
    maxPrice,
    priceConfig.maxPrice,
    selectedTimes.length,
    selectedActivities.length,
    selectedAreas.length,
  ]);

  const timeValue = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedTimes.length === 0) return 'All';
    if (selectedTimes.length === 1) return selectedTimes[0];
    return `${selectedTimes.length} selected`;
  }, [selectedTimes]);

  const activityValue = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedActivities.length === 0) return 'All';
    if (selectedActivities.length === 1) return selectedActivities[0];
    return `${selectedActivities.length} selected`;
  }, [selectedActivities]);

  const areaValue = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedAreas.length === 0) return 'All';
    if (selectedAreas.length === 1) return selectedAreas[0];
    return `${selectedAreas.length} selected`;
  }, [selectedAreas]);

  const renderSearchInput = () => (
    <div className={styles.searchWrapper}>
      <svg
        className={styles.searchIcon}
        width="16"
        height="16"
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        strokeWidth="2.2"
        strokeLinecap="round"
        strokeLinejoin="round"
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8" />
        <path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35" />
      </svg>
      <input
        type="text"
        value={searchQuery}
        onChange={(e) => onSearchChange(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Search events, places, tags..."
        className={styles.searchInput}
        aria-label="Search events"
        autoComplete="off"
        spellCheck={false}
      />
      {searchQuery && (
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.searchClearBtn}
          onClick={() => onSearchChange('')}
          aria-label="Clear search query"
        >
          <svg
            width="13"
            height="13"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="2.5"
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          >
            <path d="M18 6L6 18M6 6l12 12" />
          </svg>
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.filterBlockDesktop}>
        <div className={styles.filterHeaderRow}>
          <span className={styles.filterTitle}>Filters</span>
          {hasActiveFilters && (
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.clearFiltersLink}
              onClick={onClearAllFilters}
            >
              Reset all
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.filterListVertical}>
          {renderSearchInput()}
          <FilterDropdown
            icon={activityIcon}
            category="Activity"
            value={activityValue}
            title="Select activities"
            options={activities}
            selected={selectedActivities}
            isOpen={actMenuOpen}
            onToggleOpen={() => setActMenuOpen(!actMenuOpen)}
            onToggleOption={onToggleActivity}
            onClear={onClearActivities}
            containerRef={actMenuRef}
          />
          <FilterDropdown
            icon={timeIcon}
            category="Time"
            value={timeValue}
            title="Time of day"
            options={timeSections}
            selected={selectedTimes}
            isOpen={timeMenuOpen}
            onToggleOpen={() => setTimeMenuOpen(!timeMenuOpen)}
            onToggleOption={onToggleTime}
            onClear={onClearTimes}
            containerRef={timeMenuRef}
          />
          <FilterDropdown
            icon={areaIcon}
            category="Area"
            value={areaValue}
            title="Select areas"
            options={areas}
            selected={selectedAreas}
            isOpen={areaMenuOpen}
            onToggleOpen={() => setAreaMenuOpen(!areaMenuOpen)}
            onToggleOption={onToggleArea}
            onClear={onClearAreas}
            containerRef={areaMenuRef}
          />
          <PriceFilterDropdown
            priceConfig={priceConfig}
            maxPrice={maxPrice}
            onPriceChange={onPriceChange}
            isOpen={priceMenuOpen}
            onToggleOpen={() => setPriceMenuOpen(!priceMenuOpen)}
            containerRef={priceMenuRef}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className={styles.mobileAccordionWrapper}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={`${styles.mobileAccordionTrigger} ${
            mobileAccordionOpen ? styles.mobileAccordionTriggerOpen : ''
          }`}
          onClick={() => setMobileAccordionOpen((prev) => !prev)}
          aria-expanded={mobileAccordionOpen}
          aria-controls="mobile-filters-content"
        >
          <div className={styles.mobileTriggerLeft}>
            <span className={styles.mobileTriggerIcon}>{filterSliderIcon}</span>
            <span className={styles.mobileTriggerText}>Filters &amp; Search</span>
            {activeFilterCount > 0 && (
              <span className={styles.mobileActiveBadge}>
                {activeFilterCount}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className={styles.mobileTriggerRight}>
            <span className={styles.mobileTriggerStatus}>
              {mobileAccordionOpen ? 'Hide' : activeFilterCount > 0 ? 'Edit' : 'Show'}
            </span>
            <svg
              className={`${styles.mobileAccordionChevron} ${
                mobileAccordionOpen ? styles.mobileAccordionChevronOpen : ''
              }`}
              width="15"
              height="15"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2.4"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              aria-hidden="true"
            >
              <path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" />
            </svg>
          </div>
        </button>
        {mobileAccordionOpen && (
          <div id="mobile-filters-content" className={styles.mobileAccordionContent}>
            {renderSearchInput()}
            <div className={styles.mobileFiltersRow}>
              <FilterDropdown
                icon={activityIcon}
                category="Activity"
                value={activityValue}
                title="Activities"
                options={activities}
                selected={selectedActivities}
                isOpen={actMenuOpen}
                onToggleOpen={() => setActMenuOpen(!actMenuOpen)}
                onToggleOption={onToggleActivity}
                onClear={onClearActivities}
                containerRef={actMobileMenuRef}
                flexStyle
              />
              <FilterDropdown
                icon={timeIcon}
                category="Time"
                value={timeValue}
                title="Time of day"
                options={timeSections}
                selected={selectedTimes}
                isOpen={timeMenuOpen}
                onToggleOpen={() => setTimeMenuOpen(!timeMenuOpen)}
                onToggleOption={onToggleTime}
                onClear={onClearTimes}
                containerRef={timeMobileMenuRef}
                flexStyle
              />
              <FilterDropdown
                icon={areaIcon}
                category="Area"
                value={areaValue}
                title="Areas"
                options={areas}
                selected={selectedAreas}
                isOpen={areaMenuOpen}
                onToggleOpen={() => setAreaMenuOpen(!areaMenuOpen)}
                onToggleOption={onToggleArea}
                onClear={onClearAreas}
                containerRef={areaMobileMenuRef}
                flexStyle
              />
              <PriceFilterDropdown
                priceConfig={priceConfig}
                maxPrice={maxPrice}
                onPriceChange={onPriceChange}
                isOpen={priceMenuOpen}
                onToggleOpen={() => setPriceMenuOpen(!priceMenuOpen)}
                containerRef={priceMobileMenuRef}
                flexStyle
              />
            </div>
            {hasActiveFilters && (
              <div className={styles.mobileClearRow}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className={styles.clearFiltersBtn}
                  onClick={onClearAllFilters}
                >
                  Reset all filters ({activeFilterCount})
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
export default memo(FilterControls);

================
File: app/layout.tsx

import type { Metadata, Viewport } from 'next';
import { Bricolage_Grotesque, Karla } from 'next/font/google';
import './globals.css';
import { Analytics } from '@vercel/analytics/next';
import ThemeScript from './components/ThemeScript';
const bricolage = Bricolage_Grotesque({
  subsets: ['latin'],
  weight: ['500', '700', '800'],
  variable: '--font-bricolage',
  display: 'swap',
});
const karla = Karla({
  subsets: ['latin'],
  weight: ['400', '500', '700'],
  variable: '--font-karla',
  display: 'swap',
});
export const viewport: Viewport = {
  width: 'device-width',
  initialScale: 1,
  maximumScale: 5,
};
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  metadataBase: new URL('https://www.someplacesocial.org'),
  title: {
    default: 'Someplace Social | Community Event Listings',
    template: '%s | Someplace Social',
  },
  description:
    'Regular community events, weekly activities, and recurring meetups all in one place. Find things to do including traveler friendly language exchanges, free salsa classes, and more.',
  icons: {
    icon: '/icon.png',
    apple: '/apple-icon.png',
  },
  robots: {
    index: true,
    follow: true,
    googleBot: {
      index: true,
      follow: true,
      'max-video-preview': -1,
      'max-image-preview': 'large',
      'max-snippet': -1,
    },
  },
  openGraph: {
    title: 'Someplace Social | Community Event Listings',
    description:
      'Regular community events, weekly activities, and recurring meetups all in one place. Find things to do including traveler friendly language exchanges, free salsa classes, and more.',
    url: 'https://www.someplacesocial.org',
    siteName: 'Someplace Social',
    locale: 'en_US',
    type: 'website',
  },
};
export default function RootLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" className={`${bricolage.variable} ${karla.variable}`} suppressHydrationWarning>
      <body>
        <ThemeScript />
        {children}
        <Analytics />
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}

================
File: app/contact/ContactView.tsx
================
'use client';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { useRouter, useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';
import { CityConfig } from '../lib/cities';
import ContactMessageForm from './components/ContactMessageForm';
import EventSubmissionForm from './components/EventSubmissionForm';
import styles from './Contact.module.css';
interface ContactViewProps {
  city?: CityConfig;
}
export default function ContactView({ city }: ContactViewProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const tabParam = searchParams.get('tab');
  const activeTab: 'question' | 'submit' =
    tabParam === 'submit' || tabParam === 'event' ? 'submit' : 'question';
  const basePath = city ? `/${city.slug}/contact` : '/contact';
  return (
    <main className={styles.page}>
      <section className={styles.hero}>
        <div className={styles.heroText}>
          <p className={styles.eyebrow}>CONTACT</p>
          <h1 className={styles.heroTitle}>Contact Us</h1>
          <p className={styles.heroDescription}>
            Have an event to share, or a question, comment, or suggestion? Use the forms below and we&apos;ll get back to you.
          </p>
          <div className={styles.pillGroup} role="tablist" aria-label="Contact options">
            <button
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              id="tab-question"
              aria-selected={activeTab === 'question'}
              aria-controls="panel-question"
              className={`${styles.pillBtn} ${activeTab === 'question' ? styles.pillBtnActive : ''}`}
              onClick={() => {
                router.replace(basePath, { scroll: false });
              }}
            >
              Send a Message
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              id="tab-submit"
              aria-selected={activeTab === 'submit'}
              aria-controls="panel-submit"
              className={`${styles.pillBtn} ${activeTab === 'submit' ? styles.pillBtnActive : ''}`}
              onClick={() => {
                router.replace(`${basePath}?tab=submit`, { scroll: false });
              }}
            >
              Submit an Event
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.heroImageContainer}>
          <Image
            src="/images/hero-contact.png"
            alt="Illustration of a capybara drinking coffee"
            width={340}
            height={260}
            priority
            className={styles.heroImage}
          />
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className={styles.panel}>
        {activeTab === 'question' ? (
          <ContactMessageForm cityName={city?.heroLocation} />
        ) : (
          <EventSubmissionForm
            key={city?.slug || 'global'}
            defaultCity={city?.heroLocation}
          />
        )}
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

  .mobileDayNum {
    font-family: var(--font-bricolage), system-ui, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 19px;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }

    font-size: 10.5px;
    font-weight: 500;

    line-height: 1;
  }
  .mobileDayBtnActive .mobileDayCount {
    color: var(--bg);
    opacity: 0.85;
  }
  .contentCol {
    width: 100%;
    flex: none;
  }
  .timeGroupHeader {
    margin: 18px 0 8px;
  }
}

================
File: app/lib/google-sheets.ts
================
import { CityConfig, CITIES, MAIN_SPREADSHEET_ID } from './cities';
import { normalizeDayOfWeek } from '../events/utils';
import { expandEventSchedules } from '../events/schedule-splitter';

export type Event = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  venue: string;
  venueUrl: string;
  organization: string;
  organizerUrl: string;
  location: string;
  area: string;
  activity: string;
  activities: string[];
  dayOfWeek: string;
  startTime: string;
  endTime: string;
  frequency: string;
  frequencyNotes: string;
  price: string;
  preRegistration: string;
  registrationUrl: string;
  map: string;
  contact: string;
  url1: string;
  url1Notes: string;
  url2: string;
  url2Notes: string;
  about: string;
  notes: string;
  database: string;
};

function getFetchOptions(revalidateSeconds: number = 30): RequestInit {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
    return { cache: 'no-store' };
  }
  return { next: { revalidate: revalidateSeconds } };
}

function getCandidateUrls(city: CityConfig, discoveredGid: string | null): string[] {
  if (city.csvUrl) return [city.csvUrl];
  const targetId = city.spreadsheetId || MAIN_SPREADSHEET_ID;
  const urls: string[] = [];
  const addUrl = (url: string) => {
    if (!urls.includes(url)) {
      urls.push(url);
    }
  };
  if (discoveredGid) {
    addUrl(
      `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/export?format=csv&gid=${discoveredGid}`
    );
  }
  if (city.sheetGid) {
    addUrl(
      `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/export?format=csv&gid=${city.sheetGid}`
    );
  }
  addUrl(
    `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=${encodeURIComponent(
      city.sheetTab
    )}`
  );
  const fallbackGid = discoveredGid || city.sheetGid;
  if (fallbackGid) {
    addUrl(
      `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=${fallbackGid}`
    );
  }
  return urls;
}

function parseCsv(csvText: string): string[][] {
  const rows: string[][] = [];
  let currentRow: string[] = [];
  let currentField = '';
  let inQuotes = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < csvText.length; i++) {
    const char = csvText[i];
    if (char === '"') {
      if (inQuotes && csvText[i + 1] === '"') {
        currentField += '"';
        i++;
      } else {
        inQuotes = !inQuotes;
      }
    } else if (char === ',' && !inQuotes) {
      currentRow.push(currentField);
      currentField = '';
    } else if ((char === '\n' || char === '\r') && !inQuotes) {
      currentRow.push(currentField);
      rows.push(currentRow);
      currentRow = [];
      currentField = '';
      if (char === '\r' && csvText[i + 1] === '\n') {
        i++;
      }
    } else {
      currentField += char;
    }
  }
  currentRow.push(currentField);
  rows.push(currentRow);
  return rows;
}

function parseSheetData(rawText: string): string[][] {
  const trimmed = rawText.trim();
  if (trimmed.includes('google.visualization.Query.setResponse') || trimmed.startsWith('/*O_o*/')) {
    try {
      const startIdx = trimmed.indexOf('{');
      const endIdx = trimmed.lastIndexOf('}');
      if (startIdx !== -1 && endIdx !== -1) {
        const jsonStr = trimmed.substring(startIdx, endIdx + 1);
        const data = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
        if (data.status === 'error') {
          return [];
        }
        if (data.table) {
          const cols: { label?: string; id?: string }[] = data.table.cols || [];
          const headerRow: string[] = cols.map((col) => col.label || col.id || '');
          const dataRows: string[][] = (data.table.rows || []).map(
            (row: { c?: ({ v?: unknown; f?: string } | null)[] }) => {
              return (row.c || []).map((cell) => {
                if (!cell || (cell.v === null && !cell.f) || (cell.v === undefined && !cell.f)) {
                  return '';
                }
                return String(cell.f ?? cell.v ?? '').trim();
              });
            }
          );
          if (headerRow.some((h: string) => Boolean(h && !h.match(/^[A-Z]$/)))) {
            return [headerRow, ...dataRows];
          } else if (dataRows.length > 0) {
            return dataRows;
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[Someplace Social] Failed to parse GViz JSON, falling back to CSV parser:', e);
    }
  }
  return parseCsv(rawText);
}

async function fetchValidSheetText(url: string, revalidateSeconds: number = 30): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      headers: {
        Accept: 'text/csv, application/json, text/plain, */*',
      },
      ...getFetchOptions(revalidateSeconds),
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
      console.warn(`[Someplace Social] Sheet request returned HTTP ${response.status} for ${url}`);
      return null;
    }
    const text = await response.text();
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    if (!trimmed) {
      console.warn(`[Someplace Social] Empty sheet response from ${url}`);
      return null;
    }
    const lowerPrefix = trimmed.slice(0, 200).toLowerCase();
    if (
      lowerPrefix.startsWith('<!doctype html') ||
      lowerPrefix.startsWith('<html') ||
      trimmed.includes('accounts.google.com')
    ) {
      console.warn(
        `[Someplace Social] Received HTML/sign-in page for ${url}. Verify spreadsheet ID and "Anyone with the link" sharing.`
      );
      return null;
    }
    if (trimmed.includes('"status":"error"') || trimmed.includes('INVALID_QUERY')) {
      console.warn(`[Someplace Social] GViz query error for ${url}`);
      return null;
    }
    return trimmed;
  } catch (fetchErr) {
    console.warn(`[Someplace Social] Fetch error on ${url}:`, fetchErr);
  }
  return null;
}

async function fetchSheetRows(candidateUrls: string[], revalidateSeconds: number = 30): Promise<string[][]> {
  for (const url of candidateUrls) {
    const text = await fetchValidSheetText(url, revalidateSeconds);
    if (!text) continue;
    const parsed = parseSheetData(text);
    if (parsed.length >= 2) {
      return parsed;
    }
  }
  return [];
}

const normalizeHeader = (header: string): string =>
  header
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');

const normalizeCityKey = (value: string): string =>
  value
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .trim();

function formatSheetDate(value: string): string {
  const gvizDateMatch = value.match(/^Date\((\d{4}),\s*(\d{1,2}),\s*(\d{1,2})\)$/);
  if (gvizDateMatch) {
    const year = parseInt(gvizDateMatch[1], 10);
    const month = parseInt(gvizDateMatch[2], 10);
    const day = parseInt(gvizDateMatch[3], 10);
    const date = new Date(year, month, day);
    return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      year: 'numeric',
    });
  }
  return value;
}

function parseLastUpdatedRows(rows: string[][]): Map<string, string> | null {
  if (rows.length < 2) return null;
  const headerRow = rows[0].map((h) => normalizeHeader(h));
  const dateColIdx = headerRow.findIndex((h) =>
    ['lastupdateddate', 'lastupdated', 'updateddate', 'lastupdate'].includes(h)
  );
  const cityColIdx = headerRow.findIndex((h) => h === 'city');
  if (dateColIdx === -1 || cityColIdx === -1) {
    return null;
  }
  const map = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const row of rows.slice(1)) {
    const rawDate = (row[dateColIdx] || '').trim();
    const rawCity = (row[cityColIdx] || '').trim();
    if (!rawDate || !rawCity || rawDate.toLowerCase() === 'x') continue;
    map.set(normalizeCityKey(rawCity), formatSheetDate(rawDate));
  }
  return map.size > 0 ? map : null;
}

function findTabGidInHtml(html: string, tabNames: string[]): string | null {
  const targets = new Set(tabNames.map((n) => normalizeHeader(n)));
  const itemNameFirstRegex = /\{[^{}]*?name:\s*["']([^"']+)["'][^{}]*?gid:\s*["'](\d+)["']/gi;
  let match: RegExpExecArray | null;
  while ((match = itemNameFirstRegex.exec(html)) !== null) {
    if (targets.has(normalizeHeader(match[1]))) {
      return match[2];
    }
  }
  const itemGidFirstRegex = /\{[^{}]*?gid:\s*["'](\d+)["'][^{}]*?name:\s*["']([^"']+)["']/gi;
  while ((match = itemGidFirstRegex.exec(html)) !== null) {
    if (targets.has(normalizeHeader(match[2]))) {
      return match[1];
    }
  }
  const buttonRegex = /id=["']sheet-button-(\d+)["'][^>]*>[\s\S]{0,120}?<a[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/a>/gi;
  while ((match = buttonRegex.exec(html)) !== null) {
    if (targets.has(normalizeHeader(match[2]))) {
      return match[1];
    }
  }
  return null;
}

async function discoverTabGid(
  targetId: string,
  tabNames: string[],
  revalidateSeconds: number = 30
): Promise<string | null> {
  const htmlviewUrl = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/htmlview`;
  try {
    const response = await fetch(htmlviewUrl, getFetchOptions(revalidateSeconds));
    if (!response.ok) {
      console.warn(`[Someplace Social] htmlview returned HTTP ${response.status} for ${targetId}`);
      return null;
    }
    const html = await response.text();
    if (!html || html.includes('accounts.google.com')) {
      console.warn(
        `[Someplace Social] htmlview redirected to Google login for ${targetId}. Verify "Anyone with the link" sharing.`
      );
      return null;
    }
    return findTabGidInHtml(html, tabNames);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[Someplace Social] Failed to inspect sheet tabs for ${targetId}:`, err);
    return null;
  }
}

const HEADER_ALIASES: Record<string, string[]> = {
  id: ['id'],
  title: ['title', 'eventname', 'name'],
  venue: ['venue', 'place'],
  venueUrl: ['venueurl', 'venuelink', 'placeurl'],
  organization: ['organization', 'organizer', 'host', 'hostedby', 'organizerhost', 'hostorganization'],
  organizerUrl: [
    'organizerurl',
    'organizationurl',
    'hosturl',
    'organizerlink',
    'organizationlink',
    'hostlink',
  ],
  location: ['location', 'address'],
  area: ['area', 'neighborhood'],
  activity: ['activity', 'activities'],
  activity1: ['activity1', 'activity'],
  activity2: ['activity2'],
  activity3: ['activity3'],
  dayOfWeek: ['dayofweek', 'day', 'days', 'daysofweek'],
  startTime: ['starttime', 'start'],
  endTime: ['endtime', 'end'],
  frequency: ['frequency', 'cadence', 'recurrence', 'howoften'],
  frequencyNotes: [
    'frequencynotes',
    'frequencynote',
    'frequency_notes',
    'freqnotes',
    'freqnote',
    'frequencynot',
    'recurrencenotes',
  ],
  price: ['price', 'cost'],
  preRegistration: ['preregistration', 'prereg', 'registration', 'rsvp', 'preregister'],
  registrationUrl: [
    'registrationurl',
    'preregistrationurl',
    'preregurl',
    'rsvpurl',
    'regurl',
    'registrationlink',
    'preregistrationlink',
    'rsvplink',
  ],
  map: ['map', 'googlemap', 'googlemaplink', 'maps'],
  contact: ['contact', 'whatsapp', 'phone'],
  url1: ['url1', 'primaryurl', 'mainurl'],
  url1Notes: ['url1notes', 'url1note'],
  url2: ['url2', 'secondaryurl'],
  url2Notes: ['url2notes', 'url2note'],
  about: ['about', 'description'],
  notes: ['notes', 'note'],
  database: ['database', 'db', 'sheet'],
};

export async function getLastUpdated(
  city: CityConfig,
  revalidateSeconds: number = 30
): Promise<string | null> {
  try {
    const targetId = city.spreadsheetId || MAIN_SPREADSHEET_ID;
    const tabNames = ['LastUpdate', 'Last Update'];
    const discoveredGid = await discoverTabGid(targetId, tabNames, revalidateSeconds);
    const candidateUrls: string[] = [];
    if (discoveredGid) {
      candidateUrls.push(
        `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/export?format=csv&gid=${discoveredGid}`,
        `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=${discoveredGid}`
      );
    }
    for (const tabName of tabNames) {
      candidateUrls.push(
        `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${targetId}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=${encodeURIComponent(
          tabName
        )}`
      );
    }
    let cityDateMap: Map<string, string> | null = null;
    for (const url of candidateUrls) {
      const text = await fetchValidSheetText(url, revalidateSeconds);
      if (!text) continue;
      const parsedMap = parseLastUpdatedRows(parseSheetData(text));
      if (parsedMap) {
        cityDateMap = parsedMap;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!cityDateMap) {
      return null;
    }
    return (
      cityDateMap.get(normalizeCityKey(city.sheetTab)) ??
      cityDateMap.get(normalizeCityKey(city.name)) ??
      cityDateMap.get(normalizeCityKey(city.slug)) ??
      null
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching last updated date:', error);
    return null;
  }
}

export async function getEvents(
  cityOrTab?: CityConfig | string,
  revalidateSeconds: number = 30
): Promise<Event[]> {
  try {
    let cityConfig: CityConfig;
    if (typeof cityOrTab === 'string') {
      cityConfig = CITIES[cityOrTab] || {
        slug: cityOrTab.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-'),
        name: cityOrTab,
        region: '',
        heroLocation: cityOrTab,
        timeZone: 'America/Denver',
        sheetTab: cityOrTab,
      };
    } else if (cityOrTab) {
      cityConfig = cityOrTab;
    } else {
      cityConfig = CITIES['medellin-colombia'];
    }
    const targetId = cityConfig.spreadsheetId || MAIN_SPREADSHEET_ID;
    const discoveredGid = cityConfig.csvUrl
      ? null
      : await discoverTabGid(targetId, [cityConfig.sheetTab], revalidateSeconds);
    const candidateUrls = getCandidateUrls(cityConfig, discoveredGid);
    const rows = await fetchSheetRows(candidateUrls, revalidateSeconds);
    if (rows.length < 2) {
      console.error(`[Someplace Social] No live sheet data found for ${cityConfig.sheetTab} (${targetId})`);
      return [];
    }
    const headerRow = rows[0].map((h: string) => normalizeHeader(h));
    const headerIndexMap: Record<string, number> = {};
    Object.keys(HEADER_ALIASES).forEach((field) => {
      const aliases = HEADER_ALIASES[field];
      const foundIdx = headerRow.findIndex((h: string) => aliases.includes(h));
      if (foundIdx !== -1) {
        headerIndexMap[field] = foundIdx;
      }
    });
    if (Object.keys(headerIndexMap).length === 0) {
      console.error(`[Someplace Social] Missing recognizable header row for ${cityConfig.sheetTab} (${targetId})`);
      return [];
    }
    const cleanCell = (cell: string): string => {
      const trimmed = (cell || '').trim();
      return trimmed.toLowerCase() === 'x' ? '' : trimmed;
    };
    const dataRows = rows.slice(1);
    const events = dataRows
      .map((row): Event | null => {
        if (row.length === 0 || row.every((cell) => cleanCell(cell) === '')) return null;
        const getValue = (field: string): string => {
          const colIdx = headerIndexMap[field];
          if (colIdx !== undefined && colIdx < row.length) {
            return cleanCell(row[colIdx]);
          }
          return '';
        };
        const rawActivity = getValue('activity');
        const act1 = getValue('activity1');
        const act2 = getValue('activity2');
        const act3 = getValue('activity3');
        let parsedActivities: string[] = [];
        if (rawActivity) {
          parsedActivities = rawActivity.split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        }
        if (parsedActivities.length === 0) {
          parsedActivities = [act1, act2, act3]
            .flatMap((s) => (s ? s.split(',').map((x) => x.trim()) : []))
            .filter(Boolean);
        }
        const uniqueActs: string[] = [];
        for (const act of parsedActivities) {
          if (!uniqueActs.some((u) => u.toLowerCase() === act.toLowerCase())) {
            uniqueActs.push(act);
          }
        }
        const activityStr = uniqueActs.join(', ');
        const rawDay = getValue('dayOfWeek');
        const dayOfWeekStr = normalizeDayOfWeek(rawDay);
        return {
          id: getValue('id'),
          title: getValue('title'),
          venue: getValue('venue'),
          venueUrl: getValue('venueUrl'),
          organization: getValue('organization'),
          organizerUrl: getValue('organizerUrl'),
          location: getValue('location'),
          area: getValue('area'),
          activity: activityStr,
          activities: uniqueActs,
          dayOfWeek: dayOfWeekStr,
          startTime: getValue('startTime'),
          endTime: getValue('endTime'),
          frequency: getValue('frequency'),
          frequencyNotes: getValue('frequencyNotes'),
          price: getValue('price'),
          preRegistration: getValue('preRegistration'),
          registrationUrl: getValue('registrationUrl'),
          map: getValue('map'),
          contact: getValue('contact'),
          url1: getValue('url1'),
          url1Notes: getValue('url1Notes'),
          url2: getValue('url2'),
          url2Notes: getValue('url2Notes'),
          about: getValue('about'),
          notes: getValue('notes'),
          database: getValue('database'),
        };
      })
      .filter((event): event is Event => event !== null);
    return events
      .filter((event) => Boolean(event.title))
      .flatMap(expandEventSchedules);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error fetching events:', error);
    return [];
  }
}

================
File: app/events/utils.test.ts
