import { describe, it } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { isEventActiveOnDate, isMonthActive } from './utils';
import { expandEventSchedules } from './schedule-splitter';
import { makeEvent } from './test-fixtures';

const jan2Fri = new Date(2026, 0, 2);
const jan3Sat = new Date(2026, 0, 3);
const jan4Sun = new Date(2026, 0, 4);
const jan5Mon = new Date(2026, 0, 5);
const jan7Wed = new Date(2026, 0, 7);
const jan9Fri = new Date(2026, 0, 9);
const jan12Mon = new Date(2026, 0, 12);
const jan16Fri = new Date(2026, 0, 16);
const jan23Fri = new Date(2026, 0, 23);
const jan25Sun = new Date(2026, 0, 25);
const jan30Fri = new Date(2026, 0, 30);
const feb3Tue = new Date(2026, 1, 3);
const feb4Wed = new Date(2026, 1, 4);
const feb5Thu = new Date(2026, 1, 5);
const feb6Fri = new Date(2026, 1, 6);
const feb10Tue = new Date(2026, 1, 10);
const feb13Fri = new Date(2026, 1, 13);
const feb17Tue = new Date(2026, 1, 17);
const feb18Wed = new Date(2026, 1, 18);
const feb19Thu = new Date(2026, 1, 19);
const feb20Fri = new Date(2026, 1, 20);
const feb27Fri = new Date(2026, 1, 27);
const mar3Tue = new Date(2026, 2, 3);
const mar17Tue = new Date(2026, 2, 17);
const mar31Tue = new Date(2026, 2, 31);

describe('isEventActiveOnDate frequency parsing', () => {
  it('handles Weekly and Weekly, Sat & Sun', () => {
    const weeklyFri = makeEvent({ frequency: 'Weekly', dayOfWeek: 'Fri' });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(weeklyFri, jan2Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(weeklyFri, jan9Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(weeklyFri, jan3Sat), false);
    const weekendEv = makeEvent({ frequency: 'Weekly, Sat & Sun', dayOfWeek: 'Sat, Sun' });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(weekendEv, jan3Sat), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(weekendEv, jan4Sun), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(weekendEv, jan5Mon), false);
  });
  it('handles Twice-weekly with Mon & Wed and Twice-weekly, Wed & Fri', () => {
    const monWed = makeEvent({ frequency: 'Twice-weekly', dayOfWeek: 'Mon & Wed' });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(monWed, jan5Mon), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(monWed, jan7Wed), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(monWed, jan2Fri), false);
    const wedFri = makeEvent({ frequency: 'Twice-weekly, Wed & Fri', dayOfWeek: 'Wed, Fri' });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(wedFri, jan7Wed), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(wedFri, jan9Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(wedFri, jan5Mon), false);
  });
  it('handles Bi-weekly and phrasing variations on even weeks by default', () => {
    const variations = [
      { frequency: 'Bi-weekly', frequencyNotes: '' },
      { frequency: 'Biweekly', frequencyNotes: '' },
      { frequency: 'bi weekly', frequencyNotes: '' },
      { frequency: 'Every other week', frequencyNotes: '' },
      { frequency: 'Every 2 weeks', frequencyNotes: '' },
      { frequency: 'Alternating weeks', frequencyNotes: '' },
      { frequency: '', frequencyNotes: 'Every other week' },
    ];
    for (const v of variations) {
      const ev = makeEvent({ ...v, dayOfWeek: 'Fri' });
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan2Fri), false, `${v.frequency || v.frequencyNotes} on W1`);
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan9Fri), true, `${v.frequency || v.frequencyNotes} on W2`);
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan16Fri), false, `${v.frequency || v.frequencyNotes} on W3`);
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan23Fri), true, `${v.frequency || v.frequencyNotes} on W4`);
    }
    const biweeklyMon = makeEvent({ frequency: 'Bi-weekly, Mon', dayOfWeek: 'Mon' });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(biweeklyMon, jan5Mon), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(biweeklyMon, jan12Mon), false);
  });
  it('fixes Bi-weekly + Odd weeks and respects explicit Even weeks', () => {
    const oddEv = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Bi-weekly',
      frequencyNotes: 'Odd weeks',
      dayOfWeek: 'Fri',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(oddEv, jan2Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(oddEv, jan9Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(oddEv, jan16Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(oddEv, jan23Fri), false);
    const evenEv = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Biweekly',
      frequencyNotes: 'Even weeks',
      dayOfWeek: 'Fri',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(evenEv, jan2Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(evenEv, jan9Fri), true);
  });
  it('handles Bi-weekly with ordinal lists including 2nd & 4th Fri and 1st, 3rd & 5th Tue', () => {
    const ev = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Bi-weekly',
      frequencyNotes: '2nd & 4th Fri',
      dayOfWeek: 'Fri',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan2Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan9Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan16Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan23Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan30Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, feb6Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, feb13Fri), true);
    const fifthTueEv = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Bi-weekly, 1st, 3rd & 5th Tue',
      dayOfWeek: 'Tue',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(fifthTueEv, feb10Tue), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(fifthTueEv, feb17Tue), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(fifthTueEv, mar3Tue), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(fifthTueEv, mar17Tue), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(fifthTueEv, mar31Tue), true);
  });
  it('defaults plain Monthly with no ordinal to the 1st occurrence', () => {
    for (const freq of ['Monthly', 'Once a month', 'Every month']) {
      const ev = makeEvent({ frequency: freq, frequencyNotes: '', dayOfWeek: 'Fri' });
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan2Fri), true, `${freq} on 1st Fri`);
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan9Fri), false, `${freq} on 2nd Fri`);
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan16Fri), false, `${freq} on 3rd Fri`);
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan23Fri), false, `${freq} on 4th Fri`);
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, feb6Fri), true, `${freq} on Feb 1st Fri`);
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, feb13Fri), false, `${freq} on Feb 2nd Fri`);
    }
  });
  it('handles Monthly with Last, Final, and 1st & Last ordinals', () => {
    const lastEv = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Monthly',
      frequencyNotes: 'Last Fri',
      dayOfWeek: 'Fri',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(lastEv, jan23Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(lastEv, jan30Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(lastEv, feb20Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(lastEv, feb27Fri), true);
    const finalEv = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Monthly',
      frequencyNotes: 'Final Fri',
      dayOfWeek: 'Fri',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(finalEv, jan23Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(finalEv, jan30Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(finalEv, feb27Fri), true);
    const firstAndLastSun = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Monthly, 1st & Last Sun',
      dayOfWeek: 'Sun',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(firstAndLastSun, jan4Sun), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(firstAndLastSun, jan25Sun), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(firstAndLastSun, new Date(2026, 0, 11)), false);
  });
  it('handles numeric week lists and slash ordinals like weeks 1 & 3 and 1st/3rd', () => {
    const weeksListEv = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Monthly',
      frequencyNotes: 'weeks 1 & 3',
      dayOfWeek: 'Fri',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(weeksListEv, jan2Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(weeksListEv, jan9Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(weeksListEv, jan16Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(weeksListEv, jan23Fri), false);
    const slashEv = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Monthly',
      frequencyNotes: '1st/3rd',
      dayOfWeek: 'Fri',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(slashEv, jan2Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(slashEv, jan9Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(slashEv, jan16Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(slashEv, jan23Fri), false);
    const commaAndEv = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Monthly',
      frequencyNotes: 'weeks 1, 3, and 5',
      dayOfWeek: 'Fri',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(commaAndEv, jan2Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(commaAndEv, jan9Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(commaAndEv, jan30Fri), true);
  });
  it('handles Bi-monthly variations, odd months override, and day-paired ordinals', () => {
    const variations = [
      'Bi-monthly',
      'Bimonthly',
      'Bi monthly',
      'Every other month',
      'Every 2 months',
    ];
    for (const freq of variations) {
      const ev = makeEvent({ frequency: freq, frequencyNotes: '', dayOfWeek: 'Fri' });
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, jan2Fri), false, `${freq} in Jan (odd)`);
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, feb6Fri), true, `${freq} in Feb (even)`);
      assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ev, feb13Fri), true, `${freq} in Feb 2nd Fri`);
    }
    const oddMonthsEv = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Bi-monthly',
      frequencyNotes: 'Odd months',
      dayOfWeek: 'Fri',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(oddMonthsEv, jan2Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(oddMonthsEv, feb6Fri), false);
    const ordinalBiMonthlyEv = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Every 2 months',
      frequencyNotes: '1st Fri',
      dayOfWeek: 'Fri',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ordinalBiMonthlyEv, jan2Fri), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ordinalBiMonthlyEv, feb6Fri), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(ordinalBiMonthlyEv, feb13Fri), false);
    const pairedBiMonthlyEv = makeEvent({
      frequency: 'Bi-monthly, 1st Wed & 3rd Thu',
      dayOfWeek: 'Wed, Thu',
    });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(pairedBiMonthlyEv, feb4Wed), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(pairedBiMonthlyEv, feb5Thu), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(pairedBiMonthlyEv, feb18Wed), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(pairedBiMonthlyEv, feb19Thu), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(pairedBiMonthlyEv, feb3Tue), false);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(pairedBiMonthlyEv, jan7Wed), false);
  });
  it('handles paused and hiatus statuses', () => {
    const pausedEv = makeEvent({ frequency: 'Weekly', frequencyNotes: 'On hold' });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(pausedEv, jan2Fri), false);
  });
  it('matches only event.dayOfWeek when split event has multi-day text in frequency', () => {
    const splitSat = makeEvent({ frequency: 'Weekly, Sat & Sun', dayOfWeek: 'Sat' });
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(splitSat, jan3Sat), true);
    assert.equal(isEventActiveOnDate(splitSat, jan4Sun), false);
  });
});

describe('expandEventSchedules', () => {
  it('splits FOCO0024-style day-mapped schedules into separate clean events', () => {
    const karaoke = makeEvent({
      id: 'FOCO0024',
      title: 'Weekly Karaoke Night',
      venue: 'R Bar and Lounge',
      venueUrl: 'rbar.com',
      organizerUrl: 'instagram.com/rbar',
      url1: 'rbar.com/karaoke',
      url1Notes: 'See events calendar',
      dayOfWeek: 'Mon, Wed, Sat',
      startTime: '7p (Mon) / 8p (Wed, Sat)',
      endTime: '10p (Mon) / 11p (Wed, Sat)',
      frequency: 'Weekly',
    });
    const expanded = expandEventSchedules(karaoke);
    assert.equal(expanded.length, 3);
    assert.deepEqual(
      expanded.map((e) => ({
        id: e.id,
        dayOfWeek: e.dayOfWeek,
        startTime: e.startTime,
        endTime: e.endTime,
        venueUrl: e.venueUrl,
        organizerUrl: e.organizerUrl,
        url1: e.url1,
        url1Notes: e.url1Notes,
      })),
      [
        {
          id: 'FOCO0024-mon',
          dayOfWeek: 'Mon',
          startTime: '7p',
          endTime: '10p',
          venueUrl: 'rbar.com',
          organizerUrl: 'instagram.com/rbar',
          url1: 'rbar.com/karaoke',
          url1Notes: 'See events calendar',
        },
        {
          id: 'FOCO0024-wed',
          dayOfWeek: 'Wed',
          startTime: '8p',
          endTime: '11p',
          venueUrl: 'rbar.com',
          organizerUrl: 'instagram.com/rbar',
          url1: 'rbar.com/karaoke',
          url1Notes: 'See events calendar',
        },
        {
          id: 'FOCO0024-sat',
          dayOfWeek: 'Sat',
          startTime: '8p',
          endTime: '11p',
          venueUrl: 'rbar.com',
          organizerUrl: 'instagram.com/rbar',
          url1: 'rbar.com/karaoke',
          url1Notes: 'See events calendar',
        },
      ]
    );
  });
  it('supports comma-separated, colon-prefixed, and day-range schedules', () => {
    const commaEv = makeEvent({
      id: 'E1',
      dayOfWeek: 'Mon, Wed, Sat',
      startTime: '7p (Mon), 8p (Wed & Sat)',
      endTime: '',
    });
    const commaExpanded = expandEventSchedules(commaEv);
    assert.equal(commaExpanded.length, 3);
    assert.equal(commaExpanded[0].startTime, '7p');
    assert.equal(commaExpanded[1].startTime, '8p');
    assert.equal(commaExpanded[2].startTime, '8p');
    assert.equal(commaExpanded[0].endTime, '');
    const colonEv = makeEvent({
      id: 'E2',
      dayOfWeek: 'Tue, Thu',
      startTime: 'Tue: 6p / Thu: 7:30p',
      endTime: '9p',
    });
    const colonExpanded = expandEventSchedules(colonEv);
    assert.deepEqual(
      colonExpanded.map((e) => [e.dayOfWeek, e.startTime, e.endTime]),
      [
        ['Tue', '6p', '9p'],
        ['Thu', '7:30p', '9p'],
      ]
    );
    const rangeEv = makeEvent({
      id: 'E3',
      dayOfWeek: 'Mon-Wed',
      startTime: '5p (Mon-Tue) / 6p (Wed)',
      endTime: '7p (Mon-Tue) / 8p (Wed)',
    });
    const rangeExpanded = expandEventSchedules(rangeEv);
    assert.deepEqual(
      rangeExpanded.map((e) => [e.dayOfWeek, e.startTime, e.endTime]),
      [
        ['Mon', '5p', '7p'],
        ['Tue', '5p', '7p'],
        ['Wed', '6p', '8p'],
      ]
    );
  });
  it('supports parallel unlabeled times and same-day multiple slots', () => {
    const parallelEv = makeEvent({
      id: 'E4',
      dayOfWeek: 'Tue, Thu',
      startTime: '6p / 7p',
      endTime: '8p / 9p',
    });
    assert.deepEqual(
      expandEventSchedules(parallelEv).map((e) => [e.id, e.dayOfWeek, e.startTime, e.endTime]),
      [
        ['E4-tue', 'Tue', '6p', '8p'],
        ['E4-thu', 'Thu', '7p', '9p'],
      ]
    );
    const sameDayEv = makeEvent({
      id: 'E5',
      dayOfWeek: 'Sat',
      startTime: '10a / 2p',
      endTime: '12p / 4p',
    });
    assert.deepEqual(
      expandEventSchedules(sameDayEv).map((e) => [e.id, e.dayOfWeek, e.startTime, e.endTime]),
      [
        ['E5-sat-1', 'Sat', '10a', '12p'],
        ['E5-sat-2', 'Sat', '2p', '4p'],
      ]
    );
  });
  it('keeps single-time multi-day events unsplit', () => {
    const sameTimeMultiDay = makeEvent({
      id: 'FOCO0020',
      dayOfWeek: 'Tue, Thu',
      startTime: '6p',
      endTime: '9p',
    });
    const result = expandEventSchedules(sameTimeMultiDay);
    assert.equal(result.length, 1);
    assert.equal(result[0].dayOfWeek, 'Tue, Thu');
    assert.equal(result[0].startTime, '6p');
    assert.equal(result[0].endTime, '9p');
  });
});

describe('isMonthActive', () => {
  it('respects month ranges, exclusions, bi-monthly, and odd/even months', () => {
    assert.equal(isMonthActive('May-Sep', new Date(2026, 5, 1)), true);
    assert.equal(isMonthActive('May-Sep', new Date(2026, 0, 1)), false);
    assert.equal(isMonthActive('Except July and August', new Date(2026, 6, 1)), false);
    assert.equal(isMonthActive('Except July and August', new Date(2026, 5, 1)), true);
    assert.equal(isMonthActive('Bi-monthly', new Date(2026, 0, 1)), false);
    assert.equal(isMonthActive('Bi-monthly', new Date(2026, 1, 1)), true);
    assert.equal(isMonthActive('Bi-monthly, odd months', new Date(2026, 0, 1)), true);
    assert.equal(isMonthActive('Bi-monthly, odd months', new Date(2026, 1, 1)), false);
  });
});

export const DEFAULT_USD_PRICE_CONFIG: CityPriceConfig = {
  currencyCode: 'USD',
  currencySymbol: '$',
  unitSuffix: '',
  maxPrice: 50,
  step: 5,
  underValue: 10,
  underLabel: 'Under $10',
  midLabel: '$25',
};
export function getCityPriceConfig(city?: CityConfig): CityPriceConfig {
  if (city?.priceConfig) return city.priceConfig;
  if (city?.region?.toLowerCase().includes('colombia') || city?.slug?.includes('colombia')) {
    return CITIES['medellin-colombia'].priceConfig!;
  }
  return DEFAULT_USD_PRICE_CONFIG;
}
export function getCityTimeZone(city?: CityConfig): string {
  if (city?.timeZone) return city.timeZone;
  if (city?.region?.toLowerCase().includes('colombia') || city?.slug?.includes('colombia')) {
    return 'America/Bogota';
  }
  return 'America/Denver';
}
export function getCityBySlug(slug: string): CityConfig | undefined {
  if (!slug) return undefined;
  const normalized = slug.toLowerCase().trim();
  return CITIES[normalized];
}
export function getAllCitySlugs(): string[] {
  return Object.keys(CITIES);
}
export function getAllCities(): CityConfig[] {
  return Object.values(CITIES).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}

'use client';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import Image from 'next/image';
import { usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { CityConfig } from '../lib/cities';
import ThemeToggle from './ThemeToggle';
import styles from './Header.module.css';
interface HeaderProps {
  city?: CityConfig;
}
export default function Header({ city }: HeaderProps) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [mobileDrawerOpen, setMobileDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mobileDrawerOpen) return;
    const originalOverflow = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    function handleKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setMobileDrawerOpen(false);
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = originalOverflow;
      window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    };
  }, [mobileDrawerOpen]);
  const eventsHref = city ? `/${city.slug}/events` : '';
  const aboutHref = city ? `/${city.slug}/about` : '/';
  const contactHref = city ? `/${city.slug}/contact` : '/contact';
  const isEventsActive = Boolean(
    city &&
      (pathname === `/${city.slug}/events` ||
        pathname.startsWith(`/${city.slug}/events/`))
  );
  const isAboutActive = city
    ? pathname === `/${city.slug}/about`
    : pathname === '/' || pathname === '/about';
  const isContactActive = city
    ? pathname === `/${city.slug}/contact`
    : pathname === '/contact';
  return (
    <>
      <header className={styles.header}>
        <div className={styles.headerInner}>
          <div className={styles.brandCol}>
            <Link
              href={city ? `/${city.slug}/events` : '/'}
              className={styles.brandLogoLink}
            >
              <Image
                src="/images/logo.svg"
                alt="Someplace Social"
                width={540}
                height={150}
                priority
                className={styles.logoImage}
              />
            </Link>
            {city && (
              <div className={styles.brandSubtitle}>{city.heroLocation}</div>
            )}
          </div>
          <nav className={styles.navDesktop} aria-label="Primary">
            {city && (
              <Link
                href={eventsHref}
                className={`${styles.navLink} ${
                  isEventsActive ? styles.navLinkActive : ''
                }`}
              >
                Events
              </Link>
            )}
            <Link
              href={aboutHref}
              className={`${styles.navLink} ${
                isAboutActive ? styles.navLinkActive : ''
              }`}
            >
              About
            </Link>
            <Link
              href={contactHref}
              className={`${styles.navLink} ${
                isContactActive ? styles.navLinkActive : ''
              }`}
            >
              Contact
            </Link>
            <ThemeToggle />
          </nav>
          <div className={styles.navMobileActions}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.hamburgerBtn}
              aria-label="Open menu"
              onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(true)}
            >
              <svg
                width="24"
                height="24"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2.2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
              >
                <path d="M4 7h16M4 12h16M4 17h16" />
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>
      {mobileDrawerOpen && (
        <div
          className={styles.drawerBackdrop}
          onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
        >
          <div
            className={styles.drawer}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-label="Navigation menu"
          >
            <div className={styles.drawerHeader}>
              <div className={styles.drawerTitle}>Someplace Social</div>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={styles.drawerCloseBtn}
                aria-label="Close menu"
                onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.drawerSectionTitle}>Navigation</div>
            <div className={styles.drawerNavLinks}>
              {city && (
                <Link
                  href={eventsHref}
                  className={`${styles.drawerNavLink} ${
                    isEventsActive ? styles.drawerNavLinkActive : ''
                  }`}
                  onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
                >
                  Events
                </Link>
              )}
              <Link
                href={aboutHref}
                className={`${styles.drawerNavLink} ${
                  isAboutActive ? styles.drawerNavLinkActive : ''
                }`}
                onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
              >
                About
              </Link>
              <Link
                href={contactHref}
                className={`${styles.drawerNavLink} ${
                  isContactActive ? styles.drawerNavLinkActive : ''
                }`}
                onClick={() => setMobileDrawerOpen(false)}
              >
                Contact
              </Link>
            </div>
            <div className={styles.drawerSectionTitle}>Preferences</div>
            <div className={styles.drawerNavLinks}>
              <ThemeToggle showLabel />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import { Event } from '../lib/google-sheets';
import { CityPriceConfig } from '../lib/cities';
export type IndexedEvent = Event & {
  parsedHour: number;
  parsedPrice: number | null;
  isFreeOrDonationPrice: boolean;
  searchCorpus: string;
  activeDays: boolean[];
};
export function parseHour(timeStr: string): number {
  if (!timeStr) return 18;
  const cleaned = timeStr.trim().toLowerCase();
  const match = cleaned.match(/(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(am|pm|a|p)?/i);
  if (match) {
    let hour = parseInt(match[1], 10);
    const minute = match[2] ? parseInt(match[2], 10) : 0;
    const meridian = match[3];
    if (meridian) {
      const isPm = meridian.startsWith('p');
      const isAm = meridian.startsWith('a');
      if (isPm && hour < 12) hour += 12;
      if (isAm && hour === 12) hour = 0;
    } else {
      if (hour >= 1 && hour <= 6) {
        hour += 12;
      }
    }
    return hour + minute / 60;
  }
  const numMatch = cleaned.match(/\d+/);
  return numMatch ? parseInt(numMatch[0], 10) : 18;
}
export function formatTimeLabel(timeStr: string): string {
  if (!timeStr) return '';
  const cleaned = timeStr.trim();
  const match = cleaned.match(/^(\d{1,2})(?::(\d{2}))?\s*(am|pm|a|p)?$/i);
  if (match) {
    const hour = match[1];
    const minute = match[2] && match[2] !== '00' ? `:${match[2]}` : '';
    const meridian = (match[3] || 'p').toLowerCase().startsWith('a') ? 'a' : 'p';
    return `${hour}${minute}${meridian}`;
  }
  return cleaned;
}
export function formatTimeRange(
  startTime: string,
  endTime: string
): { start: string; end?: string } {
  const start = formatTimeLabel(startTime);
  const end = endTime ? formatTimeLabel(endTime) : undefined;
  return { start, end };
}
export function formatRecurrenceText(
  frequency?: string,
  frequencyNotes?: string
): string {
  const freq = (frequency || '').trim();
  const notes = (frequencyNotes || '').trim();
  if (freq && notes) {
    if (notes.startsWith(',') || notes.startsWith('.')) {
      return `${freq}${notes}`;
    }
    if (
      notes.startsWith('(') ||
      notes.startsWith('·') ||
      notes.startsWith('•') ||
      notes.startsWith('-')
    ) {
      return `${freq} ${notes}`;
    }
    return `${freq} · ${notes}`;
  }
  return freq || notes || '';
}
export function isFreePrice(price: string): boolean {
  if (!price) return true;
  const p = price.trim().toLowerCase();
  return p.startsWith('free') || p.startsWith('gratis') || p === '0' || p === '$0';
}
export function isFreeOrDonation(price: string): boolean {
  if (!price) return true;
  const p = price.trim().toLowerCase();
  return (
    isFreePrice(p) ||
    p.includes('donation') ||
    p.includes('aporte') ||
    p.includes('voluntari') ||
    p === '0k'
  );
}
export function parseEventPrice(priceStr: string, currencyCode: string = 'USD'): number | null {
  if (!priceStr) return 0;
  const cleaned = priceStr.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (isFreeOrDonation(cleaned)) return 0;
  if (currencyCode === 'COP') {
    const kMatch = cleaned.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*k/i);
    if (kMatch) {
      return parseFloat(kMatch[1]);
    }
    const thousandSepMatch = cleaned.match(/(\d{1,3})[.,](\d{3})/);
    if (thousandSepMatch) {
      const whole = parseInt(thousandSepMatch[1], 10);
      const frac = parseInt(thousandSepMatch[2], 10) / 1000;
      return whole + frac;
    }
    const bigNumMatch = cleaned.match(/\b(\d{4,6})\b/);
    if (bigNumMatch) {
      return parseInt(bigNumMatch[1], 10) / 1000;
    }
    const smallNumMatch = cleaned.match(/\b(\d{1,3})\b/);
    if (smallNumMatch) {
      return parseInt(smallNumMatch[1], 10);
    }
    return null;
  }
  const usdMatch = cleaned.match(/\$?\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
  if (usdMatch) {
    return parseFloat(usdMatch[1]);
  }
  return null;
}
export function matchesPriceFilter(
  eventPrice: string,
  maxPriceFilter: number,
  priceConfig: CityPriceConfig
): boolean {
  if (maxPriceFilter >= priceConfig.maxPrice) {
    return true;
  }
  if (isFreeOrDonation(eventPrice)) {
    return true;
  }
  if (maxPriceFilter === 0) {
    return isFreeOrDonation(eventPrice);
  }
  const num = parseEventPrice(eventPrice, priceConfig.currencyCode);
  if (num === null) {
    return false;
  }
  return num <= maxPriceFilter;
}
export function formatPriceValue(val: number, config: CityPriceConfig): string {
  if (val === 0) return 'Free';
  if (config.unitSuffix) {
    return `${val}${config.unitSuffix}`;
  }
  return `${config.currencySymbol}${val}`;
}
export function formatPriceReadout(val: number, config: CityPriceConfig): string {
  if (val === 0) return 'Free / donation';
  if (val === config.underValue) return config.underLabel;
  if (val >= config.maxPrice) return 'Any price';
  return `Up to ${formatPriceValue(val, config)}`;
}
export function formatPriceTriggerLabel(val: number, config: CityPriceConfig): string {
  if (val >= config.maxPrice) return 'All prices';
  if (val === 0) return 'Free / donation';
  if (val === config.underValue) return config.underLabel;
  return `Up to ${formatPriceValue(val, config)}`;
}
const DAY_ALIAS_MAP: Record<string, string[]> = {
  sun: ['sun', 'sunday'],
  sunday: ['sun', 'sunday'],
  mon: ['mon', 'monday'],
  monday: ['mon', 'monday'],
  tue: ['tue', 'tues', 'tuesday'],
  tuesday: ['tue', 'tues', 'tuesday'],
  wed: ['wed', 'weds', 'wednesday'],
  wednesday: ['wed', 'weds', 'wednesday'],
  thu: ['thu', 'thur', 'thurs', 'thursday'],
  thursday: ['thu', 'thur', 'thurs', 'thursday'],
  fri: ['fri', 'friday'],
  friday: ['fri', 'friday'],
  sat: ['sat', 'saturday'],
  saturday: ['sat', 'saturday'],
};
const DAY_INDEX: Record<string, number> = {
  sun: 0,
  sunday: 0,
  mon: 1,
  monday: 1,
  tue: 2,
  tues: 2,
  tuesday: 2,
  wed: 3,
  weds: 3,
  wednesday: 3,
  thu: 4,
  thur: 4,
  thurs: 4,
  thursday: 4,
  fri: 5,
  friday: 5,
  sat: 6,
  saturday: 6,
};
export function normalizeDayOfWeek(dayStr: string): string {
  if (!dayStr) return '';
  const trimmed = dayStr.trim();
  const lower = trimmed.toLowerCase();
  if (lower.includes('daily') || lower.includes('everyday') || lower.includes('every day')) {
    return 'Daily';
  }
  const DAY_TO_SHORT: Record<string, string> = {
    sun: 'Sun',
    sunday: 'Sun',
    mon: 'Mon',
    monday: 'Mon',
    tue: 'Tue',
    tues: 'Tue',
    tuesday: 'Tue',
    wed: 'Wed',
    weds: 'Wed',
    wednesday: 'Wed',
    thu: 'Thu',
    thur: 'Thu',
    thurs: 'Thu',
    thursday: 'Thu',
    fri: 'Fri',
    friday: 'Fri',
    sat: 'Sat',
    saturday: 'Sat',
  };
  const rangeMatch = trimmed.match(/^([a-zA-Z]+)\s*(?:[\u2013\u2014\-]|\bto\b)\s*([a-zA-Z]+)$/i);
  if (rangeMatch) {
    const startShort = DAY_TO_SHORT[rangeMatch[1].toLowerCase()];
    const endShort = DAY_TO_SHORT[rangeMatch[2].toLowerCase()];
    if (startShort && endShort) {
      return `${startShort}-${endShort}`;
    }
  }
  const tokens = trimmed.split(/[^a-zA-Z]+/).filter(Boolean);
  const normalized: string[] = [];
  for (const token of tokens) {
    const short = DAY_TO_SHORT[token.toLowerCase()];
    if (short && !normalized.includes(short)) {
      normalized.push(short);
    }
  }
  return normalized.length > 0 ? normalized.join(', ') : trimmed;
}
export function matchesDay(eventDays: string, targetDayName: string): boolean {
  if (!eventDays || !targetDayName) return false;
  const targetKey = targetDayName.trim().toLowerCase();
  const targetIndex = DAY_INDEX[targetKey];
  const aliases = DAY_ALIAS_MAP[targetKey] || [targetKey];
  const rawLower = eventDays.toLowerCase();
  if (rawLower.includes('daily') || rawLower.includes('everyday') || rawLower.includes('every day')) {
    return true;
  }
  if (rawLower.includes(targetKey)) {
    return true;
  }
  const tokens = rawLower.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (tokens.some((token) => aliases.includes(token))) {
    return true;
  }
  const rangeMatch = rawLower.match(/([a-zA-Z]+)\s*(?:[\u2013\u2014\-]|to)\s*([a-zA-Z]+)/);
  if (rangeMatch && targetIndex !== undefined) {
    const d1 = DAY_INDEX[rangeMatch[1].toLowerCase()];
    const d2 = DAY_INDEX[rangeMatch[2].toLowerCase()];
    if (d1 !== undefined && d2 !== undefined) {
      if (d1 <= d2) {
        return targetIndex >= d1 && targetIndex <= d2;
      }
      return targetIndex >= d1 || targetIndex <= d2;
    }
  }
  return false;
}
const MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM: Record<string, number> = {
  jan: 1, january: 1, enero: 1, ene: 1,
  feb: 2, february: 2, febrero: 2,
  mar: 3, march: 3, marzo: 3,
  apr: 4, april: 4, abril: 4, abr: 4,
  may: 5, mayo: 5,
  jun: 6, june: 6, junio: 6,
  jul: 7, july: 7, julio: 7,
  aug: 8, august: 8, agosto: 8, ago: 8,
  sep: 9, sept: 9, september: 9, septiembre: 9, setiembre: 9, set: 9,
  oct: 10, october: 10, octubre: 10,
  nov: 11, november: 11, noviembre: 11,
  dec: 12, december: 12, diciembre: 12, dic: 12,
};
const BIWEEKLY_REGEX =
  /\b(?:bi[-\s]?weekly|every\s+other\s+week|every\s+(?:2|two)\s+weeks?|alternating\s+weeks?)\b/i;
const BIMONTHLY_REGEX =
  /\b(?:bi[-\s]?monthly|every\s+other\s+month|every\s+(?:2|two)\s+months?)\b/i;
const ORDINAL_TOKEN_PATTERN =
  '(?:1st|first|primer[oa]?|2nd|second|segund[oa]|3rd|third|tercer[oa]?|4th|fourth|cuart[oa]|5th|fifth|quint[oa]|last|final|ultimo|últim[oa])';
const WEEKDAY_TOKEN_PATTERN =
  '(?:sun(?:day)?|mon(?:day)?|tue(?:s|sday)?|wed(?:s|nesday)?|thu(?:r|rs|rsday)?|fri(?:day)?|sat(?:urday)?)';
const DAY_PAIRED_ORDINAL_REGEX = new RegExp(
  `\\b((?:${ORDINAL_TOKEN_PATTERN})(?:\\s*(?:,\\s*(?:and\\b|&|y\\b)?|&|/|\\band\\b|\\by\\b)\\s*(?:${ORDINAL_TOKEN_PATTERN}))*)\\s+(?:of\\s+)?(${WEEKDAY_TOKEN_PATTERN})\\b`,
  'gi'
);
type OrdinalFlags = {
  has1st: boolean;
  has2nd: boolean;
  has3rd: boolean;
  has4th: boolean;
  has5th: boolean;
  hasLast: boolean;
};
function parseOrdinalFlags(text: string, numericWeeks?: Set<number>): OrdinalFlags {
  return {
    has1st: /\b(1st|first|primer[oa]?)\b/i.test(text) || Boolean(numericWeeks?.has(1)),
    has2nd: /\b(2nd|second|segund[oa])\b/i.test(text) || Boolean(numericWeeks?.has(2)),
    has3rd: /\b(3rd|third|tercer[oa]?)\b/i.test(text) || Boolean(numericWeeks?.has(3)),
    has4th: /\b(4th|fourth|cuart[oa])\b/i.test(text) || Boolean(numericWeeks?.has(4)),
    has5th: /\b(5th|fifth|quint[oa])\b/i.test(text) || Boolean(numericWeeks?.has(5)),
    hasLast: /\b(last|final|ultimo|últim[oa])\b/i.test(text),
  };
}
function matchesOrdinalFlags(flags: OrdinalFlags, occurrence: number, isLast: boolean): boolean {
  return (
    (flags.has1st && occurrence === 1) ||
    (flags.has2nd && occurrence === 2) ||
    (flags.has3rd && occurrence === 3) ||
    (flags.has4th && occurrence === 4) ||
    (flags.has5th && occurrence === 5) ||
    (flags.hasLast && isLast)
  );
}
export function isMonthActive(frequencyNotes?: string, targetDate: Date = new Date()): boolean {
  if (!frequencyNotes) return true;
  const cleaned = frequencyNotes.trim();
  if (!cleaned) return true;
  if (/\b(?:irregular|hiatus|paused|cancelled|canceled|on hold|inactive|tbd)\b/i.test(cleaned)) {
    return false;
  }
  const targetMonth = targetDate.getMonth() + 1;
  const exceptMatch = cleaned.match(
    /\b(?:except|excluding|no meetings? in|off in)\s+([a-zA-Z]+)(?:\s*(?:and|&|,)\s*([a-zA-Z]+))?\b/i
  );
  if (exceptMatch) {
    const m1 = MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM[exceptMatch[1].toLowerCase()];
    const m2 = exceptMatch[2] ? MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM[exceptMatch[2].toLowerCase()] : null;
    if (m1 && targetMonth === m1) return false;
    if (m2 && targetMonth === m2) return false;
  }
  for (const rangeMatch of cleaned.matchAll(
    /\b([a-zA-Z]{3,10})\s*(?:[\u2013\u2014\-]|--|\bto\b|\bthrough\b|\bthru\b|\ba\b)\s*([a-zA-Z]{3,10})\b/gi
  )) {
    const startMonth = MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM[rangeMatch[1].toLowerCase()];
    const endMonth = MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM[rangeMatch[2].toLowerCase()];
    if (startMonth && endMonth) {
      const inRange =
        startMonth <= endMonth
          ? targetMonth >= startMonth && targetMonth <= endMonth
          : targetMonth >= startMonth || targetMonth <= endMonth;
      if (!inRange) return false;
      break;
    }
  }
  const singleMonthMatch = cleaned.match(/\b([a-zA-Z]{3,10})\s+only\b/i);
  if (singleMonthMatch) {
    const m = MONTH_NAME_TO_NUM[singleMonthMatch[1].toLowerCase()];
    if (m) {
      return targetMonth === m;
    }
  }
  if (/\bsummer\b/i.test(cleaned) && (targetMonth < 6 || targetMonth > 8)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (/\bwinter\b/i.test(cleaned) && targetMonth !== 12 && targetMonth > 2) {
    return false;
  }
  if (/\bspring\b/i.test(cleaned) && (targetMonth < 3 || targetMonth > 5)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (/\b(?:fall|autumn)\b/i.test(cleaned) && (targetMonth < 9 || targetMonth > 11)) {
    return false;
  }
  const hasEvenMonths = /\b(?:even\s*months?|months?[\s,]+even|meses\s*pares)\b/i.test(cleaned);
  const hasOddMonths = /\b(?:odd\s*months?|months?[\s,]+odd|meses\s*impares)\b/i.test(cleaned);
  if (hasEvenMonths && !hasOddMonths) {
    return targetMonth % 2 === 0;
  }
  if (hasOddMonths && !hasEvenMonths) {
    return targetMonth % 2 !== 0;
  }
  if (!hasEvenMonths && !hasOddMonths && BIMONTHLY_REGEX.test(cleaned)) {
    return targetMonth % 2 === 0;
  }
  return true;
}
export function getWeekdayOccurrence(targetDate: Date): {
  occurrence: number;
  isLast: boolean;
} {
  const dayOfMonth = targetDate.getDate();
  const occurrence = Math.ceil(dayOfMonth / 7);
  const daysInMonth = new Date(
    targetDate.getFullYear(),
    targetDate.getMonth() + 1,
    0
  ).getDate();
  const isLast = dayOfMonth + 7 > daysInMonth;
  return { occurrence, isLast };
}
function getWeekNumber(d: Date): number {
  const target = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()));
  const dayNum = target.getUTCDay() || 7;
  target.setUTCDate(target.getUTCDate() + 4 - dayNum);
  const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(target.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1));
  return Math.ceil(((target.getTime() - yearStart.getTime()) / 86400000 + 1) / 7);
}
export function isEventActiveOnDate(event: Event, targetDate: Date): boolean {
  const combinedText = [event.frequency, event.frequencyNotes]
    .map((s) => (s || '').trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' | ');
  if (/\b(?:irregular|hiatus|paused|cancelled|canceled|on hold|inactive|tbd)\b/i.test(combinedText)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (!isMonthActive(combinedText, targetDate)) {
    return false;
  }
  const DAY_NAMES = ['Sunday', 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday'];
  const DAY_SHORT_NAMES = ['sun', 'mon', 'tue', 'wed', 'thu', 'fri', 'sat'];
  const dayIdx = targetDate.getDay();
  const targetDayName = DAY_NAMES[dayIdx];
  const targetDayShort = DAY_SHORT_NAMES[dayIdx];
  const daySpec =
    (event.dayOfWeek || '').trim() ||
    (event.frequency || '').trim() ||
    (event.frequencyNotes || '').trim();
  if (!matchesDay(daySpec, targetDayName)) {
    return false;
  }
  const hasEvenWeeks = /\b(?:even\s*weeks?|weeks?[\s,]+even)\b/i.test(combinedText);
  const hasOddWeeks = /\b(?:odd\s*weeks?|weeks?[\s,]+odd)\b/i.test(combinedText);
  if (hasEvenWeeks || hasOddWeeks) {
    const weekNum = getWeekNumber(targetDate);
    if (hasEvenWeeks && !hasOddWeeks) return weekNum % 2 === 0;
    if (hasOddWeeks && !hasEvenWeeks) return weekNum % 2 !== 0;
  }
  const { occurrence, isLast } = getWeekdayOccurrence(targetDate);
  const dayRules = new Map<string, OrdinalFlags>();
  for (const match of combinedText.matchAll(DAY_PAIRED_ORDINAL_REGEX)) {
    const dayKey = match[2].slice(0, 3).toLowerCase();
    const flags = parseOrdinalFlags(match[1]);
    const existing = dayRules.get(dayKey);
    if (existing) {
      existing.has1st = existing.has1st || flags.has1st;
      existing.has2nd = existing.has2nd || flags.has2nd;
      existing.has3rd = existing.has3rd || flags.has3rd;
      existing.has4th = existing.has4th || flags.has4th;
      existing.has5th = existing.has5th || flags.has5th;
      existing.hasLast = existing.hasLast || flags.hasLast;
    } else {
      dayRules.set(dayKey, flags);
    }
  }
  if (dayRules.size > 0) {
    const rule = dayRules.get(targetDayShort);
    if (rule) {
      return matchesOrdinalFlags(rule, occurrence, isLast);
    }
  }
  const weekNumMatches = new Set<number>();
  for (const m of combinedText.matchAll(
    /\b(?:weeks?|wks?|occurrences?)\s+(?:#\s*)?([1-5](?:\s*(?:,\s*(?:and\b|&|y\b)?|&|\/|\band\b|\by\b)\s*[1-5])*)\b/gi
  )) {
    for (const d of m[1].match(/[1-5]/g) || []) {
      weekNumMatches.add(Number(d));
    }
  }
  for (const m of combinedText.matchAll(
    /(?:^|[\s,(|])([1-5](?:\s*(?:,\s*(?:and\b|&|y\b)?|&|\/|\band\b|\by\b)\s*[1-5])+)(?![\d:/-])/gi
  )) {
    for (const d of m[1].match(/[1-5]/g) || []) {
      weekNumMatches.add(Number(d));
    }
  }
  const globalFlags = parseOrdinalFlags(combinedText, weekNumMatches);
  if (
    globalFlags.has1st ||
    globalFlags.has2nd ||
    globalFlags.has3rd ||
    globalFlags.has4th ||
    globalFlags.has5th ||
    globalFlags.hasLast
  ) {
    return matchesOrdinalFlags(globalFlags, occurrence, isLast);
  }
  if (BIWEEKLY_REGEX.test(combinedText)) {
    const weekNum = getWeekNumber(targetDate);
    return weekNum % 2 === 0;
  }
  const isBiMonthly = BIMONTHLY_REGEX.test(combinedText);
  const isPlainMonthly =
    !isBiMonthly &&
    !/\b(?:twice|semi)[-\s]?monthly\b/i.test(combinedText) &&
    /\b(?:monthly|once\s+a\s+month|every\s+month)\b/i.test(combinedText);
  if (isPlainMonthly) {
    return occurrence === 1;
  }
  return true;
}
export function ensureExternalUrl(url: string): string {
  if (!url) return '';
  const trimmed = url.trim();
  if (!trimmed || trimmed.toLowerCase() === 'x') return '';
  if (/^(javascript|data|vbscript):/i.test(trimmed)) return '';
  if (trimmed.startsWith('//')) return `https:${trimmed}`;
  if (/^(https?:\/\/|mailto:|tel:|sms:)/i.test(trimmed)) return trimmed;
  return `https://${trimmed}`;
}
export function getTagStyle(tag: string): { color: string; background: string } {
  const t = (tag || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (t.includes('science')) {
    return { color: 'var(--tag-science-ink, #0f5c5c)', background: 'var(--tag-science-bg, #d3efec)' };
  }
  if (t.includes('craft')) {
    return { color: 'var(--tag-craft-ink, #8a3d0c)', background: 'var(--tag-craft-bg, #fde4cf)' };
  }
  if (t.includes('food') || t.includes('drink')) {
    return { color: 'var(--tag-food-ink, #6b5200)', background: 'var(--tag-food-bg, #f4eab8)' };
  }
  if (t.includes('community') || t.includes('social')) {
    return { color: 'var(--tag-community-ink, #3b4a54)', background: 'var(--tag-community-bg, #e1e7ea)' };
  }
  if (t.includes('music') || t.includes('bluegrass')) {
    return { color: 'var(--tag-music-ink, #5b2a86)', background: 'var(--tag-music-bg, #ecdcf7)' };
  }
  if (t.includes('trivia')) {
    return { color: 'var(--tag-trivia-ink, #2d3f7a)', background: 'var(--tag-trivia-bg, #dde4f7)' };
  }
  if (t.includes('open mic') || t.includes('mic') || t.includes('comedy')) {
    return { color: 'var(--tag-comedy-ink, #8a1f4f)', background: 'var(--tag-comedy-bg, #fbdce9)' };
  }
  if (t.includes('dance') || t.includes('salsa') || t.includes('bachata')) {
    return { color: 'var(--tag-dance-ink, #852b2b)', background: 'var(--tag-dance-bg, #f9dede)' };
  }
  if (t.includes('sport') || t.includes('fitness') || t.includes('yoga') || t.includes('walk')) {
    return { color: 'var(--tag-sport-ink, #1f6a42)', background: 'var(--tag-sport-bg, #d7f0df)' };
  }
  if (t.includes('language') || t.includes('english') || t.includes('spanish')) {
    return { color: 'var(--tag-language-ink, #2c4f7c)', background: 'var(--tag-language-bg, #dbe5f7)' };
  }
  return { color: 'var(--tag-default-ink, #4f483e)', background: 'var(--tag-default-bg, #f3ead4)' };
}
export function indexEvents(
  events: Event[],
  rollingWeek: Date[],
  currencyCode: string = 'USD'
): IndexedEvent[] {
  return events.map((ev) => {
    const parsedHour = parseHour(ev.startTime);
    const freeOrDonation = isFreeOrDonation(ev.price);
    const parsedPrice = freeOrDonation ? 0 : parseEventPrice(ev.price, currencyCode);
    const searchCorpus = [
      ev.title,
      ev.venue,
      ev.organization,
      ev.location,
      ev.area,
      ev.activity,
      ...ev.activities,
      ev.about,
      ev.notes,
    ]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(' ')
      .toLowerCase();
    const activeDays = rollingWeek.map((day) => isEventActiveOnDate(ev, day));
    return {
      ...ev,
      parsedHour,
      parsedPrice,
      isFreeOrDonationPrice: freeOrDonation,
      searchCorpus,
      activeDays,
    };
  });
}
export function filterAndCountEvents(
  indexedEvents: IndexedEvent[],
  activeDayIdx: number,
  maxPrice: number,
  priceConfig: CityPriceConfig,
  selectedTimes: string[],
  selectedActivities: string[],
  selectedAreas: string[],
  searchQuery: string,
  timeGroups: { name: string; predicate: (h: number) => boolean }[]
): { currentList: IndexedEvent[]; dayCounts: number[] } {
  const dayCounts = [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0];
  const currentList: IndexedEvent[] = [];
  const queryTerms = searchQuery.trim()
    ? searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean)
    : null;
  const selectedActivitiesLower =
    selectedActivities.length > 0
      ? selectedActivities.map((a) => a.toLowerCase())
      : null;
  const selectedAreasLower =
    selectedAreas.length > 0
      ? selectedAreas.map((a) => a.toLowerCase())
      : null;
  const isPriceFiltered = maxPrice < priceConfig.maxPrice;
  for (let i = 0; i < indexedEvents.length; i++) {
    const ev = indexedEvents[i];
    if (isPriceFiltered) {
      if (maxPrice === 0) {
        if (!ev.isFreeOrDonationPrice) continue;
      } else if (!ev.isFreeOrDonationPrice) {
        if (ev.parsedPrice === null || ev.parsedPrice > maxPrice) continue;
      }
    }
    if (selectedTimes.length > 0) {
      const matchesTime = selectedTimes.some((tgName) => {
        const group = timeGroups.find((g) => g.name === tgName);
        return group ? group.predicate(ev.parsedHour) : false;
      });
      if (!matchesTime) continue;
    }
    if (selectedActivitiesLower) {
      const hasActivityMatch = ev.activities.some((act) =>
        selectedActivitiesLower.includes(act.trim().toLowerCase())
      );
      if (!hasActivityMatch) continue;
    }
    if (selectedAreasLower) {
      const evAreaLower = (ev.area || '').trim().toLowerCase();
      if (!selectedAreasLower.includes(evAreaLower)) continue;
    }
    if (queryTerms) {
      const matchesSearch = queryTerms.every((term) =>
        ev.searchCorpus.includes(term)
      );
      if (!matchesSearch) continue;
    }
    for (let d = 0; d < 7; d++) {
      if (ev.activeDays[d]) {
        dayCounts[d]++;
      }
    }
    if (ev.activeDays[activeDayIdx]) {
      currentList.push(ev);
    }
  }
  currentList.sort((a, b) => a.parsedHour - b.parsedHour);
  return { currentList, dayCounts };
}

================
File: app/events/CityEventsView.tsx

'use client';
import {
  useState,
  useMemo,
  useDeferredValue,
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useSyncExternalStore,
} from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  CityConfig,
  getCityPriceConfig,
  getCityTimeZone,
} from '../lib/cities';
import type { Event } from '../lib/google-sheets';
import {
  indexEvents,
  filterAndCountEvents,
} from './utils';
import { getCityToday, getEventSlug, resolveEventBySlug } from './event-helpers';
import Header from '../components/Header';
import Footer from '../components/Footer';
import DayPicker from './components/DayPicker';
import FilterControls from './components/FilterControls';
import EventCard from './components/EventCard';
import SuggestEditModal from './components/SuggestEditModal';
import CityHeroCard from './components/CityHeroCard';
import styles from './EventsView.module.css';
const emptySubscribe = () => () => {};
const DAY_NAMES_LONG = [
  'Sunday',
  'Monday',
  'Tuesday',
  'Wednesday',
  'Thursday',
  'Friday',
  'Saturday',
];
const MONTH_NAMES = [
  'Jan',
  'Feb',
  'Mar',
  'Apr',
  'May',
  'Jun',
  'Jul',
  'Aug',
  'Sep',
  'Oct',
  'Nov',
  'Dec',
];
const TIME_GROUPS = [
  { name: 'Morning', predicate: (h: number) => h < 12 },
  { name: 'Afternoon', predicate: (h: number) => h >= 12 && h < 17 },
  { name: 'Evening', predicate: (h: number) => h >= 17 && h < 20 },
  { name: 'Night', predicate: (h: number) => h >= 20 },
];
export default function CityEventsView({
  city,
  initialEvents = [],
  lastUpdated = null,
}: {
  city: CityConfig;
  initialEvents?: Event[];
  lastUpdated?: string | null;
}) {
  const mounted = useSyncExternalStore(
    emptySubscribe,
    () => true,
    () => false
  );
  const priceConfig = useMemo(() => getCityPriceConfig(city), [city]);
  const timeZone = useMemo(() => getCityTimeZone(city), [city]);
  const [activeDayIdx, setActiveDayIdx] = useState(0);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const deferredSearchQuery = useDeferredValue(searchQuery);
  const [selectedMaxPrice, setSelectedMaxPrice] = useState<{
    citySlug: string;
    value: number;
  } | null>(null);
  const [selectedTimes, setSelectedTimes] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedActivities, setSelectedActivities] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedAreas, setSelectedAreas] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [openEventId, setOpenEventId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editModalEvent, setEditModalEvent] = useState<Event | null>(null);
  const pendingScrollIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const handledInitialHashRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const maxPrice =
    selectedMaxPrice && selectedMaxPrice.citySlug === city.slug
      ? selectedMaxPrice.value
      : priceConfig.maxPrice;
  const handlePriceChange = useCallback(
    (val: number) => {
      setSelectedMaxPrice({ citySlug: city.slug, value: val });
    },
    [city.slug]
  );
  const allEvents = initialEvents;
  const eventKeyMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<Event, string>();
    const seen = new Map<string, number>();
    allEvents.forEach((ev) => {
      const base = getEventSlug(ev);
      const count = seen.get(base) || 0;
      seen.set(base, count + 1);
      map.set(ev, count === 0 ? base : `${base}-${count}`);
    });
    return map;
  }, [allEvents]);
  const rollingWeek = useMemo(() => {
    const today = getCityToday(timeZone);
    return Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => {
      const d = new Date(today);
      d.setDate(today.getDate() + i);
      return d;
    });
  }, [timeZone]);
  const indexedEvents = useMemo(() => {
    return indexEvents(allEvents, rollingWeek, priceConfig.currencyCode);
  }, [allEvents, rollingWeek, priceConfig.currencyCode]);
  const syncEventHash = useCallback((slug: string | null) => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const url = new URL(window.location.href);
    const nextHash = slug ? `#${slug}` : '';
    if (url.hash === nextHash) return;
    url.hash = nextHash;
    const nextUrl = `${url.pathname}${url.search}${url.hash}`;
    window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, '', nextUrl);
  }, []);
  const openEventFromHash = useCallback(
    (clearIfEmpty: boolean) => {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
      const rawHash = window.location.hash.replace(/^#/, '').trim();
      if (!rawHash) {
        if (clearIfEmpty) {
          setOpenEventId(null);
        }
        return;
      }
      const resolved = resolveEventBySlug(allEvents, rawHash);
      if (!resolved) return;
      const targetIdx = allEvents.indexOf(resolved.event);
      const indexedTarget = targetIdx >= 0 ? indexedEvents[targetIdx] : null;
      const firstActiveDayIdx = indexedTarget
        ? indexedTarget.activeDays.findIndex(Boolean)
        : -1;
      if (firstActiveDayIdx < 0 || !indexedTarget) return;
      const key = eventKeyMap.get(resolved.event) || resolved.canonicalSlug;
      setActiveDayIdx((prevDay) =>
        indexedTarget.activeDays[prevDay] ? prevDay : firstActiveDayIdx
      );
      setOpenEventId(key);
      syncEventHash(resolved.canonicalSlug);
      pendingScrollIdRef.current = `event-card-${key}`;
    },
    [allEvents, eventKeyMap, indexedEvents, syncEventHash]
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    let rafId: number | null = null;
    if (handledInitialHashRef.current !== city.slug) {
      rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        handledInitialHashRef.current = city.slug;
        openEventFromHash(false);
      });
    }
    const handleHashChange = () => {
      openEventFromHash(true);
    };
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', handleHashChange);
    return () => {
      if (rafId !== null) {
        window.cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
      }
      window.removeEventListener('hashchange', handleHashChange);
    };
  }, [city.slug, openEventFromHash]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!pendingScrollIdRef.current) return;
    const domId = pendingScrollIdRef.current;
    const el = document.getElementById(domId);
    if (!el) return;
    pendingScrollIdRef.current = null;
    const rafId = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
    });
    return () => window.cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
  }, [activeDayIdx, openEventId]);
  const activeDate = rollingWeek[activeDayIdx] || rollingWeek[0];
  const activityFrequencies = useMemo(() => {
    const counts = new Map<string, number>();
    allEvents.forEach((ev) => {
      ev.activities.forEach((act) => {
        const trimmed = act.trim();
        if (trimmed) {
          counts.set(trimmed, (counts.get(trimmed) || 0) + 1);
        }
      });
    });
    return counts;
  }, [allEvents]);
  const activities = useMemo(() => {
    return Array.from(activityFrequencies.keys()).sort((a, b) => {
      const countDiff = (activityFrequencies.get(b) || 0) - (activityFrequencies.get(a) || 0);
      if (countDiff !== 0) return countDiff;
      return a.localeCompare(b);
    });
  }, [activityFrequencies]);
  const areas = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    allEvents.forEach((ev) => {
      if (ev.area && ev.area.trim().length > 0 && ev.area.trim().length < 35) {
        set.add(ev.area.trim());
      }
    });
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [allEvents]);
  const toggleTime = useCallback((tName: string) => {
    setSelectedTimes((prev) =>
      prev.includes(tName) ? prev.filter((t) => t !== tName) : [...prev, tName]
    );
  }, []);
  const toggleActivity = useCallback((act: string) => {
    setSelectedActivities((prev) =>
      prev.includes(act) ? prev.filter((a) => a !== act) : [...prev, act]
    );
  }, []);
  const handleSelectChip = useCallback((act: string) => {
    setSelectedActivities((prev) => {
      if (prev.includes(act)) {
        return prev.filter((a) => a !== act);
      }
      return [act];
    });
  }, []);
  const toggleArea = useCallback((ar: string) => {
    setSelectedAreas((prev) =>
      prev.includes(ar) ? prev.filter((a) => a !== ar) : [...prev, ar]
    );
  }, []);
  const { currentList, dayCounts } = useMemo(() => {
    return filterAndCountEvents(
      indexedEvents,
      activeDayIdx,
      maxPrice,
      priceConfig,
      selectedTimes,
      selectedActivities,
      selectedAreas,
      deferredSearchQuery,
      TIME_GROUPS
    );
  }, [
    indexedEvents,
    activeDayIdx,
    maxPrice,
    priceConfig,
    selectedTimes,
    selectedActivities,
    selectedAreas,
    deferredSearchQuery,
  ]);
  const nextUpEventId = useMemo(() => {
    if (!mounted || activeDayIdx !== 0) return null;
    const now = new Date();
    const nowHour = now.getHours() + now.getMinutes() / 60;
    const nextEvent = currentList.find((ev) => ev.parsedHour >= nowHour);
    if (!nextEvent) return null;
    const idx = indexedEvents.indexOf(nextEvent);
    const sourceEvent = idx >= 0 ? allEvents[idx] : nextEvent;
    return eventKeyMap.get(sourceEvent) || getEventSlug(nextEvent);
  }, [mounted, activeDayIdx, allEvents, currentList, eventKeyMap, indexedEvents]);
  const handleToggleEvent = useCallback(
    (ev: Event, uniqueId: string) => {
      if (openEventId === uniqueId) {
        setOpenEventId(null);
        syncEventHash(null);
      } else {
        setOpenEventId(uniqueId);
        syncEventHash(getEventSlug(ev));
      }
    },
    [openEventId, syncEventHash]
  );
  const hasActiveFilters =
    searchQuery.trim().length > 0 ||
    maxPrice < priceConfig.maxPrice ||
    selectedTimes.length > 0 ||
    selectedActivities.length > 0 ||
    selectedAreas.length > 0;
  const clearAllFilters = useCallback(() => {
    setSearchQuery('');
    setSelectedMaxPrice(null);
    setSelectedTimes([]);
    setSelectedActivities([]);
    setSelectedAreas([]);
  }, []);
  const totalEventsCount = allEvents.length;
  const dayHeading =
    activeDayIdx === 0
      ? 'Today'
      : activeDayIdx === 1
      ? 'Tomorrow'
      : DAY_NAMES_LONG[activeDate.getDay()];
  const daySubheading = `${DAY_NAMES_LONG[activeDate.getDay()]}, ${activeDate.getDate()} ${
    MONTH_NAMES[activeDate.getMonth()]
  }`;
  return (
    <div className={styles.pageContainer}>
      <Header city={city} />
      {city.alertBanner && (
        <div className={styles.alertBanner} role="status">
          <div className={styles.alertBannerInner}>
            <span className={styles.alertBannerIcon} aria-hidden="true">
              <svg
                width="18"
                height="18"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="2.2"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
              >
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
                <line x1="12" y1="8" x2="12" y2="12" />
                <line x1="12" y1="16" x2="12.01" y2="16" />
              </svg>
            </span>
            <span className={styles.alertBannerText}>
              {city.alertBanner.message}
              {city.alertBanner.linkText && city.alertBanner.linkHref ? (
                <>
                  {' '}
                  <Link href={city.alertBanner.linkHref} className={styles.alertBannerLink}>
                    {city.alertBanner.linkText}
                  </Link>
                </>
              ) : null}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className={styles.heroWrapper}>
        <CityHeroCard
          cityName={city.name}
          introTitle={city.introTitle}
          introDescription={city.introDescription}
          eventCount={totalEventsCount}
          lastUpdated={lastUpdated}
          activities={activities}
          selectedActivities={selectedActivities}
          onSelectChip={handleSelectChip}
          onClearActivities={() => setSelectedActivities([])}
        />
      </div>
      <main className={styles.mainLayout}>
        <aside className={styles.aside}>
          <h2 className={styles.asideTitle}>{dayHeading}</h2>
          <p className={styles.asideSubtitle}>{daySubheading}</p>
          <DayPicker
            rollingWeek={rollingWeek}
            activeDayIdx={activeDayIdx}
            onSelectDay={(idx) => {
              setActiveDayIdx(idx);
              setOpenEventId(null);
              syncEventHash(null);
            }}
            dayCounts={dayCounts}
          />
          <FilterControls
            searchQuery={searchQuery}
            onSearchChange={setSearchQuery}
            priceConfig={priceConfig}
            maxPrice={maxPrice}
            onPriceChange={handlePriceChange}
            timeSections={TIME_GROUPS.map((g) => g.name)}
            selectedTimes={selectedTimes}
            onToggleTime={toggleTime}
            onClearTimes={() => setSelectedTimes([])}
            activities={activities}
            selectedActivities={selectedActivities}
            onToggleActivity={toggleActivity}
            onClearActivities={() => setSelectedActivities([])}
            areas={areas}
            selectedAreas={selectedAreas}
            onToggleArea={toggleArea}
            onClearAreas={() => setSelectedAreas([])}
            hasActiveFilters={hasActiveFilters}
            onClearAllFilters={clearAllFilters}
          />
        </aside>
        <section className={styles.contentCol}>
          {currentList.length === 0 ? (
            <div className={styles.emptyState}>
              <b className={styles.emptyStateTitle}>
                Nothing listed{hasActiveFilters ? ' with these filters' : ''}
              </b>
              {hasActiveFilters ? (
                'Try clearing your filters to see more events.'
              ) : (
                <>
                  Know an event or group happening on this day?{' '}
                  <Link
                    href={`/${city.slug}/contact?tab=submit`}
                    className={styles.emptyStateLink}
                  >
                    Submit an event
                  </Link>
                  .
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            TIME_GROUPS.map((group) => {
              const groupEvents = currentList.filter((ev) =>
                group.predicate(ev.parsedHour)
              );
              if (groupEvents.length === 0) return null;
              return (
                <div key={group.name}>
                  <div className={styles.timeGroupHeader}>
                    {group.name}
                    <div className={styles.timeGroupLine} />
                  </div>
                  {groupEvents.map((ev) => {
                    const idx = indexedEvents.indexOf(ev);
                    const sourceEvent = idx >= 0 ? allEvents[idx] : ev;
                    const uniqueId =
                      eventKeyMap.get(sourceEvent) || getEventSlug(ev);
                    return (
                      <EventCard
                        key={uniqueId}
                        domId={`event-card-${uniqueId}`}
                        event={sourceEvent}
                        isOpen={openEventId === uniqueId}
                        isNextUp={uniqueId === nextUpEventId}
                        city={city}
                        selectedDate={activeDate}
                        onToggle={() => handleToggleEvent(sourceEvent, uniqueId)}
                        onOpenEdit={setEditModalEvent}
                      />
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              );
            })
          )}
        </section>
      </main>
      <Footer city={city} />
      {editModalEvent && (
        <SuggestEditModal
          event={editModalEvent}
          cityName={city.name}
          onClose={() => setEditModalEvent(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: app/events/components/EventCard.tsx
================
'use client';
import { memo, useId, useRef } from 'react';
import type { CityConfig } from '../../lib/cities';
import { Event } from '../../lib/google-sheets';
import {
  formatTimeRange,
  isFreePrice,
  getTagStyle,
} from '../utils';
import { getEventDisplayDetails } from '../event-helpers';
import EventActions from './EventActions';
import EventFacts from './EventFacts';
import InlineExternalLink from './InlineExternalLink';
import {
  ChevronDownIcon,
  CompassIcon,
  PinIcon,
  TagIcon,
} from './EventIcons';
import styles from './EventCard.module.css';

const DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX = 5;

interface EventCardProps {
  event: Event;
  isOpen: boolean;
  isNextUp: boolean;
  city: CityConfig;
  selectedDate: Date;
  domId?: string;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onOpenEdit: (ev: Event) => void;
}

function EventCard({
  event,
  isOpen,
  isNextUp,
  city,
  selectedDate,
  domId,
  onToggle,
  onOpenEdit,
}: EventCardProps) {
  const bodyId = useId();
  const headRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const pointerStartRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
  const didDragRef = useRef(false);
  const prevSelectionRef = useRef('');

  const handleHeadPointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.button !== 0) {
      pointerStartRef.current = null;
      return;
    }
    pointerStartRef.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    didDragRef.current = false;
    prevSelectionRef.current = window.getSelection()?.toString() ?? '';
  };

  const handleHeadPointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!pointerStartRef.current || didDragRef.current) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - pointerStartRef.current.x;
    const dy = e.clientY - pointerStartRef.current.y;
    if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX) {
      didDragRef.current = true;
    }
  };

  const handleHeadPointerCancel = () => {
    pointerStartRef.current = null;
    didDragRef.current = false;
  };

  const handleHeadClick = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if (target?.closest('button, a')) {
      return;
    }
    const start = pointerStartRef.current;
    pointerStartRef.current = null;
    if (didDragRef.current) {
      didDragRef.current = false;
      return;
    }
    if (start) {
      const dx = e.clientX - start.x;
      const dy = e.clientY - start.y;
      if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > DRAG_THRESHOLD_PX) {
        return;
      }
    }
    if (e.detail >= 2) {
      return;
    }
    const selection = window.getSelection();
    const selectedText = selection?.toString() ?? '';
    if (
      selectedText.trim().length > 0 &&
      selectedText !== prevSelectionRef.current &&
      headRef.current &&
      selection
    ) {
      const { anchorNode, focusNode } = selection;
      if (
        (anchorNode && headRef.current.contains(anchorNode)) ||
        (focusNode && headRef.current.contains(focusNode))
      ) {
        return;
      }
    }
    onToggle();
  };

  const { start, end } = formatTimeRange(event.startTime, event.endTime);
  const isFree = isFreePrice(event.price);
  const tagList = event.activities || [];
  const {
    displayVenue,
    venueUrl,
    showDistinctAddress,
    organizerName,
    organizerUrl,
    showOrganizer,
    recurrenceText,
    preRegistrationText,
    registrationUrl,
    needsSignupIcon,
    mapsHref,
    moreDetailsUrl,
  } = getEventDisplayDetails(event, city.name);
  const hasMeta = Boolean(event.price || event.area || tagList.length > 0);
  const descriptionText = (event.about || event.notes || '').trim();

  return (
    <article
      id={domId}
      className={`${styles.card} ${isOpen ? styles.open : ''}`}
    >
      <div
        ref={headRef}
        className={styles.head}
        onPointerDown={handleHeadPointerDown}
        onPointerMove={handleHeadPointerMove}
        onPointerCancel={handleHeadPointerCancel}
        onClick={handleHeadClick}
      >
        <div className={styles.time}>
          <b>{start || '—'}</b>
          {end && <span>to {end}</span>}
        </div>
        <div className={styles.main}>
          {isNextUp && <span className={styles.next}>Next up</span>}
          <h3 className={styles.title}>{event.title}</h3>
          {displayVenue && (
            <div className={styles.venue}>
              <PinIcon className={`${styles.icon} ${styles.venueIcon}`} />
              <div className={styles.venueText}>
                <InlineExternalLink href={venueUrl}>
                  {displayVenue}
                </InlineExternalLink>
                {showDistinctAddress && (
                  <span className={styles.venueLocation}>
                    , {event.location}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {showOrganizer && (
            <div
              className={`${styles.host} ${!displayVenue ? styles.hostFlush : ''}`}
            >
              Hosted by{' '}
              <InlineExternalLink
                href={organizerUrl}
                className={organizerUrl ? styles.hostLink : undefined}
              >
                {organizerName}
              </InlineExternalLink>
            </div>
          )}
          {hasMeta && (
            <div className={styles.meta}>
              {event.price && (
                <span
                  className={`${styles.price} ${
                    isFree ? styles.priceFree : styles.pricePaid
                  }`}
                >
                  <TagIcon className={styles.icon} />
                  <span>{event.price}</span>
                </span>
              )}
              {event.price && event.area && (
                <span className={styles.dot} aria-hidden="true" />
              )}
              {event.area && (
                <span className={styles.area}>
                  <CompassIcon className={styles.icon} />
                  <span>{event.area}</span>
                </span>
              )}
              {(event.price || event.area) && tagList.length > 0 && (
                <span className={`${styles.dot} ${styles.sep2}`} aria-hidden="true" />
              )}
              {tagList.length > 0 && (
                <div className={styles.tags}>
                  {tagList.map((tag) => {
                    const customStyle = getTagStyle(tag);
                    return (
                      <span
                        key={tag}
                        className={styles.tag}
                        style={{
                          color: customStyle.color,
                          backgroundColor: customStyle.background,
                        }}
                      >
                        {tag}
                      </span>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.chev}
          aria-expanded={isOpen}
          aria-controls={bodyId}
          aria-label={
            isOpen
              ? `Collapse details for ${event.title}`
              : `Expand details for ${event.title}`
          }
          onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            onToggle();
          }}
        >
          <ChevronDownIcon className={styles.icon} />
        </button>
      </div>
      <div
        id={bodyId}
        className={`${styles.body} ${!isOpen ? styles.bodyHidden : ''}`}
        aria-hidden={!isOpen}
      >
        {(descriptionText || moreDetailsUrl) && (
          <p className={styles.desc}>
            {descriptionText}
            {descriptionText && moreDetailsUrl ? ' ' : ''}
            {moreDetailsUrl && (
              <InlineExternalLink
                href={moreDetailsUrl}
                className={styles.moreDetailsLink}
              >
                More details
              </InlineExternalLink>
            )}
          </p>
        )}
        <EventFacts
          recurrenceText={recurrenceText}
          preRegistrationText={preRegistrationText}
          registrationUrl={registrationUrl}
          needsSignupIcon={needsSignupIcon}
          className={styles.facts}
        />
        <EventActions
          event={event}
          city={city}
          selectedDate={selectedDate}
          mapsHref={mapsHref}
          onOpenEdit={() => onOpenEdit(event)}
        />
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

export default memo(EventCard);
